title: 0-31 Saichi Maru (Annette)
summary: Security walker robot configured for gunner and shipboard defense duties.
text: 0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette) Security Walker Robot Designation 0 31 Saichi Maru | Type Size 5 walker robot | TL 12+ | Status Active | Owner Annette ![0 31 Saichi Maru portrait](/wiki/media/Saichi Maru HEAD.png) | Field | Value | | | | | Designation | 0 31 Saichi Maru | | Nickname | Saichi | | Type | Security Walker Robot | | Tech Level | TL12+ | Overview 0 31 Saichi Maru is a size 5 walker robot configured for gunner and security duties. Known by the crew as Saichi, the unit combines a hardened security chassis, an Advanced TL12+ brain, integrated sensors, and mounted laser weapons into a compact patrol and shipboard defense platform. The robot is operated by Annette and is built around battlefield awareness, corridor control, and reliable response under pressure rather than social nuance or independent improvisation. Updates In [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], Saichi warned the group she needed a heavy charge within about a day unless she avoided combat. Saichi and Varian used a public shaming at the Grand Axis as cover to access a police mech charger. Saichi unplugged the mech, charged herself, and restored roughly three days of noncombat power. Character Sheet Sensors Auditory/Visual Sensor Audio Broad, Atmospheric Sensor, and Recon Sensor Enhanced. Communications Transceiver 5km with Wireless Data Link and Tight Beam. Systems Voder Speaker, Encryption Module, Fire Control Basic, Drone Interface, and Robot Armour. Connections Session 1 Official Business Attended the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] as an autonomous AI/robot whose status required financial and administrative review. Stood apart at first, trying not to interrupt human social protocols. Identified herself by pointing to the 0 31 designation "31" as Saichi and "0" as Maru. Joined the escape after the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Killed the pilot of the attacking walker/mech without destroying the machine, enabling the group to ride it down the building. Took damage in the descent and was repaired afterward by [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]]. Built or placed a tracker for [[Marcel Delphine]]'s communicator so the group would not lose it. Session 2 Masks and Markers Made her power needs a priority for the group before they split up. Traveled under an [[Identity Veils|Identity Veil]] that made her appear as a similar but different robot model. Went with [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] to find a heavy charge source while the others investigated the Hall and gathered supplies. Used the public shaming at the Grand Axis as cover to reach a police mech charger. Recharged from the police mech during the crowd distraction and left the mech unplugged. Returned to the warehouse with enough power to keep operating for the next phase. Session 3 Transstar Day Entered the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] as tagged equipment/property while the party sought corporate shelter. Accepted a restrainer/tag arrangement that powered down her weapons enough for Transstar entry. Became part of Emma's Transstar signing package once Emma tested into executive status. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Reported to Dock 6 2 with the rest of the crew and received a Transstar visual treatment suitable for a robot. Confirmed that her gecko feet and robotic body could help with fast hull response before suited humans could deploy. Was offered access to reactor room charge plug ins aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. Worked drone and exterior watch duties during the Hadal mission. Watched the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]'s room from outside [[Undersea Base Elyon]] and spotted a [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] taking scans. Sent a security notice to the rest of the team after identifying the SolSec contact. Session 5 The Oduya Maintained watch outside [[Alain Mercier]]'s medical room at [[Undersea Base Elyon]] while the group discussed the SolSec confrontation. Accepted Emma's request to scout the [[Sunken Ship Boat]] as a remote recon unit. Walked roughly twenty to thirty miles along the sea floor to reach the wreck before the [[TSS Profondeur]] arrived. Recorded exterior markings, hull condition, mummified crew in vac suits, and the suspicious removable Navy wrap. Found the dead captain in a locker and recovered the [[Transponder Swap Box]] from his hands. Documented the unusual transponder modules and helped the group identify [[Oduya]] as a smuggling craft rather than a clean Navy vessel. title: Admiral Henri Duval
summary: Commander, Jardin Naval Command at Fort Robespierre Naval Annex.
text: Admiral Henri Duval Commander, Jardin Naval Command Overview Admiral Henri Duval commands Jardin Naval Command from the [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]] and is the senior naval officer assigned to the system. A strong advocate for expanding naval power across the Solomani Front, he sits at the point where Jardin's military ambitions meet Confederation strategy. The fleet anchored above Jardin answers, ultimately, to him. Notable For Senior naval officer in the Jardin system. Pushes to expand Solomani Front naval power. Commands the fleet stationed at Fort Robespierre. Ties [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]]

title: Adrien Pelletier
summary: Governor of Rousseau at Arcosphere Rousseau.
text: Adrien Pelletier Governor of Rousseau Overview Adrien Pelletier governs the Arcosphère Rousseau, the largest single structure on Jardin and home to nearly two billion permanent residents. A dedicated administrator, he genuinely believes the arcology is a working model of humanity's future and defends the Solomani planning ideal in every public forum. Running a self contained city of that scale means his authority touches housing, transit, industry, and security in ways that rival a planetary minister, and critics note that few decisions inside Rousseau happen without his office knowing. Notable For Governs a residential megastructure of roughly 1.8 billion residents. Treats the arcology as proof that Solomani social planning succeeds. Holds practical power over Rousseau comparable to a planetary minister. Ties [[Arcosphere Rousseau]]

title: Agent Luc Deschamps
summary: SolSec Liaison Officer at Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony.
text: Agent Luc Deschamps SolSec Liaison Officer Overview Agent Luc Deschamps is the [[SolSec]] liaison officer at [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]], officially responsible for interagency coordination and unofficially responsible for a good deal more. As the Solomani security service's eyes at the border, he watches for the terrorism and external threats that fall outside [[Social Solidarity]]'s planetary remit — a jurisdiction that, since the Mercier frame up, now brushes uncomfortably close to the party. Notable For SolSec's presence at the arrival checkpoint. Watches for external and terrorism linked threats. His remit now overlaps the party's framed status. Ties [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]] [[SolSec]] [[Social Solidarity]]

title: Alain Mercier
text: Alain Mercier Basic Information Full Name Alain Étienne Mercier Species Human (Solomani) Citizenship Solomani Confederation (Jardin) Birth Year 1061 Birthplace Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, Jardin Occupation Minister of Genetics, Government of Jardin Political Affiliation Solomani Party (Technocratic Reform Bloc) Status Publicly deceased (1105); restored clone body recovered at Hadal. Overview Alain Mercier was a Jardinese geneticist, civil servant, and politician who served as Minister of Genetics during the administration of Supreme President Leo Duprey. Widely regarded as one of the foremost experts on population genetics and demographic analysis within the Solomani Confederation, Mercier oversaw the Ministry of Genetics during a period of unprecedented expansion in genetic research and data collection. Although generally viewed as a loyal supporter of the Solomani Cause, Mercier developed a reputation for placing scientific findings above political convenience. His insistence on evidence based policy earned him respect among researchers and academics but often placed him at odds with powerful political interests. Mercier became a figure of subsector wide interest shortly before his death when he announced plans to release the results of a major long term demographic study at the upcoming Solomani Party Congress. Early Life Born in the capital city of Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, Mercier was the son of two senior administrators employed by Jardin's Eugenics Bureau. Identified at an early age as possessing exceptional intellectual aptitude, he was selected for advanced educational programs and graduated with distinction from the Jardin Institute of Biological Sciences. His academic work focused on long term population stability, hereditary trait distribution, and the interaction between social planning and genetic outcomes. Several of his early papers became required reading within Confederation genetics programs. Academic Career Before entering government service, Mercier spent nearly two decades as a researcher and lecturer. He gained prominence through his work analyzing the effects of large scale demographic interventions across multiple generations. His findings challenged several accepted assumptions regarding population management and brought him to the attention of senior Party officials. Unlike many researchers who remained within academia, Mercier demonstrated an unusual ability to communicate complex scientific findings to political leaders. By his mid forties he had become one of the Confederation's most influential voices on genetics policy. Minister of Genetics Mercier was appointed Minister of Genetics in 1097 following the retirement of his predecessor. During his tenure the Ministry expanded several major initiatives, including Confederation wide genetic archive modernization. Longitudinal population studies. Enhanced hereditary disease screening. Interplanetary demographic monitoring. Research into population resilience and long term genetic stability. Although publicly supportive of existing policy, Mercier repeatedly argued that no social system could remain effective unless it was subjected to continual scientific review. His ministry became known for its unusually rigorous standards and independence from factional politics. Political Views Mercier was often described as a technocrat rather than an ideologue. While loyal to Jardin and the Solomani Cause, he frequently emphasized that scientific institutions should not be influenced by political considerations. His most famous public statement was delivered shortly before his death "We owe it to the citizens of Jardin to follow the data wherever it leads. The strength of our society has always been built upon scientific rigor, honest evaluation, and the courage to improve." Supporters viewed this philosophy as evidence of intellectual integrity. Critics argued that it demonstrated political naivety. Final Months In the final year of his life, Mercier directed a comprehensive review of demographic and genetic data collected over multiple generations. At a press conference held at the Hall of Genetics, he announced that his ministry would reveal significant findings at the upcoming Solomani Party Congress. The announcement generated intense speculation throughout political, military, and academic circles. Observers noted that Mercier's remarks were unusually direct and appeared to suggest conclusions with potentially far reaching implications. Session 1 Assassination During [[Session 1 Official Business]], the characters saw a news broadcast reporting that Mercier would reveal corruption in the genetic affairs files at the coming Party Congress. The broadcast framed the announcement as potentially revolutionary for the government. Shortly afterward, Mercier rushed through the office area at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] and was killed by multiple shots. The scene appeared designed to make the player characters look responsible several characters detected signs that their own weapons had moved, fired, or been made to appear as if they fired. Items recovered from Mercier [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] His phone. Concealed armor, which failed to stop the barrage. [[Marcel Delphine]] later claimed Mercier's real discovery pointed to corruption "from above," not to the [[Jardin Syndicate]]'s genetic identity manipulation. Session 2 Recovered Research During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], the party recovered a [[Mobile Data Tube]] from the Hall's plumbing. Its message stated that Mercier had been killed for data given to him. The chip inside contained part of the [[Mercier Genetic Findings]] long term genetic marker research tied to extraordinary or psionic like effects. The file is corrupted before its final conclusion, but the recovered material strongly suggests Mercier's planned disclosure was more than ordinary record fraud. Press Materials Hall of Genetics News Capture ![Fraud at the Hall of Genetics? Minister Mercier promises major findings at upcoming Party Congress.](/wiki/media/Alain Mercier Hall of Genetics News.png) Minister Mercier Announcement Audio Minister Mercier announcement audio. Death On 143 1105, while attending official business at the Hall of Genetics in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, Mercier was assassinated. The murder shocked Jardin and rapidly became one of the most significant criminal and political investigations in recent Confederation history. His death occurred only weeks before the scheduled release of his ministry's report. The contents of the report have never been publicly disclosed. Legacy Alain Mercier remains a controversial figure in Jardinese history. To supporters, he embodied the principle that scientific truth should guide public policy regardless of political consequences. To critics, he represented a dangerous willingness to question institutions that had maintained stability for centuries. His unfinished work continues to be the subject of speculation among historians, political analysts, and genetic researchers throughout the Solomani Confederation. Session 4 Lookalike Survivor During [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]], the party rescues an unidentified Jardin Navy officer from [[Hadal Research Site]] who looks strikingly like Alain Mercier. The survivor is stabilized at [[Undersea Base Elyon]] and becomes the subject of a [[SolSec Operative at Elyon|SolSec]] scan, raising the possibility of a twin, clone, altered double, or other genetic connection to Mercier. Session 5 Clone Rebirth During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], the survivor wakes and identifies himself as Alain Mercier. He explains that high status people with Platinum 2 security can maintain prepared clone bodies through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. If the original dies, an engram transfer wakes the prepared body. Mercier's restored memory is about six weeks old, so he does not know exactly what his prior self found immediately before the public assassination. He suspects that the attack on [[Hadal Research Site]] destroyed political, naval, and Transstar clone backups before a future assassination. The same day, the [[Prime Minister Bombing]] makes that warning urgent. Mercier cannot legally return to Jardin's surface after a public death. He offers the party access codes to his house and computer if they keep him safe and get him to an off world or Navy transfer.

title: Amelia Torres
summary: Special Projects Coordinator at Transstar.
text: Amelia Torres Special Projects Coordinator Overview Amelia Torres is [[Transstar]]'s Special Projects Coordinator, officially overseeing strategic transportation initiatives that no one can quite define. She appears whenever [[SolSec]] becomes involved, Party officials travel, or sensitive cargo moves, and many employees quietly believe she works for intelligence services. Asked directly, she only smiles — which is answer enough for most who ask. Notable For Oversees undefined "strategic" Transstar projects. Surfaces around SolSec, VIPs, and sensitive cargo. Widely suspected of working for intelligence. Ties [[Transstar]] [[SolSec]]

title: Anita Singh
summary: Emma Colbert contact who can convert illegal cargo into ship repair services through logistics channels.
text: Anita Singh Overview Anita Singh is one of [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]]'s contacts. She is a sharp witted entrepreneur whose logistics consortium quietly controls warehousing, orbital freight handling, and labor contracts across several Confederation starports. Session 5 During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], Emma identifies Anita as a viable channel for fencing the illegal cybernetic cargo recovered from [[Oduya]]. Rather than simply paying cash, Anita can trade value into ship repair services, plates, replacement monitors, cleanup, and refueling support. Relevance Anita gives the party a way to turn dangerous contraband into practical repairs without presenting wanted fugitives at a normal market.

title: Antoine Mercier
summary: Executive Director, Solomani Front Operations at Transstar Sector Exchange.
text: Antoine Mercier Executive Director, Solomani Front Operations Overview Antoine Mercier is Executive Director of Solomani Front Operations for [[Transstar]] and the most powerful Transstar executive on Jardin. He is frequently rumored to wield more real influence than several planetary ministers, which on a world this centralized is a striking thing to say about a corporate officer. Whether his surname ties him to the late Minister of Genetics is not established, but in a city this tangled the coincidence rarely goes unremarked. Notable For Most powerful Transstar executive on Jardin. Said to outweigh several planetary ministers in influence. Surname link to Alain Mercier is unconfirmed. Ties [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] [[Transstar]]

title: Aquatic Salvage Project
summary: First Transstar assignment: undersea salvage aboard the TSS Profondeur, beginning with Hadal Research Site.
text: Aquatic Salvage Project ![Hadal undersea operations map](/wiki/media/Hadal Undersea Map.png) Overview The Aquatic Salvage Project is the party's first Transstar assignment after [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]. [[Claire Bouchard]] assigns the group to the project during onboarding, and [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]] begins with the group reporting to Dock 6 2 for duty aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. Known Details Work begins the morning after Transstar orientation. The first vessel is the [[TSS Profondeur]], a refitted former Jardin Navy submersible. The first site is [[Hadal Research Site]], a damaged Transstar undersea facility. The project needs loaders, ship crew, executive oversight, technical salvage hands, drone operators, and armed diving support. The opposition was first described as [[Dolphin Extremists]] and later clarified as [[Undersea Extremists]] including humanoids and orcas. Transstar undersea suits use vac suit style procedures but are built for pressure rather than space vacuum. Session 4 Results The party surveys Hadal, finds a live power load, and discovers a sealed chamber with four living survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel. A temporary airlock rescue saves only one survivor the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. The rescue turns the project from simple salvage into a conspiracy lead. Hadal was a Transstar site, but the people found there were Jardin Navy. Session 5 Results After the Hadal rescue, the party uses the project, the [[TSS Profondeur]], and Emma's Transstar authority to divert toward the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]. [[Etienne Valcourt]] agrees to frame the run as continued rescue and evidence hunting work. The party raises the wreck, identifies it as [[Oduya]], and recovers illegal cybernetics, a valuable hibernating tree, ship logs, and a [[Transponder Swap Box]]. The find turns the salvage project into the party's possible route to orbit and the next stage of the [[Mercier Frame Up]] investigation. Relevance The project may connect to earlier leads about the [[Sunken Ship Boat]], hidden military operations, and the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Emma's executive role and the party's shipboard training give them a way to investigate while serving Transstar's needs. Open Questions What was Transstar salvaging at Hadal? playerText: Aquatic Salvage Project ![Hadal undersea operations map](/wiki/media/Hadal Undersea Map.png) Overview The Aquatic Salvage Project is the party's first Transstar assignment after [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]. [[Claire Bouchard]] assigns the group to the project during onboarding, and [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]] begins with the group reporting to Dock 6 2 for duty aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. Known Details Work begins the morning after Transstar orientation. The first vessel is the [[TSS Profondeur]], a refitted former Jardin Navy submersible. The first site is [[Hadal Research Site]], a damaged Transstar undersea facility. The project needs loaders, ship crew, executive oversight, technical salvage hands, drone operators, and armed diving support. The opposition was first described as [[Dolphin Extremists]] and later clarified as [[Undersea Extremists]] including humanoids and orcas. Transstar undersea suits use vac suit style procedures but are built for pressure rather than space vacuum. Session 4 Results The party surveys Hadal, finds a live power load, and discovers a sealed chamber with four living survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel. A temporary airlock rescue saves only one survivor the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. The rescue turns the project from simple salvage into a conspiracy lead. Hadal was a Transstar site, but the people found there were Jardin Navy. Session 5 Results After the Hadal rescue, the party uses the project, the [[TSS Profondeur]], and Emma's Transstar authority to divert toward the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]. [[Etienne Valcourt]] agrees to frame the run as continued rescue and evidence hunting work. The party raises the wreck, identifies it as [[Oduya]], and recovers illegal cybernetics, a valuable hibernating tree, ship logs, and a [[Transponder Swap Box]]. The find turns the salvage project into the party's possible route to orbit and the next stage of the [[Mercier Frame Up]] investigation. the registry war) [Lost Beneath Rousseau]( lost beneath rousseau) [Session 1 Notes]( session 1 notes) Overview The Arcosphère Rousseau (Rousseau Arcology) is the largest structure on Jardin and one of the most densely populated urban environments in the Solomani Confederation. Dominating the center of Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, the arcology forms a massive crescent surrounding the Grand Axis and serves as the residential, commercial, industrial, and cultural heart of the planetary capital. To outsiders, Rousseau appears impossible. To residents, it is simply home. Nearly one in seven citizens of Jardin lives within its walls. Entire generations are born, educated, employed, married, and buried without ever leaving the arcology. Government planners proudly describe Rousseau as "Human civilization perfected." Residents typically describe it as "Crowded." History The Arcology Initiative Construction began nearly two centuries ago during the Great Expansion. Rapid population growth threatened to consume valuable agricultural land surrounding Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne. Rather than expand outward indefinitely, planners chose a different solution. The city would expand upward. The Arcology Initiative combined Housing Industry Transportation Commerce Education Recreation into a single integrated structure. The project became one of the largest construction efforts in Confederation history. The Rousseau Doctrine Named after the ancient Terran philosopher Jean Jacques Rousseau, the arcology was intended to demonstrate that careful planning could create a superior urban environment. Government publications described it as "A city designed for citizens rather than automobiles." The original plans envisioned housing approximately 800 million residents. Reality proved more complicated. The Quiet Expansion Over successive generations, unused maintenance spaces, storage sections, and service corridors were gradually converted into residential and commercial districts. Some expansions were legal. Others were not. The result is a structure far larger than official plans ever intended. No one knows its true size. Architecture From above, Rousseau resembles an immense crescent embracing the Grand Axis of Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne. The structure rises hundreds of meters above the city and extends deep beneath ground level. Major features include Residential towers Commercial districts Internal parks Transit networks Schools Hospitals Manufacturing centers The arcology contains enough internal infrastructure to function independently for months if isolated. Major Districts Les Sommets The Summit Levels The highest and most prestigious districts. Home to Senior Party officials Corporate executives Leading scientists Wealthy professionals Features include Private sky gardens Luxury apartments Exclusive clubs Fine dining establishments Many apartments possess direct views of the Palace of Continuity. Residents insist this is merely coincidence. Les Niveaux Civiques Civic Levels The professional middle class. Home to Teachers Engineers Doctors Administrators Researchers These districts represent the idealized vision of Jardin society. Clean. Efficient. Safe. Almost every government promotional video is filmed here. Les Communes Commons Levels The largest section of Rousseau. Home to more than a billion residents. Contains Housing blocks Schools Markets Restaurants Recreation facilities This is where most ordinary citizens live. Visitors often compare it to a city existing entirely indoors. Les Ateliers Industrial Levels The manufacturing heart of the arcology. Contains Factories Warehouses Robot maintenance facilities Recycling systems Cargo handling centers Thousands of freight vehicles move through the district every hour. Most visitors never see it. Most residents depend upon it. Les Profondeurs The Depths The lowest officially recognized districts. Contains Utility systems Transit infrastructure Water processing facilities Power distribution networks Officially sparsely populated. Unofficially not. The Unofficial City Les Ombres The Shadows The name given to unregistered districts hidden within the arcology. These areas do not officially exist. Generations of unauthorized construction have created Informal neighborhoods Hidden marketplaces Illegal workshops Refugee communities Smuggling routes Authorities periodically deny their existence. Everyone else knows better. Daily Life Life inside Rousseau rarely requires leaving the structure. Residents have access to Employment Education Entertainment Healthcare Transportation within walking distance. Many citizens spend months without seeing open sky. Artificial lighting systems simulate natural day night cycles. Most residents stop noticing. Transportation Rousseau possesses one of the most advanced transit systems in the Confederation. Transportation methods include Maglev trains Moving pedestrian corridors Autonomous shuttles Freight elevators Grav lifts The average resident can reach any major district within thirty minutes. Commerce The arcology contains millions of businesses. Everything from Street vendors Family restaurants Boutique manufacturers Corporate headquarters can be found within Rousseau. Many of the Confederation's largest corporations maintain offices here. Culture Rousseau possesses its own distinct identity. Residents often describe themselves as "Rousseans first, Jardinais second." Whether this is intended as a joke remains unclear. The arcology has developed Unique slang Local traditions Distinct cuisine Neighborhood rivalries Many citizens never fully identify with the broader city. Major Landmarks Forum Rousseau The central public square. Location of Public speeches Demonstrations Cultural festivals The largest indoor gathering space on Jardin. Market of a Thousand Worlds A sprawling commercial district. Contains goods from across the Confederation and beyond. One of the best places on Jardin to find something unusual. The People's Conservatory A vast indoor park. Contains Lakes Forests Walking paths Many residents visit simply to experience something resembling nature. The Arcology Museum Documents the history of Rousseau and urban development throughout the Confederation. Popular with school groups. Not popular with schoolchildren. Security Public security is maintained by Arcology Security Directorate Municipal Police SolSec liaison officers Security levels vary considerably between districts. The Summit Levels are among the safest places on Jardin. The Shadows are not. Criminal Activity Despite government claims, Rousseau possesses a substantial underworld. Activities include Smuggling Identity fraud Unregistered robotics Counterfeiting Information theft Most criminal activity occurs within The Shadows. The Jardin Syndicate The arcology serves as the primary operational center of the Jardin Syndicate. Officially this is false. Everyone knows it is true. Numerous front organizations operate within the Commons and Industrial districts. Their influence is particularly strong among Migrant populations Refugee communities Unregistered residents The Syndicate's unofficial slogan is frequently heard in the Shadows "Everything is possible. It simply isn't approved." Notable Individuals [[Adrien Pelletier]] Governor of Rousseau A dedicated administrator who genuinely believes the arcology represents humanity's future. [[Nadia Giroux]] Investigative Journalist Known for exposing corruption and embarrassing powerful individuals. Frequently receives anonymous threats. Frequently ignores them. [[Sister Celeste Moreau]] Community Organizer Operates charitable programs throughout the lower districts. Widely respected by residents. [[Jacques Martin]] Business Executive Officially owns several logistics companies. Unofficially rumored to maintain extensive connections within the Jardin Syndicate. Public Opinion Government officials point to Rousseau as proof of the success of Solomani planning. Residents generally agree. They simply disagree about why. Rumors The Lost Levels Entire districts sealed during construction still exist beneath the arcology. The Hidden Registry An illegal copy of citizen records exists somewhere within The Shadows. The Shepherd's Court Marcel Delphine allegedly maintains a hidden residence somewhere inside Rousseau. No one agrees where. The Ghost Transit Line A maglev route appears on no official maps but continues to operate. Passengers report reaching destinations that should not exist. Adventure Hooks The Missing Citizen A resident vanishes from every government database. The only lead points toward the Shadows. Arcology Election A local Party Congress threatens to expose major corruption. Several factions seek outside assistance. Ghost District Maintenance crews discover a forgotten neighborhood sealed for decades. The Shepherd's Invitation The Travellers receive an invitation to meet Marcel Delphine. The location changes every time it is transmitted. The Registry War The Hall of Chosen Futures and the Jardin Syndicate begin a quiet conflict over stolen citizen records. The Travellers become caught in the middle. Lost Beneath Rousseau A child disappears into the unregistered sections of the arcology. Finding them requires entering places that officially do not exist. Session 1 Notes The player characters live in the Rousseau arcology, though on different floors, classes, elevators, and routines. After the [[Mercier Assassination]], a driverless grav speeder returned toward their home but used waste disposal access rather than a public entrance. The vehicle entered hidden service routes beneath the arcology. [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] recognized that criminal organizations on Jardin are rumored to use access ways, cleaning material locations, venting paths, and similar spaces as headquarters in the cracks of the city. gm Referee Notes Rousseau should feel alive. Unlike the Palace of Continuity, which represents authority, or the Hall of Chosen Futures, which represents administration, Rousseau represents people. It contains everything. Success and failure. Wealth and poverty. Order and chaos. Idealism and corruption. If the Palace is the mind of Jardin and the Hall is its nervous system, then Rousseau is its beating heart. Most campaigns set on Jardin will eventually spend more time here than anywhere else. The arcology is large enough to contain an entire campaign by itself.

title: Armand Rousselet
summary: Senior Customs Liaison at Transstar.
text: Armand Rousselet Senior Customs Liaison Overview Armand Rousselet is [[Transstar]]'s Senior Customs Liaison, working the seam between the company and Jardin's customs authorities. Thirty years of finding legal solutions to impossible problems have earned him the hatred of many smugglers and the secret respect of just as many. He is the man Transstar sends when a shipment's paperwork needs to become, quite legally, someone else's problem. Notable For Thirty years bridging Transstar and customs. Turns impossible shipments into legal ones. Hated and respected across the smuggling trade. Ties [[Transstar]]

title: Campaign
summary: Main campaign hub and directory for Sparks From the Past.
text: Sparks From the Past Welcome to the campaign hub for Sparks From the Past . This wiki contains the campaign setting, session notes, player characters, NPCs, locations, handouts, and world lore. If it has happened in the game, it belongs here. Campaign Overview The year is 1105 Imperial , on the Solomani world of Jardin . The Travellers were pulled into a conspiracy after the assassination of Genetics Minister [[Alain Mercier]] at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]]. They are now fugitives under corporate cover, trying to survive long enough to learn who framed them and why Mercier's work mattered. Current Situation The crew is hiding under [[Transstar]] employment after the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. Their current cover is the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]], an undersea assignment aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], the Hadal survivor identified himself as [[Alain Mercier]] restored through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. He cannot legally return to Jardin's surface, but he will provide access codes to his house and computer if the party can keep him safe and move him off world. The party raised the old [[Sunken Ship Boat]], now identified as [[Oduya]], and recovered a [[Transponder Swap Box]] that may let the ship boat operate under multiple identities. The same day, the [[Prime Minister Bombing]] suggested that Hadal's destruction may have removed clone backups before another high ranking assassination. title: Captain Victor Mendes
summary: Senior Transstar Freight Captain at Port Sainte-Jeanne Downport.
text: Captain Victor Mendes Senior Transstar Freight Captain Overview Captain Victor Mendes is a respected merchant captain known throughout the [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]] community and a senior freight captain for [[Transstar]]. A former Confederation Navy petty officer, he now commands the freighter Prosperity's Promise and is trusted with sensitive cargo assignments precisely because of his reputation for reliability, honesty, and protecting his crew. He refuses to carry anything he believes is connected to slavery — a line that makes him useful to some and useless to others. (He is a separate person from the Traveller Victor Mendes.) Notable For Commands the freighter Prosperity's Promise. Trusted with sensitive cargo; former Navy petty officer. Will not transport anything tied to slavery. Ties [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]] [[Transstar]]

title: Carlos
summary: Old Navy acquaintance associated with a poker game on the Venture; possibly connected to future jump contacts.
text: Carlos Overview Carlos is an old shipboard acquaintance mentioned when [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] and another veteran recognized each other from service aboard the Venture. He used to run a poker game and is remembered as a cheat and poor bluffer, though still "loyal to the party" in the joking recollection. Near the end of the session, the GM mentions "Carlos contacts" or "Carlos Contax" in connection with moving the group through the next jump once they are off Jardin. The exact name and role need human review. Appears In [[Session 1 Official Business]] Notes Associated with prior Navy service and poker. May be relevant to off world movement after the group escapes Jardin.

title: Cass Pien (Kolb)
text: Cass Pien (Kolb) ![Cass Pien portrait](/wiki/media/Cass Pien.png) Solomani Racial • Confederation Navy Flight Hits 27 Armour Ceramic Carapace, Protection 10; Protection 16 vs lasers, flame throwers, and fire based attacks Cash Cr27,250 Ship Shares 3 Profile Cass Pien is a Solomani Confederation citizen whose career spans Prisoner and Confederation Navy service. His background includes Belter preparation, a prison term as a trusted inmate, and naval flight service linked to covert support of Solomani guerrillas and notable space combat. Notable Skills Tactics (Naval) 3, Leadership 3, Stealth 2, Profession (Belter) 2, Gun Combat (Slug) 2, Deception 1, Electronics (Comms) 1, Gun Combat (Energy) 1, Heavy Weapons (Vehicle) 1, Jack of All Trades 1, Medic 1, Recon 1, Streetwise 1, Vacc Suit 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Recognized a fellow veteran from service aboard the Venture and remembered Carlos's old poker game. Initially encouraged compliance after the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Joined the fight and escape once the situation turned lethal. Asked [[Marcel Delphine]] why the [[Jardin Syndicate]] had rescued the group and what they wanted. Session 3 Transstar Day Helped carry the plan to deliver the Mercier evidence through [[Lucin]] rather than approach SolSec directly. Continued pushing for evidence that could clear the party after the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. Entered Transstar employment as part of the group's legal cover plan before the [[Identity Veils]] failed. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Trained on the [[TSS Profondeur]] bridge and ship systems under [[Étienne Valcourt]]. Noted the Profondeur's under crewed condition and suspicious prior crew traces. Joined the manned entry into the sealed Hadal habitat during the temporary airlock rescue. Helped recover survivors from [[Hadal Research Site]] and kept the Mercier lookalike discovery in the party evidence channel. Contacted allies afterward a lover to recover belongings, smuggling contacts for escape options, a reporter/investigative contact, and someone who can listen at the [[Friday Party Congress Hearing]]. Learned of the [[Sunken Ship Boat]] as a possible escape asset. Session 5 The Oduya Took part in the group's discussion about whether to continue Transstar work or prioritize acquiring a ship. Participated in the [[Oduya]] salvage plan and vac suit preparations. Helped with the practical ship recovery effort aboard the wreck while others handled Mercier, persuasion, and contacts. Remained tied to the larger ship boat thread because the original [[Sunken Ship Boat]] lead came through Cass's smuggling contacts. Session 2 Masks and Markers Joined the Hall recon team and helped investigate the anxious Hall scientist, later identified as [[Dr. Luc Moreau]]. Entered the bathroom with [[Zoy (Damon)]] while following Moreau's suspicious movement through the Hall. Assisted in recovering the [[Mobile Data Tube]] from the bathroom plumbing before it could escape or destroy its contents. Continued pushing for actionable evidence that could clear the group or expose the frame up. title: Chief Helene Marchand
summary: President's Chief of Staff whose secured residence received Lucin's covert delivery.
text: Chief Helene Marchand Overview Chief Helene Marchand is identified by a gold plaque as Chief of Staff of the President. During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], the group delivered Lucin's crate to a secured residence bearing her name. Session 2 The group arrived at Marchand's address on Lucin's trike while wearing [[Identity Veils]]. Security personnel waved them through. A cybernetically enhanced butler accepted the crate, opened it with a code, released gas from the seal, and let a corgi out from inside. The group left without challenging the delivery or asking questions on site. Open Questions Did Marchand personally request the delivery? Why was the crate routed through Lucin rather than normal official channels? Was the corgi genetically significant, politically sensitive, or simply contraband luxury? Does Marchand have ties to the underworld, the Closed Gardens, or the genetic research scandal? gm GM Notes The transcript later summarizes this as "the Vice President" receiving a corgi, but the scene plaque says Chief Helene Marchand, Chief of Staff of the President.

title: Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)
text: Ciernan Seanislav (Peter) ![Ciernan Seanislav portrait](/wiki/media/Ciernan Seanislav.png) Solomani Racial • Merchant Merchant Marine Player Peter Age 30 Species Solomani Racial Gender Unknown UPP STR 11, DEX 8, END 12, INT 6, EDU 8, SOC 8 Hits 31 Armour Cloth Jacket, Protection 5 Cash Cr4,000 Profile Ciernan Seanislav is a Solomani Confederation citizen whose career spans the Solomani Star Marines and Merchant service. Their record includes battledress marine training, commendations, specialist weapons work, and a merchant term that ended in pirate trouble. Notable Skills Gun Combat (Slug) 3, Heavy Weapons (Manportable) 2, Vacc Suit 2, Athletics (Endurance) 1, Deception 1, Drive 1, Electronics (Comms) 1, Gunner (Turret) 1, Leadership 1, Medic 1, Melee (Blade) 1, Persuade 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Science (Cybernetics) 1, Stealth 1, Steward 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Arrived heavily armed and visibly militarized, with religious paraphernalia, tattoos, red braid, beard, and combat habits. Spoke with [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] as a fellow Solomani marine/service veteran. Distrusted the situation immediately after his shotgun showed a missing round and heat from firing. Interpreted the weapon manipulation as "psyker" or "Esper witchery" and pushed hard for escape. Helped support the walker/mech descent while Emma drove. Hid or moved heavy gear afterward, including a minigun, with help from the group. Session 2 Masks and Markers Joined the Sainte Liberte supply team and prioritized ammunition, repair tools, and practical survival needs. Used his broker skills to acquire ordinary supplies without immediately exposing the group through identity linked payments. Helped create [[Secure Burner Comms]] from cheap phones and parts. Met [[Lucin]] with Dan and the supply team, opening a path to ammunition through a Transstar broker. Compared the recovered [[Mercier Genetic Findings]] to his own genetic papers. The identified markers do not appear in his records. Session 3 Transstar Day Led the Lucin team back through Sainte Liberte and helped negotiate the evidence handoff at [[La Porte Fiel]]. Directed the escape route after [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] activated its tracking signal. Entered Transstar as a loader, accepting lower status work as the price of immediate corporate protection. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Introduced himself aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]] as a loader willing to help with repair, security, and whatever work kept the ship alive. Trained in undersea suit procedures and exterior work with [[Sabine Caron]]. Helped reason through the temporary airlock plan for the sealed Hadal habitat. Entered the sealed chamber, reassured the survivors, and began triage after the rescue. Privately flagged the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]] as evidence that needed to be logged and protected. Backed up the attempted contact with the [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]]. Session 5 The Oduya Debriefed the party on the SolSec confrontation and emphasized that the agent had drawn a gun on Zoy. Opposed signing a long Transstar commitment, but supported a short term mission if it led toward freedom and evidence. Joined the [[Oduya]] recovery in a vac suit with harpoon gear, focusing on threats and security. Helped bring sensors and monitors online inside the wreck while the ship began moving. Reacted strongly to the ship moving before life support and safety were fully restored. Showed intense interest in the illegal cybernetic weapons and implants recovered from Oduya's cargo. Considered keeping at least one cybernetic implant, while Emma raised the question of genetic purity consequences. Rival Betrayer Enemy Pressik Voss, space pirate and reptilian rascal who seeks destruction for destruction's sake Enemy Pirates/Corsairs Equipment Navy Combat Shotgun, Navy Combat Shotgun Stun Round, Ceramic Carapace, Cloth Jacket, Vacc Suit Basic, Machinegun. gm Import Notes Imported from Foundry actor export fvtt Actor ciernan seanislav (peter) bU6Hk2gIFL4x8X1E.json .

title: Claire Bouchard
summary: Transstar Highport Operations Manager who processed the party after their employment tests.
text: Claire Bouchard Highport Operations Manager Overview Claire Bouchard manages Highport operations for [[Transstar]] at Port Sainte Jeanne, coordinating thousands of arrivals and departures every week. She has a reputation for absolute efficiency nothing surprises her, nothing delays her, and nothing intimidates her. She can reroute half a sector's shipping traffic while eating lunch, which makes her one of the most quietly indispensable people in Jardin orbit. Session 3 Claire handled the party's onboarding after the aptitude tests in [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]. She gathered the newly hired group in an HR style room and thanked them for joining [[Transstar]]. Because the system had difficulty reading the party's veiled faces at first, she had them complete a questionnaire and then issued employee badges based on the real faces captured during VR testing. She explained the thirty day open employment window, the later two , four , or six year term options, salary deductions for housing and food, and the practical protection of Transstar employment inside the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. Claire assigned the group to the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] and allowed them to stay together in Emma's executive suite on floor 162 rather than separate housing blocks. Notable For Runs Transstar's Highport traffic at Port Sainte Jeanne. Renowned for unflappable efficiency. Can redirect a sector's worth of shipping single handed. Processed the party under the [[Transstar Employment Contract]]. Connected Pages [[Transstar]] [[Transstar Employment Contract]] [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]

title: Clone Rebirth Program
summary: Platinum 2 continuity system that restores elite officials into prepared clone bodies after public death.
text: Clone Rebirth Program Overview The Clone Rebirth Program is an elite Jardinian continuity system used by people with Platinum 2 level security or comparable political, naval, corporate, or government rank. [[Alain Mercier]] describes it during [[Session 5 The Oduya]] after waking in the body recovered from [[Hadal Research Site]]. Participants maintain a prepared clone body that can be awakened after the original body dies. The system is expensive enough to consume a major share of income, and it is reserved for people whose institutional value justifies the cost. Known Process A clone body takes about three weeks of expensive preparation. Bodies are often grown early and kept in a brain dead hypersleep state. When the original dies, memories and identity patterns are uploaded into the prepared body. Clones are checked monthly for genetic drift and replaced if drift or cancerous growth appears. The body must remain the same biological age as the participant; younger body transfers are illegal and treated as criminal immortality. Legal Restriction If a participant dies publicly and the death cannot be explained away, the restored person cannot return to Jardin's surface. Mercier says such people are supposed to be moved directly onto a Navy ship and sent off world. This restriction exists to prevent public unrest over the rich and powerful visibly surviving deaths ordinary citizens cannot. Hadal Connection [[Hadal Research Site]] contained clone bodies, scientific staff, and high status backups divided by class of person political figures, naval officials, and senior Transstar or board level figures were not mixed together. Mercier suspects the Hadal attack may have been a preparation step. If conspirators destroy the backup first, they can later kill the original with no legal or biological return path. SolSec Interest [[SolSec]] can test whether someone is a clone or original through bone growth history, hand structure, fingerprints, genetic identity, and mitochondrial age patterns. The [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] scans Mercier after the Hadal rescue, likely to determine whether he is a valid restored body or part of a fraud. Open Questions Which high ranking backups were destroyed at Hadal? Was the [[Prime Minister Bombing]] possible because a backup had already been destroyed? Did Mercier's prior self hide final evidence before death? Who outside official channels has access to younger body or illegal clone transfer technology?

title: Colette Moreau
summary: President, Liberty Merchants Association at Quartier Sainte-Liberté.
text: Colette Moreau President, Liberty Merchants Association Overview Colette Moreau presides over the Liberty Merchants Association and is one of the most influential civilian leaders in [[Quartier Sainte Liberté]], the capital's neon lit entertainment and data market district. She speaks for the legitimate businesses that keep the quarter running, which in Sainte Liberté means constant negotiation with the [[Jardin Syndicate]] presence that runs the rest of it. Her association is where the district's above board and below board economies quietly meet. Notable For Leads Sainte Liberté's organized merchant interests. Brokers between legitimate trade and Syndicate influence. A civilian power center in a Syndicate shadowed district. Ties [[Quartier Sainte Liberté]] [[Jardin Syndicate]]

title: Colonel Victor Almeida
summary: Commandant, Mech Combat Academy at Fort Robespierre Naval Annex.
text: Colonel Victor Almeida Commandant, Mech Combat Academy Overview Colonel Victor Almeida is Commandant of the Mech Combat Academy at the [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]] and one of the Confederation's foremost experts on walker warfare. A hero among mech pilots, he trains the crews who operate Jardin's combat walkers — the same class of machine the party has already brushed against in the streets of the capital. His graduates crew the war machines a rebellion would have to face. Notable For Leading Confederation authority on walker warfare. Trains Jardin's combat walker crews. Revered among mech pilots. Ties [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]]

title: Commander Lucien Marchand
summary: Director, Orbital Transfer Operations at Fort Robespierre Naval Annex.
text: Commander Lucien Marchand Director, Orbital Transfer Operations Overview Commander Lucien Marchand directs Orbital Transfer Operations at the [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]], controlling military movement between Jardin's surface and orbit. Few officers shape daily operations more, because nothing reaches the fleet or comes down from it without passing through his schedules. For anyone hoping to move off world through military channels, he is both the gatekeeper and the bottleneck. Notable For Controls military surface to orbit movement. A quiet but decisive logistical chokepoint. Gatekeeper of any military off world route. Ties [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]]

title: Commander Sophie Durand
summary: Port Security Directorate at Port Sainte-Jeanne Downport.
text: Commander Sophie Durand Port Security Directorate Overview Commander Sophie Durand of the Port Security Directorate is a veteran investigator known for her relentless pursuit of organized crime at [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]]. The downport is the [[Jardin Syndicate]]'s favorite seam — where forged manifests and quiet berths do their work — which makes Durand the standing obstacle the smugglers plan around. For a party arriving under false identity, she is precisely the wrong person to draw the attention of. Notable For Veteran anti organized crime investigator. The Syndicate's chief obstacle at the downport. A serious danger to travelers using forged papers. Ties [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]] [[Jardin Syndicate]]

title: Commissioner Elise Martin
summary: Directorate of Citizen Integrity at Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony.
text: Commissioner Elise Martin Directorate of Citizen Integrity Overview Commissioner Elise Martin coordinates [[Social Solidarity]] operations within [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]] through its Directorate of Citizen Integrity. Where the customs officers watch cargo and papers, Martin's people watch for ideological and genetic irregularity — the softer, more political layer of the border. An arrival that clears customs cleanly can still be quietly marked by her directorate. Notable For Runs Social Solidarity's presence at the checkpoint. Screens arrivals for ideological and genetic flags. Can mark a traveler who otherwise cleared customs. Ties [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]] [[Social Solidarity]]

title: Commissioner Isabelle Fournier
summary: Chief Commissioner, Exchange Security Bureau at Transstar Sector Exchange.
text: Commissioner Isabelle Fournier Chief Commissioner, Exchange Security Bureau Overview Commissioner Isabelle Fournier heads the Exchange Security Bureau, the corporate police force of the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. She is respected, feared, and — according to official statements — incorruptible. The Exchange is an independent legal entity where Confederation, Imperial, and Hive money all changes hands, so the person who polices its floor holds a quiet leverage over everyone who trades there. (She is not the medical botanist of the same surname at the Closed Gardens.) Notable For Commands the Exchange's corporate police. Officially incorruptible; universally feared. Polices a trading floor where three powers' money meets. Ties [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]

title: Crèche District 14
text: Crèche District 14 "Every Child, A Future." Location Eastern Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne Type State Child Development Arcology Administrative Authority Directorate of Child Development Status Active Population 1.2 Million Children Staff 180,000 Educators, Medical Personnel, and Administrators Nickname District 14 Contents [Overview]( overview) [First Impressions]( first impressions) [Philosophy]( philosophy) [Structure]( structure) [Maisons]( maisons) [Mentors]( mentors) [Education]( education) [Daily Life]( daily life) [The Memory Gardens]( the memory gardens) [Relationship with Biological Parents]( relationship with biological parents) [Public Opinion]( public opinion) [Security]( security) [Notable Locations]( notable locations) [Hall of First Steps]( hall of first steps) [Unity Stadium]( unity stadium) [Garden of Futures]( garden of futures) [The Reflection Pool]( the reflection pool) [Notable Individuals]( notable individuals) [Director Elise Fournier]( director elise fournier) [Mentor Jean Mercier]( mentor jean mercier) [Dr. Amelie Rousseau]( dr amelie rousseau) [What Foreigners Notice]( what foreigners notice) [Rumors]( rumors) [The Lost Maison]( the lost maison) [The Original Children]( the original children) [The Questionnaires]( the questionnaires) Overview Crèche District 14 is one of the largest child development complexes on Jardin. It serves as home, school, community, and developmental center for over a million children from infancy through adolescence. Unlike most societies, children in District 14 are not raised by biological parents. They are raised by the State. To most Jardinese citizens, this is entirely normal. To foreign visitors, it is often deeply unsettling. First Impressions Visitors expecting a grim institution are often surprised. District 14 is beautiful. Clean. Quiet. Orderly. Safe. Children play in parks. Students attend classes. Sports teams practice in open fields. Music drifts from performance halls. Everything appears healthy and happy. That is what makes visitors uncomfortable. Nothing appears wrong. Philosophy District 14 operates under a simple belief No child should be limited by the circumstances of birth. Every child receives Housing Nutrition Medical care Education Psychological support Recreational opportunities The system does not view itself as replacing parents. It views itself as replacing inequality. Structure Children are organized into developmental cohorts called Maisons Houses. Each Maison contains approximately 120 Children 12 Mentors 8 Educational Staff Medical Support Personnel Children remain with the same Maison for years. The House becomes their family. Mentors The closest equivalent to parents. Mentors are highly trained professionals responsible for Emotional development Discipline Guidance Education support Many remain with the same cohort for decades. Former students frequently maintain lifelong relationships with mentors. Education District 14 contains Primary Schools Secondary Schools Technical Academies Arts Programs Athletic Institutes Educational outcomes are among the highest in the Confederation. The district produces Scientists Administrators Military Officers Engineers Artists at remarkable rates. Daily Life Children live structured lives. A typical day includes Education Physical Exercise Community Service Social Development Recreation Schedules are carefully balanced. The goal is not obedience. The goal is optimization. The Memory Gardens The most unusual area of District 14. Every child possesses a personal record archive. Messages from biological parents. Medical records. Academic achievements. Personal milestones. Upon adulthood citizens gain access to these records. For many, this is the first time they learn much about their biological origins. Relationship with Biological Parents Biological parents are not secret. Nor are they central. Most children know Their genetic contributors Their heritage Their family history But these relationships are considered secondary. The Maison is primary. Public Opinion Most Jardinese consider District 14 a success. Supporters point to Low crime Excellent education Social equality High productivity Critics argue that something important has been lost. Most struggle to define exactly what. Security District 14 maintains its own branch of Social Solidarity. Officers are rarely seen. Problems are usually addressed long before force becomes necessary. Visitors often describe the district as "The safest place on the planet." Notable Locations Hall of First Steps Infant development center. Every citizen of District 14 begins here. Unity Stadium Largest youth athletics facility on Jardin. Garden of Futures A massive public park where graduation ceremonies occur. The Reflection Pool A quiet memorial dedicated to former students. Notable Individuals [[Director Elise Fournier]] Administrator of District 14. Widely respected. Known throughout Jardin as "The Mother of a Million." [[Mentor Jean Mercier]] One of the oldest serving mentors. Three generations of graduates have passed through his Maison. [[Dr. Amelie Rousseau]] Chief Developmental Psychologist. Her research shapes educational policy across Jardin. What Foreigners Notice Visitors usually report three things 1. The children appear remarkably confident. 2. The children appear unusually independent. 3. The children rarely speak about parents. The third observation is usually the one that stays with them. Rumors The Lost Maison A House that supposedly disappeared from official records decades ago. The Original Children Records of the first generation raised under the Perfection System remain sealed. The Questionnaires Every child completes extensive annual assessments. Conspiracy theorists claim these evaluations serve purposes beyond education. gm Referee Notes District 14 should never feel like an orphanage. It should feel like a society that genuinely believes it has solved childhood. Visitors should leave asking themselves "The children seem happy." And then immediately wondering "So why does this place make me uncomfortable?"

title: Crew of TSS Profondeur
summary: Small Transstar submersible crew operating the TSS Profondeur during the Aquatic Salvage Project.
text: Crew of TSS Profondeur Public Face The crew of the [[TSS Profondeur]] is the small Transstar team assigned to run the party's first [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] shift. They are experienced, practical, and used to undersea operations, but the vessel is notably under crewed after experienced hands were shifted elsewhere. [[Etienne Valcourt]] captain and pilot. [[Maelle Fournier]] engineer and damage control specialist. [[Remi Beauchamp]] sonar, sensors, electronics, and communications specialist. [[Sabine Caron]] security and diving operations lead. Relationships The crew treats the party as temporary Transstar workers until the group proves useful during the [[Hadal Research Site]] rescue. Valcourt especially respects the successful rescue attempt, even though the result creates a serious political and legal problem. During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], Valcourt accepts Emma's confidential argument that helping the party reach the [[Sunken Ship Boat]] may serve Transstar's interests and solve the restored [[Alain Mercier]] problem. The Profondeur later supports the recovery of [[Oduya]] by delivering the party, supplying oxygen, and drawing away an approaching craft. Secrets gm Known concerns and mysteries Previous Profondeur rescue logs are scrubbed or incomplete. The ship has hidden energy weapons logged as welders. Experienced crew were split off to train another vessel before the Hadal mission. Valcourt may know more about Transstar's prior undersea work than he has said aloud.

Checkpoint Harmony is the primary entry point into Jardin. Every traveler entering the planet through Port Sainte Jeanne eventually passes through its halls. For most visitors the experience is efficient, professional, and surprisingly polite. For others it is one of the most stressful experiences of their lives. The checkpoint serves as the intersection between Social Solidarity Customs Authority SolSec Transstar The Hall of Chosen Futures Every traveler is recorded. Every declaration is logged. Every arrival becomes part of the system. As many Jardinese officials proudly state "A secure society begins with knowing who enters it." First Impressions The checkpoint resembles a modern airport terminal scaled to impossible proportions. Visitors encounter Massive arrival halls Automated processing systems Biometric scanners Citizen service kiosks Customs inspection zones The atmosphere is calm. Almost too calm. Announcements are soft. Queues move quickly. Officers remain polite. Nobody raises their voice. Yet every traveler senses they are being observed. Because they are. Architecture The facility was intentionally designed to project confidence rather than intimidation. Features include White stone architecture Indoor gardens Natural lighting systems Public art displays Quiet processing areas Government planners wanted arrivals to feel welcomed. The extensive security measures remain largely hidden from view. Primary Divisions Immigration Processing Hall The largest section of the facility. Handles Visitor entry permits Residency applications Work authorizations Colonial transfers Most travelers spend less than thirty minutes here. Most. Citizen Services Bureau Dedicated to Jardinese citizens. Provides Identity updates Travel registrations Repatriation services Documentation support Returning citizens are often directed here before being allowed to proceed. Customs Inspection Complex Responsible for Cargo inspections Contraband detection Duty collection Import certification The Customs Bureau possesses a reputation for thoroughness. Smugglers possess other descriptions. Biosecurity Division Protects Jardin from Disease vectors Agricultural contamination Biological hazards The division maintains quarantine facilities capable of isolating thousands of travelers. Visitor Orientation Center Provides information regarding Local laws Social expectations Cultural customs Restricted activities Many visitors later admit they should have paid closer attention. Social Solidarity Presence The checkpoint falls under the authority of the Directorate of Citizen Integrity . Their responsibilities include Identity verification Travel monitoring Population records Immigration review Officers are generally courteous. They also have access to more information than most travelers realize. SolSec Liaison Office A permanent SolSec office operates within the checkpoint. Official responsibilities include Counterintelligence Counterterrorism Security investigations Most travelers never interact with SolSec. Those who do generally remember the experience. The Arrival Assessment One of the facility's most unusual procedures. Visitors are often asked seemingly harmless questions regarding Travel plans Employment Personal interests Educational background The process feels conversational. Many travelers later discover the information was far more valuable than they realized. Processing Categories Green Channel Low risk travelers. Fast processing. Minimal review. Blue Channel Routine review. Additional verification. Most visitors fall into this category. Silver Channel Enhanced screening. Usually associated with Foreign government officials Corporate executives Intelligence concerns Red Channel Restricted access. Few travelers ever see it. Fewer discuss it afterward. Notable Locations Hall of Welcome The first chamber encountered by arriving visitors. Contains Information kiosks Currency exchanges Transportation services The Registry Atrium Where identity records are verified and updated. Connected directly to systems maintained by the Hall of Chosen Futures. Observation Gallery An elevated monitoring center overlooking the facility. Closed to the public. Quarantine Annex Biosecurity facility located beneath the main complex. Most travelers never know it exists. Notable Individuals [[Director Simone Laurent]] Chief Administrator Responsible for overall operations. Known for exceptional efficiency. [[Inspector Gabriel Rousseau]] Senior Customs Officer A legend among anti smuggling investigators. [[Commissioner Elise Martin]] Directorate of Citizen Integrity Coordinates Social Solidarity operations within the facility. [[Agent Luc Deschamps]] SolSec Liaison Officer Officially responsible for interagency coordination. Unofficially responsible for many other things. Public Reputation Most Jardinese citizens appreciate the checkpoint. They view it as Professional Efficient Necessary Foreign visitors often describe it differently. Common observations include Surprisingly polite Extremely thorough Unsettlingly organized Rumors The Forgotten Traveler A visitor allegedly entered the checkpoint decades ago and was never seen leaving. No records exist. The Hidden Registry A classified database beneath the facility contains information unavailable even to the Hall of Chosen Futures. The Watch List Certain names automatically trigger responses from multiple government agencies. No one knows how many names are included. The Silent Room A secure interview chamber rumored to be jointly operated by Social Solidarity and SolSec. Officially it does not exist. Adventure Hooks Missing Passenger A traveler disappears somewhere inside the checkpoint. Smuggled Data A courier attempts to bring sensitive information onto Jardin. False Identity A visitor arrives carrying perfectly forged documents. Quarantine Alert An arriving vessel triggers emergency biosecurity protocols. SolSec Request An agent asks the Travellers to discreetly observe a newly arrived passenger. The Red Channel A routine arrival is unexpectedly redirected into the facility's most restricted processing area. gm Referee Notes The Checkpoint should not feel oppressive. It should feel inevitable. Nobody shouts. Nobody threatens. Nobody waves weapons. Instead the system quietly knows Who you are. Where you came from. Why you arrived. Where you are going. The true power of the checkpoint is not force. It is information. For most visitors, passing through the Gate is routine. For those carrying secrets, it can be one of the most dangerous places on Jardin.

title: Dan Araujo (Josh)
text: Dan Araujo (Josh) ![Dan Araujo portrait](/wiki/media/Dan Araujo.png) Solomani Racial • Confederation Navy Technical Player Josh Age 34 Species Solomani Racial Gender Male UPP STR 7, DEX 12, END 8, INT 14, EDU 12, SOC 12 Hits 25 Armour Cloth (TL10), Protection 8 Cash Cr250 Ship Shares 6 Profile Dan Araujo is a sharp minded, well connected Solomani Confederation citizen who spent four terms in the Confederation Navy technical branch, leaving as a Petty Officer 1st Class. His career emphasizes engineering, investigation, and shipboard technical competence. Notable Skills Engineer (J drive) 3, Mechanic 2, Investigate 2, Vacc Suit 2, Astrogation 1, Diplomat 1, Electronics (Remote Ops) 1, Engineer (M drive) 1, Gunner (Screen) 1, Language (Trokh) 1, Leadership 1, Medic 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Recon 1, Tactics (Naval) 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Initially leaned toward compliance with authorities after the [[Mercier Assassination]], trusting that he had done nothing wrong. Stayed with the group as the containment broke into violence and escape. After reaching the hideout, repaired [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] after the walker descent. Focused on tangible technical work rather than drawing attention through risky computer searches. Session 2 Masks and Markers Joined the Sainte Liberte supply team. Helped secure a repair kit that should provide bonuses on the next few repair attempts. Spoke with [[Lucin]] and helped turn the supply run into a data broker contact. Became surprisingly enthusiastic about doing "criminal" work well, while still insisting he is not a criminal by nature. Supported the Lucin delivery plan as a way to gain a vehicle and a possible underworld information channel. Helped complete the daylight crate delivery from [[Les Jardins Fermés]] to [[Chief Helene Marchand]]'s secured residence. title: Director Elise Fournier
summary: Administrator of District 14 at Crèche District 14.
text: Director Elise Fournier Administrator of District 14 Overview Director Elise Fournier administers [[Crèche District 14]], one of the state creche districts where Jardin raises children communally under the Perfection System. Widely respected and known across the world as "the Mother of a Million," she embodies the system's gentlest and most sincerely believed face. That a single administrator can be a household name says how central state child rearing is to Jardin's idea of itself. (She shares a surname, not an identity, with the Gardens botanist and the Social Solidarity director general.) Notable For Administers a full state creche district. Known planet wide as "the Mother of a Million." The sympathetic public face of the Perfection System. Ties [[Crèche District 14]]

title: Director-General Camille Fournier
summary: Head of the Ministry of Social Solidarity.
text: Director General Camille Fournier Head of the Ministry of Social Solidarity Overview Director General Camille Fournier is the current head of the Ministry of [[Social Solidarity]], Jardin's internal security and social management apparatus. A career administrator and loyal supporter of the Perfection System, she now runs the ministry that Supreme President [[Leo Duprey]] himself once led. Commanding the machinery of surveillance, assessment, and "civic harmony" makes her one of the most quietly powerful figures on the planet. (She shares only a surname with the scientists of the same name.) Notable For Runs Jardin's internal security ministry. Inherited the ministry Duprey once led. Commands surveillance, assessment, and civic harmony operations. Ties [[Social Solidarity]] [[Leo Duprey]]

title: Director Luc Beaumont
summary: Port Authority Director at Port Sainte-Jeanne Downport.
text: Director Luc Beaumont Port Authority Director Overview Director Luc Beaumont runs the Port Authority at [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]], overseeing the largest transportation facility on Jardin. Pragmatic and politically skilled, he keeps cargo, passengers, and naval traffic moving through the world's primary gateway while managing the competing demands of customs, the Navy, and [[Social Solidarity]]. Everything that enters or leaves Jardin by the front door passes, in some sense, through his office. Notable For Runs Jardin's primary downport. Balances customs, naval, and security interests. Controls the world's main point of arrival and departure. Ties [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]]

title: Director Simone Laurent
summary: Chief Administrator, Checkpoint Harmony at Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony.
text: Director Simone Laurent Chief Administrator, Checkpoint Harmony Overview Director Simone Laurent is Chief Administrator of [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]], responsible for its overall operation and known for exceptional efficiency. The checkpoint is where arrivals are sorted, assessed, and — where necessary — quietly flagged, and Laurent keeps that machine running smoothly. Efficiency at a border like Harmony is not a neutral virtue it means fewer people slip through unnoticed. Notable For Runs Jardin's principal arrival checkpoint. Prized for administrative efficiency. Her smooth operation means fewer travelers pass unscreened. Ties [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]]

title: Dolphin Extremists
summary: Earlier Transstar label for aquatic opposition later clarified as broader undersea extremists.
text: Dolphin Extremists Overview Transstar first describes the opposition to the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] as rogue dolphin extremists. In [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]], the briefing clarifies that the threat is broader and better tracked as [[Undersea Extremists]] humanoids and orcas using cybernetic rigs, explosive harpoons, and deep sea tactics. Known From Session 3 During onboarding, [[Claire Bouchard]] explains that Transstar needs military support because dolphin extremists are trying to stop the company's salvage techniques. Transstar does not care whether the group is killed, scared off, or otherwise neutralized, as long as corporate losses stop. Session 4 Clarification The Profondeur crew describes attackers who include orcas capable of transporting cargo internally, cybernetically enhanced leaders strong enough to rip metal, and explosive micro harpoon weapons dangerous to suits and hulls. Open Questions Was "dolphin extremists" a simplification, propaganda label, or genuine mistake? What are the undersea attackers trying to prevent at [[Hadal Research Site]]? Are they connected to any prior aquatic rumors or the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]? Can they become allies instead of enemies?

title: Dr. Amelie Rousseau
summary: Chief Developmental Psychologist at Crèche District 14.
text: Dr. Amelie Rousseau Chief Developmental Psychologist Overview Dr. Amelie Rousseau is Chief Developmental Psychologist for [[Crèche District 14]], and her research shapes educational policy across Jardin. She studies how the state's communally raised children develop, and her findings feed directly back into how the next cohort is taught. In a system that treats child rearing as an engineering problem, she is one of the engineers. Notable For Her research drives Jardin wide educational policy. Studies the outcomes of communal child rearing. Helps engineer how each new cohort is raised. Ties [[Crèche District 14]]

title: Dr. Gabriel Laurent
summary: Director of Xenobiology at Les Jardins Fermés.
text: Dr. Gabriel Laurent Director of Xenobiology Overview Dr. Gabriel Laurent directs Xenobiology at [[Les Jardins Fermés]] and rarely appears in public. His work inside Dome Nine — the Xenobiological Annex — has generated considerable speculation, none of it confirmed. On a world already nervous about what the Ministry of Genetics knows, a xenobiologist who never explains himself is exactly the sort of figure rumors accrete to. Notable For Runs the secretive Dome Nine xenobiology program. Almost never appears publicly. The subject of persistent, unconfirmed speculation. Ties [[Les Jardins Fermés]]

title: Dr. Isabelle Fournier
summary: Director of Medical Botany at Les Jardins Fermés.
text: Dr. Isabelle Fournier Director of Medical Botany Overview Dr. Isabelle Fournier directs Medical Botany at [[Les Jardins Fermés]] and is responsible for multiple breakthrough therapies drawn from the Gardens' living pharmacopeia. Her medical achievements have made her a popular public figure, one of the few faces of the Closed Gardens that ordinary citizens actually trust. That goodwill is politically valuable to an institution whose deeper work is anything but public. Notable For Developed several breakthrough medical therapies. A rare publicly trusted face of the Closed Gardens. Her reputation lends the Gardens political cover. Ties [[Les Jardins Fermés]]

title: Dr. Luc Moreau
summary: Nervous Hall scientist who tried to move Mercier-linked data out through a mobile pipe courier.
text: Dr. Luc Moreau Overview Dr. Luc Moreau is a scientist or technical researcher at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]]. During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], the party saw him leave a secured floor looking anxious and enter a public bathroom despite presumably having access to facilities on his own floor. Session 2 Moreau placed a data stick into a [[Mobile Data Tube]], typed a warning message on an arm computer, put the tube in the toilet, and flushed it. The message said this was the last time he would pass information, that Mercier was obviously killed for the data given to him, and that the recipient should lose his number. Zoy and Cass recovered the tube before it escaped through the plumbing. Emma disarmed its destructive charge and preserved the data chip, which contained part of the [[Mercier Genetic Findings]]. Open Questions Was Moreau one of Mercier's sources? Who was supposed to receive the data tube? Is Moreau still alive, missing, or under Social Solidarity watch? Does he know the uncorrupted conclusion of the genetic marker file?

title: Dr. Sophie Delacroix
summary: Director-General of the Gardens at Les Jardins Fermés.
text: Dr. Sophie Delacroix Director General of the Gardens Overview Dr. Sophie Delacroix is Director General of [[Les Jardins Fermés]], the sealed biological research complex the Ministry of Genetics runs at the heart of Jardin's Perfection System. Regarded as one of the leading scientific minds in the Confederation, she is consulted directly by both Supreme President [[Leo Duprey]] and — until his death — Minister [[Alain Mercier]]. Overseeing the domes where Jardin's most sensitive genetic work is done places her uncomfortably close to whatever Mercier was about to reveal. Notable For Runs the Closed Gardens research complex. Advises the Supreme President and the late Minister of Genetics. Positioned near the center of the Mercier genetic controversy. Ties [[Les Jardins Fermés]] [[Leo Duprey]] [[Alain Mercier]]
