title: Elena Kovacs
summary: Taj Mahal Class Purser at Transstar.
text: Elena Kovacs Taj Mahal Class Purser Overview Elena Kovacs is a purser on [[Transstar]]'s Taj Mahal class liner SS Nouvelle Aube, overseeing high passage travel for billionaires, admirals, diplomats, and celebrities without breaking a sweat. She possesses enough overheard gossip to destabilize several governments, all of it gathered from passengers who assumed a purser wasn't listening. Her discretion is worth more to Transstar than the fares. Notable For Manages luxury high passage aboard the Nouvelle Aube. Holds a fortune in overheard elite gossip. Her discretion is a corporate asset in itself. Ties [[Transstar]]

title: Elena Verona
summary: Social Solidarity commissar who responded to the Mercier assassination scene and survived the group's escape.
text: Elena Verona Overview Elena Verona is a commissar of [[Social Solidarity]] who arrived at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] after the [[Mercier Assassination]]. The transcript first presents her over the speakers as "Elena Verona, Commissar of Social Solidarity," though later table speech also calls her Alina. The spelling should be reviewed. Verona attempted to calm and contain the scene while Home Guard forces surrounded the characters. After Emma opened fire, Verona was wounded, grappled by [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]], and left unconscious during the escape. Appears In [[Session 1 Official Business]] [[Mercier Frame Up]] Equipment and Assets Social Solidarity uniform. Sidearm. Computerized belt identified as a one use grav belt. Radio/earpiece. Its communication channel produced unusual hiss or interference. Notes Public broadcasts later used Verona as a harmed witness. She survived the escape, making her testimony a major risk. The group debated killing her but did not do so in the transcript.

title: Emma Colbert (Laura)
text: Emma Colbert (Laura) ![Emma Colbert portrait](/wiki/media/Emma Colbert.jpg) Solomani Racial • SolSec Secret Agent Player Laura Age 38 Species Solomani Racial Gender Female UPP STR 7, DEX 10, END 9, INT 14, EDU 15, SOC 10 Hits 24 Armour Protec Suit; Cloth Trench Coat, Protection 10 Ship Shares 2 Profile Emma Colbert is a Solomani Confederation citizen who spent five terms in SolSec as a Secret Agent, rising through field and command work. Her sheet emphasizes informant networks, social leverage, intelligence operations, and a wide spread of civilian, military, corporate, criminal, and diplomatic contacts. Notable Skills Broker 2, Carouse 2, Deception 2, Electronics (Comms) 2, Persuade 2, Advocate 1, Electronics (Computers) 1, Electronics (Sensors) 1, Gun Combat (Slug) 1, Gunner (Turret) 1, Medic 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Science (Psychology) 1, Stealth 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Maintained cover during the initial response to the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Received a critical warning through an attached/cybernetic computer setup that the authorities intended to kill the group. Opened fire on a Home Guard guard, triggering the group's active escape. Provided or had access to a safe warehouse with shower and stored food where the group could regroup. Held or was trusted with [[Marcel Delphine]]'s one use communicator. Session 3 Transstar Day Argued for using [[Lucin]] to deliver the Mercier evidence to [[Inspector Marc Valois]] without exposing the party directly. Entered the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] with the first group and excelled on the executive employment track. Became a Transstar division level executive, allowing the party to stay together in her assigned suite. Accepted the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] assignment as the group's first corporate shelter and work cover. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Reported aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]] as the party's executive presence. Trained on communications and sensors, then discovered a hidden encrypted [[Jardinian Naval SOS]]. Recognized the signal as military grade and connected it to living personnel at an attacked location. Passed the SOS to [[Sabine Caron]] as an outside interception while keeping the source less obvious. Understood the [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]]'s hand and bone growth scan as a test for genetic identity, alteration, or cloning. Urged the party away from poking, killing, or unnecessarily escalating around the survivor. Session 5 The Oduya Went with [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] into [[Alain Mercier]]'s medical room at [[Undersea Base Elyon]]. Used deception to clear nearby medical staff without creating an obvious security incident. Tried to access Mercier's medical chart and listened closely as he explained the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. Pressed Mercier on whether Hadal's destruction could have targeted clone backups before a future assassination. Persuaded Captain [[Etienne Valcourt]] to divert the [[TSS Profondeur]] toward the [[Sunken Ship Boat]] under Transstar rescue/evidence cover. Helped with vac suit checks, computer work, and piloting support during the recovery of [[Oduya]]. Identified [[Anita Singh]] as a contact to fence illegal cybernetics into repair services and [[Sergey Sun]] as a contact to help move Mercier. Contacted [[Nico Gay]], a smuggler contact, and learned more about [[Marcel Delphine]], the [[Jardin Syndicate]], and the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] as a potential refuge. Retained a recording of the "kill them all" warning/order. Session 2 Masks and Markers Joined the recon team returning to the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] under an [[Identity Veils|Identity Veil]]. Recognized [[Inspector Marc Valois]], a SolSec investigator tied to genetic and alien biology crimes. Observed that [[Social Solidarity]] was actively blocking [[SolSec]] access to the assassination scene. Intercepted outgoing phone data from the Hall and set up a limited comms tap forwarding calls to a server she may be able to access. Helped secure and disarm the [[Mobile Data Tube]], preserving the data chip inside. Interpreted the recovered [[Mercier Genetic Findings]], including markers HX 14, SC 9, MY22, and PX 4. Suggested checking the party's own genetic records to see whether any of them carry the recovered markers. Emma has an extensive SolSec contact network including Captain Anna Pereira, Christine Hernandez, Anita Hussain, Nancy Wang, Anita Singh, Sergey Sun, Captain Irina Lal, Sergeant Andrea Jin, Lieutenant Robert Rodriguez, Pedro He, Secretary Daniel Garcia, Luis Zhang, Laura Yuan, Nainod, Fatima Yu, Mayer Meeks, and a compartmentalized Marc Duncan bureaucracy contact. Equipment & Benefits Protec Suit, Cloth Trench Coat, Officer's Revolver, SolSec Wafer Jack, SC Courier, Body Camera, Radio Jammer, Neural Comm Basic, Satellite Uplink, Mobile Comm Advanced, 2 ship shares. gm Import Notes Imported from Foundry actor export fvtt Actor emma colbert (laura) fAhaECjHXSjH01V1 (2).json .

Observed that [[Social Solidarity]] was actively blocking [[SolSec]] access to the assassination scene. Intercepted outgoing phone data from the Hall and set up a limited comms tap forwarding calls to a server she may be able to access. Helped secure and disarm the [[Mobile Data Tube]], preserving the data chip inside. Interpreted the recovered [[Mercier Genetic Findings]], including markers HX 14, SC 9, MY22, and PX 4. Suggested checking the party's own genetic records to see whether any of them carry the recovered markers. Emma has an extensive SolSec contact network including Captain Anna Pereira, Christine Hernandez, Anita Hussain, Nancy Wang, Anita Singh, Sergey Sun, Captain Irina Lal, Sergeant Andrea Jin, Lieutenant Robert Rodriguez, Pedro He, Secretary Daniel Garcia, Luis Zhang, Laura Yuan, Nainod, Fatima Yu, Mayer Meeks, and a compartmentalized Marc Duncan bureaucracy contact. title: Étienne Marchand
summary: Customs Commissioner at Port Sainte-Jeanne Downport.
text: Étienne Marchand Customs Commissioner Overview Étienne Marchand is Customs Commissioner at [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]] — a nightmare for smugglers and a hero to accountants. He enforces the identity and cargo controls that make leaving Jardin directly so difficult, the very controls that have stranded more than one traveler without clean papers. His bureau's scanners are the wall that any off world escape has to get over. (He is unrelated to Chief of Staff [[Chief Helene Marchand]].) Notable For Enforces the downport's strict identity and cargo controls. A dreaded figure among smugglers. His scanners are a direct obstacle to off world escape. Ties [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]]

title: Étienne Moreau
summary: Regional Director, Jardin Subsector at Transstar.
text: Étienne Moreau Regional Director, Jardin Subsector Overview Étienne Moreau is [[Transstar]]'s Regional Director for the Jardin Subsector and the senior Transstar executive on the ground. Polished, intelligent, and politically connected, he views transportation as the nervous system of civilization and genuinely believes Transstar holds the Confederation together. Some expect his next move to be a Ministry of Economics post; others are convinced he already answers to [[SolSec]]. No one is entirely certain, which is exactly how a man in his position stays useful. Notable For Senior Transstar executive in the subsector. Politically wired into the Confederation elite. Rumored to already work for SolSec. Ties [[Transstar]] [[SolSec]]

title: Étienne Valcourt
summary: Captain and pilot of the TSS Profondeur; former Jardin Navy
text: Étienne Valcourt ![Étienne Valcourt portrait](/wiki/media/Etienne Valcourt.png) Captain / Pilot Overview Étienne Valcourt is the captain and pilot of the [[TSS Profondeur]]. He spent roughly twenty years in the Jardin Navy, specializing in submersible operations and platform work, before taking a Transstar opportunity between promotion cycles. Valcourt treats the party as useful crew if they prove they can work, learn, and avoid self destruction. He is direct about risk, pressure, and shipboard utility, but he honors the party's rescue attempt at [[Hadal Research Site]]. Session 4 Valcourt introduces the Profondeur and its senior crew, assigns the party into training roles, and explains the Hadal salvage mission. After the party rescues a Jardin Navy survivor from the sealed Hadal dome, he diverts to [[Undersea Base Elyon]]. In the crew mess, Valcourt points out the contradiction Hadal was a Transstar research facility, yet every corpse and the lone survivor recovered from the sealed room wore Jardin Navy uniforms. Session 5 Valcourt refuels and re equips the [[TSS Profondeur]] at [[Undersea Base Elyon]] after the Hadal rescue. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] privately briefs him on the legal problem surrounding restored [[Alain Mercier]] and persuades him to divert toward the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]. Valcourt agrees to frame the run as continued rescue and evidence hunting work. During the recovery of [[Oduya]], he keeps the Profondeur moving and acts as a decoy when an unidentified small craft approaches the salvage site. Open Questions How much does Valcourt know about previous Transstar rescue operations? Is he quietly helping the party investigate, or simply protecting his ship? How much risk will he accept now that the party has used his ship to raise [[Oduya]]?

title: False News Broadcast
summary: A fabricated broadcast blamed Mercier's murder on genetic outcasts and falsely showed Zoy attacking the minister.
text: False News Broadcast Overview Within hours of the [[Mercier Assassination]], public news reported a terrorist attack at the Hall of Continuity and claimed that Minister [[Alain Mercier]] had been killed by genetic "half breeds." The report showed fake footage of [[Zoy (Damon)]] throwing a grenade at Mercier. The broadcast also presented [[Elena Verona]] as a harmed witness and claimed the group killed Mercier's bodyguards. Confirmed False Elements Zoy did not throw a grenade at Mercier in the transcript. Mercier was killed by gunfire linked to the frame up, not by a grenade. The story conceals the fact that the group's weapons appeared to be manipulated or spoofed. Uses Publicly brands the group as terrorists. Links the case to genetic purity politics. Gives authorities justification to hunt the group and possibly crack down on the [[Jardin Syndicate]] or other genetically disfavored populations.

Hangar]( the black hangar) Overview Fort Robespierre Naval Annex is the military heart of Jardin. While the public sees the Palace of Continuity as the center of political power and the Hall of Chosen Futures as the center of social planning, military officers understand that true power often resides elsewhere. It resides at Fort Robespierre. The Annex serves as Headquarters for major naval forces assigned to Jardin Training center for Confederation Marines Primary mech warfare academy in the subsector Strategic logistics hub Surface transportation center for orbital naval facilities Every day thousands of personnel move between the Annex and the massive military stations orbiting above Jardin. The facility never closes. Warships must always remain ready. History Origins Fort Robespierre traces its roots to the period before Solomani intervention. The original fortress was constructed during Jardin's expansionist era and served as headquarters for military operations against neighboring systems. Following Jardin's defeat, the facility was seized and reorganized by Confederation authorities. Rather than dismantle the military infrastructure, the Solomani Party expanded it. Over time the Fort became one of the most important naval installations in the Solomani Front. The Rim War Era During the Solomani Rim War the Annex operated continuously. The facility trained Marines Fleet crews Pilots Logistics specialists Entire generations of veterans passed through its gates. Many monuments throughout the complex commemorate units destroyed during the war. Modern Role Today Fort Robespierre acts as both military headquarters and training institution. The installation's influence extends throughout the subsector. Many senior naval officers began their careers here. First Impressions The Fort feels fundamentally different from the rest of Jardin. Visitors encounter Precision Discipline Purpose Every movement appears organized. Every building serves a function. Even the landscaping feels tactical. This is not a place designed to impress politicians. It is designed to prepare for war. Layout The Annex occupies hundreds of square kilometers of coastline and inland training territory. Major districts include Naval Command Citadel The headquarters of military operations on Jardin. Contains Fleet command centers Strategic planning offices Intelligence sections Communications arrays This is where regional naval operations are coordinated. Marine Training Grounds The largest military training area on Jardin. Facilities include Urban combat zones Live fire ranges Boarding simulators Atmospheric assault courses Thousands of marines train here every year. Mech Combat Academy One of the most famous institutions on the planet. Responsible for Walker operations Powered armor tactics Combined arms doctrine Urban warfare training Pilots from throughout the Confederation compete for admission. Graduates are highly respected. Vehicle Development Range Testing area for Tanks Walkers Combat drones Experimental vehicles New military designs are frequently evaluated here. Explosions are common. Orbital Transfer Complex The busiest military transportation hub on Jardin. Serves as the primary connection between Surface facilities Orbital stations Fleet anchorages Personnel transfer continuously between the Fort and orbit. Most naval officers spend considerable time here. Fleet Logistics Center Handles Munitions Spare parts Fuel supplies Vehicle maintenance One of the largest military warehouses in the subsector. Orbital Facilities The Annex itself does not house major warships. Those vessels remain in orbit. Instead the Fort serves as the surface support facility for Robespierre Fleet Anchorage Massive orbital station supporting Destroyers Cruisers Fleet auxiliaries Assault transports Marine Orbital Barracks Housing and deployment center for marine forces. Strategic Reserve Yards Storage facilities containing reserve vessels and emergency supplies. Military Culture Fort Robespierre produces officers with a distinctive reputation. Traits commonly associated with graduates include Discipline Aggressiveness Professionalism Political reliability Critics occasionally add Arrogance The graduates generally do not disagree. Security Security is among the strictest on Jardin. Organizations present include Naval Security Command Primary military police force. Responsible for Internal investigations Base security Criminal enforcement Marine Provost Corps Handles discipline among marine units. Feared throughout the installation. SolSec Military Liaison Office Maintains oversight regarding Espionage Treason Strategic intelligence Social Solidarity Military Affairs Bureau Ensures continued political reliability among personnel. Its presence is often resented. Relationship with Other Institutions Palace of Continuity Officially subordinate. Unofficially influential. Many officers believe politicians underestimate military realities. Social Solidarity A necessary relationship. Not always a comfortable one. Transstar Maintains extensive logistics contracts with the military. Many supplies pass through Transstar networks. Notable Landmarks Hall of Heroes Massive memorial honoring fallen servicemen and women. Every graduating class visits. Victory Square Site of military parades and public ceremonies. The Iron Gate The ceremonial entrance to the installation. Named after the Iron Gate naval expansion program. Marshal Cartier Academy Prestigious officer training institution. Named after Marine Cartier. Notable Individuals [[Admiral Henri Duval]] Commander, Jardin Naval Command Senior naval officer assigned to the system. A strong advocate for expanding naval power in the Solomani Front. [[General Claire Moreau]] Commander, Marine Forces Jardin Responsible for all marine training and deployment operations. Widely respected by frontline personnel. [[Colonel Victor Almeida]] Commandant, Mech Combat Academy One of the Confederation's foremost experts on walker warfare. A hero among mech pilots. [[Commander Lucien Marchand]] Director, Orbital Transfer Operations Controls military transportation between surface and orbit. Few officers influence daily operations more. Public Reputation Citizens generally view the Fort favorably. Supporters see it as A source of security A source of employment A symbol of national pride Critics worry about its growing political influence. Military officers tend to dismiss such concerns. Rumors The Deep Vault A classified facility beneath the Annex contains military technology recovered from pre Confederation ruins. Project Bastion An experimental walker program is operating under extreme secrecy. The Lost Regiment Records indicate an entire marine regiment disappeared during the Rim War. Official histories never mention them. The Black Hangar A secure aerospace facility receives unidentified vessels under heavy guard. No official explanation exists. Adventure Hooks Missing Prototype An experimental combat walker disappears during field testing. Marine Investigation A recruit dies under suspicious circumstances during training. Orbital Emergency A military transport fails while transferring personnel to orbit. Classified Cargo The Travellers are assigned to escort sensitive equipment through the Annex. Fleet Exercise A training operation uncovers evidence of sabotage. The Black Hangar A SolSec contact requests assistance investigating rumors surrounding a secret aerospace project. gm Referee Notes Fort Robespierre should feel like the martial soul of Jardin. The Palace governs. The Hall plans. The Gardens study. Social Solidarity enforces. Transstar enriches. The Fort prepares for war. This is where the Confederation's ideals become military doctrine and where the next generation of officers, marines, and mech pilots learn how to defend the Solomani Cause. For military characters, Fort Robespierre should feel like home. For civilians, it should feel slightly intimidating. For enemies of Jardin, it should feel dangerous.

title: Friday Party Congress Hearing
summary: Upcoming internal hearing where contacts may reveal who is shaping the official story after Mercier's death.
text: Friday Party Congress Hearing Overview The Friday Party Congress hearing is expected two days after the [[Mercier Assassination]]. [[Alain Mercier]] had planned to reveal his findings there before he was killed. [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] contacted a trusted ally to listen from inside the hearing and report who speaks, what story is told, and which political players are involved. Why It Matters Mercier's intended presentation may still shape the agenda. The official story may reveal who benefits from the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. Names and arguments raised at the hearing could point toward the faction or individual who silenced Mercier. Open Questions Will Mercier's actual findings be suppressed, altered, or replaced? Who will speak for the official investigation? Will the [[Jardin Syndicate]] be blamed directly? Will the player characters be publicly named as an assassin cell?

title: Hadal Research Site
summary: Damaged Transstar undersea research facility attacked before the party's first salvage mission.
text: Hadal Research Site ![Hadal undersea operations map](/wiki/media/Hadal Undersea Map.png) Overview Hadal Research Site is a damaged Transstar undersea research facility assigned as the party's first salvage target aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. It was abandoned after an attack by [[Undersea Extremists]] several weeks before [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]]. Known Details The site has five domes. Three domes are broken open. Two damaged domes still hold oxygen. One power station remains active and feeds a load consistent with life support, computers, or air filtration. At least one airlock was blown apart by underwater explosives. A sealed chamber contained four living survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel. Session 4 The party surveys the site by drone, sensors, and exterior suit work. Rather than immediately breaching a sealed oxygenated section, they build a temporary airlock and attempt a rescue. The rescue recovers four survivors, but only one lives after transfer the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. Salvage Recovered Power generators. Computer equipment. Data cubes. A Seafarer skill chip. Open Questions What research was being conducted at Hadal? Why were Jardin Navy personnel inside a Transstar research site? Who sent the encrypted [[Jardinian Naval SOS]]? Did the attackers know who was trapped inside?

Notes]( session 1 security notes) [Session 2 Aftermath Recon]( session 2 aftermath recon) Overview The Hall des Futurs Choisis (Hall of Chosen Futures) is among the most influential institutions on Jardin and arguably the most important government building outside the Palace of Continuity itself. Officially, the Hall exists to coordinate the scientific, educational, demographic, and civic planning efforts that have guided Jardin's development for centuries. In practice, the Hall serves as the point where government policy intersects with everyday life. Every citizen on Jardin will interact with the Hall repeatedly throughout their lifetime. Birth registrations, educational assessments, citizenship certifications, genetic consultations, robot registrations, family planning permits, immigration reviews, military aptitude evaluations, and countless other services are administered through its vast bureaucracy. For many citizens, the Hall represents the triumph of science and reason over chaos. For many foreigners, it represents something far more unsettling. Public Purpose The Hall's official mission is inscribed above the main entrance "The Future Is Not Found. It Is Built." The institution exists to help citizens make informed decisions that contribute to both personal success and societal prosperity. Government publications describe the Hall as A center of scientific guidance A guardian of public welfare A steward of future generations A repository of civic records A facilitator of social opportunity Critics throughout the Confederation often describe it as A surveillance apparatus A demographic control center A social engineering institution Most citizens reject such characterizations. History Foundation Era The original Hall began as a simple census and population records office during Jardin's first century. As population expanded, government planners discovered that accurate demographic forecasting provided significant economic advantages. Successive administrations gradually expanded the office's authority. What began as a registry evolved into a planning bureau. The planning bureau evolved into a ministry. The ministry eventually became the Hall. The Genetic Reforms The modern Hall emerged during the Genetic Reforms of the sixth century. Advances in biological sciences allowed officials to Predict hereditary disorders Track population trends Improve public health outcomes Guide educational development These programs proved remarkably successful. Life expectancy increased. Crime declined. Educational outcomes improved. The public generally supported further expansion. The Integration Period During the following centuries dozens of independent agencies were merged into the Hall. Functions absorbed included Birth registration Citizenship management Immigration processing Marriage licensing Educational placement Robot registration Population statistics Genetic counseling By the modern era, nearly every major life event passed through the Hall. Architecture The Hall covers nearly four square kilometers and consists of seven interconnected administrative towers surrounding a central civic plaza. Unlike the grandeur of the Palace of Continuity, the Hall was designed to appear approachable. Its architecture emphasizes Transparency Efficiency Accessibility Scientific progress Visitors enter through enormous public atriums filled with Trees Gardens Public art Information kiosks Educational exhibits The atmosphere resembles a university campus more than a government ministry. Only after proceeding deeper into the complex does its true scale become apparent. Major Divisions Citizen Registry Directorate The oldest department within the Hall. Responsible for maintaining records on every legal resident of Jardin. Files contain Birth records Family history Educational records Employment history Military service Citizenship classification Many records extend back generations. Officials proudly describe the Registry as the most complete demographic database in the Confederation. Bureau of Genetic Assessment Perhaps the Hall's most famous department. Provides Genetic screening Health forecasting Hereditary risk analysis Family planning consultation Participation is technically voluntary. Nearly everyone participates. Citizens often view refusing assessment as irresponsible. Directorate of Educational Futures Tracks educational development from childhood through adulthood. Responsibilities include Aptitude testing School placement Scholarship recommendations Professional forecasting Students are not assigned careers. However, guidance recommendations are considered highly reliable. Many citizens follow them. Bureau of Family Development Handles Marriage registrations Family planning consultations Adoption reviews Child development programs This bureau generates much of the Hall's reputation outside Jardin. Imperial media frequently exaggerates its role. In reality, most services remain advisory rather than mandatory. Immigration and Citizenship Authority Responsible for Immigration processing Naturalization Residency permits Foreign worker authorization Every long term visitor eventually encounters this department. Robot Registration Bureau One of the Hall's newer divisions. Every autonomous robot on Jardin must be registered. Records include Ownership Operational classification Maintenance history Intelligence certification Security reviews Visitors arriving with robots are required to register them within seven days. Military grade machines receive additional scrutiny. Unregistered robots can be confiscated. The Citizen Lifecycle A typical citizen may interact with the Hall dozens of times throughout life. Birth Parents register newborns. Genetic records are established. Healthcare recommendations are provided. Childhood Educational assessments begin. Development milestones are recorded. Specialized opportunities are identified. Adolescence Aptitude evaluations occur. Career counseling becomes available. Military and civic service pathways are discussed. Adulthood Marriage registration. Family planning consultation. Professional certifications. Property records. Citizenship updates. Retirement Medical support planning. Historical record preservation. Legacy documentation. Daily Operations Nearly 500,000 people pass through the Hall every week. Despite this volume, waiting times remain remarkably short. Visitors frequently report Professional staff Efficient processing Friendly service Exceptional organization Foreigners often find the experience unnerving. Questions seem prepared before they are asked. Records appear instantly. Appointments begin precisely on schedule. Officials already know what forms are required. Minister Alain Mercier Current Minister of Genetics and director of the Hall. Mercier is widely considered one of the most influential individuals on Jardin. Educated at the National Academy of Biological Sciences, he spent decades overseeing demographic planning initiatives before ascending to ministerial leadership. Supporters view him as A visionary scientist A reformer A defender of evidence based policy Critics accuse him of Excessive technocratic thinking Overreliance on predictive systems Expanding state influence into private life His upcoming presentation at the next Party Congress has generated enormous public interest. Public Opinion Surveys consistently show strong public approval. Citizens commonly cite Efficient services Improved healthcare Better educational outcomes Reduced bureaucracy A common Jardin saying states "The Hall knows where the forms are." Meaning that even complicated problems usually have a solution. Common Sayings "Trust the numbers." Often used when discussing Hall recommendations. "The Hall remembers." Refers to the vast citizen archives. "Everyone visits eventually." A common joke about the institution's reach. "Ask the Hall." Used when seeking official guidance. Security Security is extensive but intentionally discreet. Visible measures include Civil security officers Automated scanners Visitor registration systems Less visible measures include Internal intelligence personnel Data monitoring teams Behavioral analysis systems Counterespionage units The Hall maintains one of the most valuable information repositories in the Confederation. Foreign Visitors Visitors remaining longer than seven days must register. The process is usually straightforward. Typical requirements include Identity verification Ship registration Residence declaration Robot registration Temporary citizen file creation Most visitors complete the process within an hour. Many leave feeling uncomfortable without being entirely certain why. Rumors Numerous rumors surround the Hall. Common stories include The government maintains predictive profiles on every citizen. Secret archives contain centuries of genetic data. Certain future leaders are identified during childhood. The Hall can predict career success with startling accuracy. Hidden departments monitor social stability across the planet. Officials dismiss such stories as exaggerations. gm Classified Information The following information is not publicly known. Project Horizon A classified demographic forecasting initiative operating beneath the Hall. Project Horizon attempts to model Jardin's future decades in advance. Economic, educational, political, and biological data are continuously analyzed. Officially, the project does not exist. Restricted Archives Deep beneath the Hall lies a secure repository containing genetic records dating back centuries. Access is limited to a handful of senior officials. Even many Hall administrators are unaware of its existence. The Mercier Findings Recent research conducted under Minister Alain Mercier has produced highly controversial results. The exact nature of these findings remains unknown. However, rumors have spread throughout government circles that the data may challenge long standing assumptions underlying Jardin's social planning philosophy. Several senior officials reportedly view the upcoming Party Congress with considerable anxiety. Adventure Hooks Missing File A citizen's entire history vanishes from the Registry. Officially this should be impossible. Ghost Citizen Records indicate a person who has never existed. Yet dozens of government databases recognize them. Stolen Genome A classified genetic profile is stolen from the Restricted Archives. Several intelligence agencies become interested. Foreign Defector A Hall researcher seeks passage off world. They claim to possess evidence capable of destabilizing the government. Robot Uprising Thousands of robot registrations suddenly contain identical authorization codes. No one can explain why. The Wrong Future A prominent citizen receives a predictive assessment describing events that have not yet happened. Months later, those events begin occurring. Party Congress The Travellers become entangled in the political fallout surrounding Alain Mercier's long awaited presentation. Session 1 Official Business The player characters were summoned here for administrative reasons tied to genetic status, military records, finances, or autonomous AI review. The process resembled a large bureaucratic office numbers were assigned, people were called in strange orders, and military IDs were checked because many arrived armed. The grouping was suspicious. Too many armed veterans and connected figures were brought together in one area, and several already knew each other from prior service. Shortly after a news broadcast about [[Alain Mercier]] and genetic file corruption, Mercier crossed the office area and was killed in the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Session 1 Security Notes The Hall had cameras throughout the office area. Government workers used bioscans to open secure side doors. [[Home Guard]] and [[Social Solidarity]] personnel responded quickly. A walker/mech later breached the window during the group's escape. Session 2 Aftermath Recon The next day, the party returned under [[Identity Veils]] and found the exterior repairs already underway. Scaffolding covered the wall damaged during the walker escape, and security preparation was visible around the nearby Palace of Continuity in anticipation of protests or unrest. [[Social Solidarity]] personnel were blocking [[Inspector Marc Valois]] and [[SolSec]] from accessing the assassination scene. Inside the Hall, [[Dr. Luc Moreau]] tried to send data out through the plumbing in a [[Mobile Data Tube]]. The party intercepted it and later recovered part of the [[Mercier Genetic Findings]]. gm Referee Notes The Hall des Futurs Choisis should not be portrayed as overtly sinister. The institution is most effective when it appears competent, rational, and largely beneficial. The discomfort comes not from oppression but from capability. Everything works. The records are accurate. The recommendations are useful. The staff are courteous. The government genuinely improves many lives. The question facing visitors is whether any institution should possess this much information, this much influence, and this much confidence in its ability to shape the future. That question lies at the heart of modern Jardin.

title: Home Guard
summary: Jardin security force called to contain the Mercier assassination scene.
text: Home Guard Jardin's internal defense reserve Overview The Home Guard is a Jardin security force referenced as the expected defender against dissidents, rebel outbreaks, and revolutionaries. Veterans and retired military personnel may carry weapons with military IDs partly so they can support the Home Guard during unrest. Home Guard personnel responded to the [[Mercier Assassination]] scene under the broader [[Social Solidarity]] containment effort. Role in Jardin's Security On a world as tightly managed as Jardin, order rests on more than the regular military and the secret police. [[Social Solidarity]] watches for ideological and genetic irregularity and removes threats quietly; the [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]] projects military force outward. The Home Guard sits between them as the standing internal reserve — the force that turns out when unrest becomes open enough that watching is no longer enough. Because the state expects its citizens to help defend the Perfection System, the Home Guard blurs the line between soldier and civilian. Discharged veterans keep their weapons and military IDs precisely so they can be called up during a crisis, which means that in any serious disturbance the party may face not a discrete unit but an armed, mobilized slice of the population. Capabilities and Limits Organized for rapid containment of riots, insurrection, and terrorism rather than sustained warfare. Equipped for street level security — sidearms, flak vests, helmets, and networked comms — not heavy assault. Reinforced in an emergency by armed veterans acting under their retained military IDs. Operates under Social Solidarity direction at politically sensitive scenes, which can leave its rank and file caught between orders and confusion, as the Hall firefight showed. Session 1 Notes Home Guard guards entered the Hall with handguns and flak vests. They ordered the group to get on the ground and put weapons away. Several were killed or incapacitated when the attempted containment turned into a firefight. Their gear included liberator handguns, helmets, flak vests, phones, and earpieces.

title: Identity Veils
summary: Camera-spoofing masks provided by Marcel Delphine that alter how wearers register to surveillance systems.
text: Identity Veils Overview The identity veils are electronic masks or overlays provided by [[Marcel Delphine]] after the group escaped the [[Mercier Assassination]]. Marcel described them as masks that prevent camera systems from registering the wearer's normal identity. Known Capabilities Each member of the group received one veil. The veils last for approximately three cycles. Surveillance systems see a slightly altered identity rather than the wearer's real face or chassis. For [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]], the veil makes her appear as a similar but different robot model. Limits They are not confirmed to fool direct human recognition. They do not solve passport or genetic identity checks by themselves. They are temporary. By the end of [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], the group expects the veils to last for only one more game or short operational window. Session 2 Use The group used the veils to move around Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne in separate teams, including the Hall recon, Saichi's recharge, the Sainte Liberte supply run, and Lucin's delivery to [[Chief Helene Marchand]]. The veils were treated as sufficient to fool routine cameras and security patrols, but not as a long term identity solution. Connected Events [[Mercier Frame Up]] [[Session 1 Official Business]] [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]]

title: Inspector Adrien Martin
summary: Social Solidarity Liaison at Quartier Sainte-Liberté.
text: Inspector Adrien Martin Social Solidarity Liaison Overview Inspector Adrien Martin is the [[Social Solidarity]] liaison for [[Quartier Sainte Liberté]], responsible for maintaining relations between the district's organizations and the government. It is an extremely difficult job he must keep the peace in a quarter where the [[Jardin Syndicate]], the merchants, and the data brokers all have interests the state would rather not acknowledge. Managing Sainte Liberté means knowing which crimes to see and which to overlook. Notable For State's point of contact for a semi lawless district. Balances Social Solidarity's demands against local realities. Survives by choosing which infractions to notice. Ties [[Quartier Sainte Liberté]] [[Social Solidarity]] [[Jardin Syndicate]]

title: Inspector Gabriel Rousseau
summary: Senior Customs Officer at Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony.
text: Inspector Gabriel Rousseau Senior Customs Officer Overview Inspector Gabriel Rousseau is a senior customs officer at [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]] and a legend among anti smuggling investigators. He knows the tells of a forged identity and a doctored manifest the way other people know faces, which makes him the officer a smuggling operation most wants to avoid drawing. For travelers relying on [[Identity Veils]] or borrowed papers, Rousseau is the kind of examiner those tricks were not built to fool. Notable For Legendary anti smuggling customs investigator. Reads forged identities and manifests on sight. The examiner false papers are least likely to survive. Ties [[Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony]]

title: Inspector-General Marc Villeneuve
summary: Commander, Directorate of Social Stability at Social Solidarity.
text: Inspector General Marc Villeneuve Commander, Directorate of Social Stability Overview Inspector General Marc Villeneuve commands the Directorate of Social Stability within [[Social Solidarity]] and is widely feared by dissident organizations. His directorate is the hard edge of the ministry — the arm that identifies, contains, and removes threats to the Party's order. When the state decides that someone has become a problem, Villeneuve's people are who arrive. Notable For Leads Social Solidarity's enforcement directorate. Feared across Jardin's dissident networks. The ministry's instrument for removing threats. Ties [[Social Solidarity]]

title: Inspector Marc Valois
summary: SolSec investigator blocked from the Mercier assassination scene by Social Solidarity.
text: Inspector Marc Valois Overview Inspector Marc Valois is a [[SolSec]] investigator seen outside the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] during [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]]. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] recognized him from prior SolSec circles, though he was not in her direct chain of command. Valois works cases involving corrupt alien biology and genetic crimes. Because [[Alain Mercier]] was killed at the Hall while preparing to reveal genetic file corruption, Valois believed the assassination connected to his own investigation. Session 2 Valois was arguing with [[Social Solidarity]] personnel outside the Hall. He demanded access to evidence, saying SolSec had the right to investigate because the matter involved a SolSec member and genetic crime. Social Solidarity refused, arguing that Mercier was a planetary official killed in a planetary government building and that a SolSec operative was implicated, so SolSec could not be trusted with access. Importance Valois may be a route to bypass planetary security, but contacting him is risky. If he is honest, he may want the same evidence the party now holds. If he is watched, any approach could expose the group. Connected Pages [[Mercier Assassination]] [[Mercier Frame Up]] [[Mercier Genetic Findings]] [[Mobile Data Tube]] gm GM Notes Transcript audio renders the name as "Mark Vallor/Valois." Confirm final spelling if a table handout exists.

title: Jacques Martin
summary: Business Executive at Arcosphere Rousseau.
text: Jacques Martin Business Executive Overview Jacques Martin officially owns several logistics companies operating out of the Rousseau Arcology. Unofficially, he is widely rumored to maintain extensive connections within the [[Jardin Syndicate]], the kind of ties that turn a shipping firm into a discreet moving service for people and goods that would rather not be registered. Nothing has ever been proven, which on Jardin usually means either that he is careful or that he is useful to someone who is. Notable For Legitimately owns multiple logistics firms. Rumored to be tied into the Jardin Syndicate's movement networks. Never charged — a sign of caution, protection, or both. Ties [[Arcosphere Rousseau]] [[Jardin Syndicate]]

title: Jardin Navy
summary: Planetary naval force tied to the Hadal survivors and the wider Mercier conspiracy.
text: Jardin Navy Overview The Jardin Navy is the planetary naval force operating from facilities such as [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]]. It becomes newly important in [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]] when the party finds Jardin Navy personnel trapped inside a Transstar undersea research facility. Session 4 At [[Hadal Research Site]], the party recovers four starving survivors and ten dead personnel from a sealed oxygenated chamber. All are in Jardin Navy uniforms. Only one survivor lives after transfer to [[Undersea Base Elyon]] the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. [[Étienne Valcourt]] points out the contradiction. Hadal is a Transstar site, so a full naval group being trapped there suggests a covert operation, a failed rescue, or an official story that does not match what happened. Open Questions Why was a naval team at Hadal? Where is the ship or transport that brought them there? Did the Navy know the Mercier lookalike was present? Is the Navy cooperating with Transstar, investigating Transstar, or hiding something from it?

title: Jardin Syndicate
summary: The **Jardin Syndicate** is one of the largest and most influential
text: Syndicat Jardin Jardin Syndicate Type Interstellar Criminal Organization Area of Operations Jardin Subsector and neighboring regions on both sides of the Solomani Imperial border Primary Activities Human trafficking Refugee exploitation Identity fraud Smuggling Money laundering Counterfeiting Illegal migration Labor racketeering Threat Assessment High Session 1 Revelations During [[Session 1 Official Business]], [[Marcel Delphine]] described the Syndicate's genetic work as manipulation of genetic code records to help less fortunate people acquire jobs according to merit. Emma's smuggler contact gave similar context the Syndicate often helps people who are less genetically pure or politically disfavored by creating or altering genetic identities. The Syndicate had feared that [[Alain Mercier]] had discovered their activity, but Marcel claimed Mercier's true finding pointed to corruption "from above." The Syndicate therefore wants the [[Mercier Frame Up]] challenged before the official story can be used as justification for a crackdown. Known Assets From Session 1 Hidden service and waste disposal access beneath [[Arcosphere Rousseau]]. Driverless grav vehicle extraction capability. [[Identity Veils]] that spoof camera recognition for approximately three cycles. Possible unedited footage of the assassination. Contacts able to recover gear while posing as cleanup or police adjacent workers. Known Limits The Syndicate is criminal and self interested. It may help the group because their survival hurts mutual enemies, not because of altruism alone. Marcel does not give the unedited footage freely. Session 2 Underworld Contact In [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], the group met [[Lucin]], a Sainte Liberte data broker who may or may not be connected to [[Marcel Delphine]] or the wider Syndicate. The party deliberately avoided invoking Marcel's name. Lucin's successful delivery job gave the group a vehicle, a minor underworld credential, and a possible path to ammunition through [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. Status Active Known Leader [[Marcel Delphine]] ("The Shepherd") Headquarters Unknown Suspected Primary Operations Center Rousseau Arcology, Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne Overview The Jardin Syndicate is one of the largest and most influential criminal organizations operating within the Jardin Subsector. Originally founded on Jardin itself, the Syndicate has expanded across dozens of worlds, establishing networks that span both Confederation and Imperial territory. Unlike traditional criminal organizations, the Syndicate built its power not through narcotics, gambling, or protection rackets, but through control of migration. The organization specializes in exploiting populations trapped between political systems. Every year thousands of individuals seek escape from persecution, discrimination, economic hardship, or political repression. The Syndicate positions itself as a solution. To refugees, they offer hope. To governments, they provide plausible deniability. To criminals, they provide opportunity. To their victims, they are predators. Their unofficial motto is said to be "Everyone deserves a future." The organization never specifies whose future profits from the arrangement. Origins The Border Opportunity The Syndicate emerged approximately sixty years ago during a period of increasing migration between hard line Solomani worlds and neighboring Imperial systems. Jardin occupied a unique position. As a prosperous world situated near the border, it served as both a destination and transit hub for displaced populations. Certain groups found themselves particularly vulnerable Non Solomani humans Mixed race populations Political dissidents Religious minorities Unregistered migrants Stateless individuals A market emerged. Someone was always willing to pay for transport. Someone was always willing to sell it. The First Networks Initially the organization consisted of independent brokers and shipping agents. Most operated legally. Some did not. Over time these networks merged. A loose confederation of smugglers, recruiters, corrupt officials, and transport operators gradually evolved into a sophisticated criminal enterprise. The name "Jardin Syndicate" first appeared in SolSec intelligence reports nearly fifty years ago. Structure The Syndicate operates as a decentralized network rather than a traditional hierarchy. Cells maintain substantial autonomy. Many members never meet senior leadership. This structure has proven highly resistant to law enforcement efforts. Directorate The inner leadership circle. Responsible for Strategic planning Financial operations Political relationships Major smuggling routes Few individuals know the identities of all Directorate members. Placement Agencies The public face of the organization. These agencies advertise Employment opportunities Immigration assistance Relocation services Refugee support Many are entirely legitimate. Some are not. Citizens rarely know the difference. Transit Networks Responsible for moving people across interstellar borders. Methods include Commercial passenger liners Low berths Freight shipments False identities Bribed port officials The network extends throughout the subsector. Registry Specialists Among the Syndicate's most valuable assets. These specialists create False identities Forged permits Altered citizenship records Fabricated employment histories A skilled Registry Specialist can make a person appear to have existed for decades. Business Operations Refugee Transport The Syndicate's most profitable enterprise. Clients pay for Transportation Documentation Employment placement Housing assistance Some arrive safely. Others do not. Identity Laundering The process of constructing entirely new legal identities. Packages may include Birth certificates Citizenship records Educational histories Employment records Prices vary dramatically. Debt Contracts Many migrants lack sufficient funds. The Syndicate offers financing. Repayment terms are often severe. Debtors may spend years working to satisfy obligations. Labor Placement The Syndicate maintains relationships with employers throughout the subsector. Some placements are legitimate. Others resemble indentured servitude. The distinction often depends on who is asked. Counterfeiting The organization manufactures Currency Identification documents Shipping manifests Government certifications High quality counterfeit records are among its most valuable products. Political Relationships The Syndicate survives because powerful people occasionally benefit from its activities. Corrupt Officials Some local politicians quietly use Syndicate services. Benefits include Removal of troublesome populations Reduction in social tensions Access to unofficial labor pools Business Interests Several corporations rely upon labor supplied through Syndicate channels. Publicly they deny involvement. SolSec The relationship between SolSec and the Syndicate remains complex. Officially The Syndicate is a criminal enterprise and enemy of the Confederation. Unofficially Individual operations have occasionally intersected with broader political objectives. Rumors persist that some Syndicate leaders possess information capable of embarrassing senior officials. Presence on Jardin Jardin remains the organization's symbolic homeland. The Syndicate's influence is strongest within Rousseau Arcology Port Sainte Jeanne Utility Canal districts Independent cargo facilities Many legitimate businesses unknowingly interact with Syndicate controlled intermediaries. Public Front Organizations Known examples include Nouvelle Horizons Placement Services Employment and relocation agency. Future Path Migration Consulting Immigration assistance organization. Citizens Aid Cooperative Refugee support charity. Border Transit Logistics Shipping and transportation firm. Each has appeared in multiple investigations. None have been successfully linked to senior Syndicate leadership. Common Sayings "Everyone deserves a future." Often associated with the Syndicate. "The Hall gives you a future. The Syndicate lets you choose one." Popular among anti government circles. "The Shepherd knows a way." A phrase heard among migrant communities. Rivals SolSec The Syndicate's most dangerous enemy. Ministry of Justice Responsible for many anti Syndicate investigations. Independent Smugglers Frequently absorbed or eliminated. Local Criminal Organizations Often become subordinate partners. Rumors The Registry Mirror The Syndicate allegedly possesses a complete copy of the Hall of Chosen Futures Citizen Registry. Most experts consider this impossible. The Hidden Fleet The Syndicate supposedly controls dozens of transport vessels operating under false registrations. The Ghost Citizens Thousands of identities in the Confederation database may belong to people who never existed. The Shepherd's Archive Marcel Delphine is rumored to possess decades of blackmail material concerning politicians, Party officials, corporate executives, and military officers. Adventure Hooks The Missing Family A refugee family vanishes after arriving on Jardin. Their final known contact was a Syndicate recruiter. Ghost Identity The Travellers discover that one of their own identities now belongs to someone else. SolSec Operation Agents recruit the Travellers to infiltrate a Syndicate migration network. The Shepherd's Offer Marcel Delphine personally approaches the Travellers with a proposal. False Refugees A group of supposed refugees may actually be foreign intelligence operatives. The Registry Leak Evidence suggests the Syndicate has gained access to highly classified citizen records. Debt Collection A desperate migrant asks the Travellers for protection from Syndicate enforcers. gm Referee Notes The Jardin Syndicate should never be portrayed as purely evil or purely benevolent. They help people. They exploit people. They save lives. They destroy lives. Many citizens owe their freedom to the Syndicate. Many others lost everything because of it. The organization's greatest strength is that it exists in the gray space between criminality, politics, humanitarianism, and commerce. Every faction on Jardin has a reason to hate them. Every faction on Jardin also has a reason to quietly tolerate them.

title: Jardin
text: Jardin ![Jarin Jump Map](/wiki/media/Jarin Jump Map.png) Capital World of the Jardin Subsector UWP A5679BC D Allegiance SoCf (Solomani Confederation) Trade Codes Hi, Cp, Pr, Pz, Ht Subsector Jardin Tech Level 13 Contents [Overview]( overview) [Major Cities]( major cities) [Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne]( nouvelle sainte jeanne) [Nouvelle Cartier]( nouvelle cartier) [Port Liberté]( port libert) [Cité Duprey]( cit duprey) [Sainte Hélène des Champs]( sainte h l ne des champs) [Nouvelle Rousseau]( nouvelle rousseau) [Port Mercier]( port mercier) [Points of Interest]( points of interest) [Session 1 Notes]( session 1 notes) Overview Jardin is the capital and dominant world of the Jardin Subsector, serving as one of the most influential political, military, and economic centers in the Solomani Front. Originally founded in 450 by wealthy military adventurers and industrialists fleeing Imperial influence, Jardin rapidly developed into a regional power and briefly established its own colonial empire before being defeated and integrated into the Solomani movement. Over the centuries it transformed from a rebellious frontier power into one of the Confederation's most loyal and ideologically committed worlds. Modern Jardin is governed by Supreme President Leo Duprey and the Solomani Party. The world is famous for its extensive social engineering programs, state managed child rearing system, government directed reproductive matching, and centuries long pursuit of the so called Perfection System. The planet's capital, Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne , contains the massive Rousseau Arcology, the Hall of Chosen Futures, the Closed Gardens of the Ministry of Genetics, the Transstar Sector Exchange, and the Fort Robespierre Naval Annex. To supporters, Jardin represents the future of humanity. To critics, it is humanity redesigned. Major Cities Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne The planetary capital and largest city. Population exceeds twelve billion. Home to [[Le Palais de Continuité]] Hall of Chosen Futures Closed Gardens Rousseau Arcology Port Sainte Jeanne [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]] [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] Most offworlders never see any other part of the planet. Nouvelle Cartier The scientific capital of Jardin. Home to major universities, research institutes, and Ministry of Genetics facilities. The city's researchers are among the most respected in the Confederation. Port Liberté The industrial heart of the world. Produces Robotics Starship components Military vehicles Heavy machinery The skyline is dominated by shipyards and manufacturing towers. Cité Duprey Administrative center of the planet. Contains countless ministry offices, archives, civil service academies, and Party institutions. Known throughout Jardin as "The city where paperwork goes to breed." Sainte Hélène des Champs Agricultural center of the world. Surrounded by vast engineered farmlands and experimental crop complexes. Produces food exports throughout the subsector. Nouvelle Rousseau A model city designed according to the principles of the Perfection System. Every neighborhood, transit route, and public space was planned by social engineers. Visitors either admire it or find it deeply unsettling. Port Mercier Frontier expansion hub. Serves as the primary departure point for Colonists Exploration teams Development projects Frontier corporations Possesses a more adventurous spirit than most Jardinese cities. Points of Interest Palace of Continuity — Seat of Supreme President Leo Duprey and the symbolic center of planetary authority. Hall of Chosen Futures — The institution responsible for citizen assignment, pairing approvals, life planning, and population management. Les Jardins Fermés (The Closed Gardens) — Headquarters of the Ministry of Genetics and the center of two centuries of social and genetic research. Rousseau Arcology — The largest population center on the planet and home to billions of citizens. Transstar Sector Exchange — Economic capital of the subsector and headquarters of Transstar's Solomani Front operations. Fort Robespierre Naval Annex — Major military complex supporting fleet operations, marine training, and combat walker programs. Port Sainte Jeanne Downport — One of the busiest starports in the Solomani Front and the primary gateway to the world. Quartier Sainte Liberté — Neon lit commercial district famous for nightlife, information brokers, and Syndicate influence. Crèche District 14 — One of the largest child development complexes in the Confederation and a showcase of the Perfection System. Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony — The point through which nearly every visitor enters Jardin. Session 1 Notes The campaign begins in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, with the player characters living in or around [[Arcosphere Rousseau]]. Jardin is presented as normally safe but politically surveilled, with police activity against dissidents, revolutionaries, and people accused of aggression against the state. Veterans and retired military personnel may carry weapons when they have proper military IDs, partly so they can aid the [[Home Guard]] in a rebel outbreak. This rule helped make the [[Mercier Frame Up]] plausible the characters could be gathered armed in a civic building without immediately breaking local procedure. Direct off world escape from Jardin is difficult because identity, passport, and genetic controls are heavy at major departure points. [[Keith Morris]] suggested moving elsewhere within the Jardin system before attempting a jump. gm GM Truth Most visitors believe Jardin's greatest secret is the Perfection System. They are wrong. The Perfection System is public. The true secret is that after two centuries of collecting demographic, social, medical, psychological, and genetic data on billions of citizens, the Ministry of Genetics may finally possess enough information to answer questions nobody else in the Confederation can. Questions about human behavior. Questions about intelligence. Questions about social stability. Questions about the future itself. Minister Alain Mercier's upcoming Party Congress announcement has many of the world's most powerful individuals nervous. Some believe he is about to reveal the greatest scientific breakthrough in Confederation history. Others fear he is about to prove that two centuries of social engineering have been based upon flawed assumptions. Either possibility could change the future of Jardin forever. Meanwhile, beneath the ordered surface of society, the Jardin Syndicate continues to grow in influence, Social Solidarity watches for signs of ideological contamination, and Supreme President Leo Duprey dreams of extending Jardin's influence across the entire subsector. The experiment continues.

Fort Robespierre Naval Annex — Major military complex supporting fleet operations, marine training, and combat walker programs. Port Sainte Jeanne Downport — One of the busiest starports in the Solomani Front and the primary gateway to the world. Quartier Sainte Liberté — Neon lit commercial district famous for nightlife, information brokers, and Syndicate influence. Crèche District 14 — One of the largest child development complexes in the Confederation and a showcase of the Perfection System. Customs & Immigration Checkpoint Harmony — The point through which nearly every visitor enters Jardin. Session 1 Notes The campaign begins in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, with the player characters living in or around [[Arcosphere Rousseau]]. Jardin is presented as normally safe but politically surveilled, with police activity against dissidents, revolutionaries, and people accused of aggression against the state. Veterans and retired military personnel may carry weapons when they have proper military IDs, partly so they can aid the [[Home Guard]] in a rebel outbreak. This rule helped make the [[Mercier Frame Up]] plausible the characters could be gathered armed in a civic building without immediately breaking local procedure. Direct off world escape from Jardin is difficult because identity, passport, and genetic controls are heavy at major departure points. [[Keith Morris]] suggested moving elsewhere within the Jardin system before attempting a jump. gm GM Truth Most visitors believe Jardin's greatest secret is the Perfection System. They are wrong. The Perfection System is public. The true secret is that after two centuries of collecting demographic, social, medical, psychological, and genetic data on billions of citizens, the Ministry of Genetics may finally possess enough information to answer questions nobody else in the Confederation can. Questions about human behavior. Questions about intelligence. Questions about social stability. Questions about the future itself. Minister Alain Mercier's upcoming Party Congress announcement has many of the world's most powerful individuals nervous. Some believe he is about to reveal the greatest scientific breakthrough in Confederation history. Others fear he is about to prove that two centuries of social engineering have been based upon flawed assumptions. Either possibility could change the future of Jardin forever. Meanwhile, beneath the ordered surface of society, the Jardin Syndicate continues to grow in influence, Social Solidarity watches for signs of ideological contamination, and Supreme President Leo Duprey dreams of extending Jardin's influence across the entire subsector. The experiment continues.

title: Jardinian Naval SOS
summary: Encrypted military distress signal Emma discovers while training on Profondeur communications.
text: Jardinian Naval SOS Overview The Jardinian Naval SOS is an encrypted distress signal discovered by [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] while training on [[TSS Profondeur]] communications. The signal is hidden from ordinary Transstar systems and uses military encryption familiar to Emma from SolSec and Jardin military work. Session 4 Emma realizes the signal indicates living Jardin Navy personnel at or near an attacked location. She later frames the discovery as an outside interception and transmits the information through [[Sabine Caron]]. The later rescue at [[Hadal Research Site]] confirms that Jardin Navy personnel were trapped inside a Transstar facility. Open Questions Who sent the SOS? Why was it hidden from normal Transstar channels? Did SolSec, Jardin Navy, or Transstar already know the survivors were there?

Her record includes contact networks, military service, amnesia, enemies from the field, and a return to hunting work. Notable Skills Gun Combat 4, Astrogation 2, Gun Combat (Energy) 2, Electronics 1, Electronics (Computers) 1, Engineer 1, Explosives 1, Gunner 1, Mechanic 1, Medic 1, Melee (Blade) 1, Melee (Unarmed) 1, Pilot 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Tactics (Naval) 1, Deception 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Arrived armed and carefully maintained her rifle while respecting the public space. Tried to stabilize [[Alain Mercier]] after the assassination, but the wounds were too severe. Pushed for escape and suggested using Mercier's biometrics or transport possibilities. Spoke cautiously with [[Marcel Delphine]], making clear she would not commit the group to anything without time to think. Session 3 Transstar Day Continued serving as part of the armed, cautious side of the group during the move from fugitives to Transstar employees. Supported the decision to seek corporate cover before the [[Identity Veils]] failed completely. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep No distinct Judith actions are captured in the Session 4 transcript. Session 5 The Oduya No distinct individual spotlight is captured in the Game 5 transcript. Remains connected to the party's Transstar cover, the restored [[Alain Mercier]] problem, and the recovery of [[Oduya]] as the group's route toward orbit. Contacted [[Keith Morris]] about reaching [[Miasma]] or otherwise getting off Jardin. Learned that identities/passports are the immediate barrier to direct off world travel. title: Juliette Mercier
summary: Senior Editor, Jardin Today at Quartier Danton.
text: Juliette Mercier Senior Editor, Jardin Today Overview Juliette Mercier is a senior editor at Jardin Today, working out of the press district in [[Quartier Danton]], and is known for asking difficult questions. In the aftermath of Minister Mercier's assassination and the fabricated broadcast that followed it, an editor willing to press on the official story is a dangerous thing to be — and a valuable person to reach. Whether she shares the late minister's surname by blood or coincidence is not established. Notable For Senior editor known for hard questions. Potentially skeptical of the official Mercier narrative. Surname connection to Alain Mercier is unconfirmed. Ties [[Quartier Danton]]

title: Keith Morris
summary: Corporate executive contact of Judith Dumont who advised that direct off-world escape from Jardin is blocked by identity controls.
text: Keith Morris Overview Keith Morris is a corporate executive contact of [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]]. Judith hoped he could help the group get off Jardin and eventually reach [[Miasma]]. Morris explained that the immediate problem is not money for transport but identity control the group lacks usable passports or identities after the frame up. He suggested that leaving directly from Jardin would require passing heavy passport control scans, and that moving elsewhere in the Jardin system first may be easier. Appears In [[Session 1 Official Business]] Notes Morris is positively inclined toward Judith. He can advise on escape logistics but cannot directly bypass Jardin's identity controls. He may be useful once the group has forged identities or reaches a less secure departure point.

title: La Porte Fiel
summary: Sainte-Liberte drug den where the party found Lucin and arranged the Valois evidence drop.
text: La Porte Fiel Overview La Porte Fiel is a club or drug den in [[Quartier Sainte Liberte]]. The party found [[Lucin]] there during [[Session 3 Transstar Day]] after spotting another trike like the one Lucin had given them. Description The entrance is watched by a heavily cybered bouncer. Inside, the room is dominated by bass heavy music, flashing lights, reclining chairs, and patrons using inhaled drug packets. Most people are seated, leaning against the bar, or too altered to pay attention. Lucin used the back area, where gas canisters and packet filling equipment were visible, as a private space for business. Session 3 The party arranged for Lucin to deliver the recovered Mercier evidence to [[Inspector Marc Valois]]. During the handoff, [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] activated its tracking signal. Lucin sealed the pad in a Faraday bag, and the group fled before police arrived at the den. Connected Pages [[Lucin]] [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] [[Inspector Marc Valois]] [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]
