Report]( the future report) Overview The Quartier Danton serves as the intellectual and political center of Jardin. While the Palace of Continuity governs the planet and the Hall of Chosen Futures manages its citizens, Danton is where competing visions of the future are debated. The district contains Universities Party schools Newspapers Research institutes Policy centers Public forums Most major political movements on Jardin begin here. Many also die here. First Impressions Danton feels educated. Bookstores line the streets. Students crowd cafés. Professors argue in public squares. Political posters cover walls. News screens display debates twenty four hours a day. Visitors quickly discover that people in Danton have opinions. Strong opinions. Usually several at once. History The Founding The district emerged around Jardin's earliest universities. After the Solomani Party assumed power, numerous political schools and research institutes were established nearby. Over time the area became the unofficial center of political thought. The Congress District Following the violent Party Congress of 844, many political organizations centralized their operations in Danton. The district gradually evolved into a permanent political marketplace. Not for votes. For influence. Architecture Unlike the monumental government districts, Danton is designed on a human scale. Features include Broad boulevards Public squares Lecture halls Libraries Cafés Academic courtyards The atmosphere resembles a university city more than a capital district. Major Districts Republic Square The symbolic center of the Quarter. Location of Public speeches Demonstrations Party events Academic debates Nearly every political movement on Jardin has held rallies here. Academy Row Home to Universities Research Institutes Party Academies Thousands of students study here. The Press District Contains the headquarters of Jardin Today State Broadcasting Services Academic Journals Independent Publications Journalists wield considerable influence within Danton. Forum Boulevard A long avenue lined with Think Tanks Policy Institutes Civic Organizations Every building appears to be studying something. The Debate Gardens Public park designed specifically for lectures, discussions, and political gatherings. An unusual feature even by Solomani standards. Political Culture Politics in Danton is intense. Most debates occur between competing interpretations of the Solomani Cause. Common factions include Continuity Bloc Supports stability and existing institutions. Associated with Leo Duprey. Future Movement Advocates scientific planning and social innovation. Associated with Alain Mercier. Civic Humanists Support greater local autonomy and civic participation. Viewed with suspicion by some hardliners. Frontier Development League Promotes expansion, colonization, and economic growth. Strong support from Transstar interests. Universities University of Jardin The most prestigious educational institution on the planet. Produces Scientists Administrators Diplomats Many future leaders begin here. Party Academy of Public Administration The premier training institution for future Party officials. Graduates dominate government service. Institute for Historical Continuity Responsible for preserving and interpreting the history of Jardin. Frequently accused of political bias. Security The district remains heavily monitored. However, security is often subtle. Organizations present include Social Solidarity Campus Security SolSec Liaison Offices Most activity focuses on observation rather than intervention. Relationship with Social Solidarity Complicated. Many academics depend upon government funding. Many academics also criticize government policy. Both sides tolerate each other. Most of the time. Relationship with the Ministry of Genetics Very close. Researchers from the Closed Gardens frequently lecture and teach in Danton. Many Ministry officials maintain offices here. Notable Locations The Hall of Public Discourse A massive amphitheater used for debates and conferences. Café République Most famous political café on Jardin. Hundreds of careers have started here. Many have ended here as well. Library of the Solomani Future One of the largest public libraries in the Confederation. Monument to the First Congress Commemorates the founding generation of the Solomani Movement. Notable Individuals [[Professor Émile Laurent]] Political theorist and public intellectual. Frequently appears on state broadcasts. [[Juliette Mercier]] Senior editor at Jardin Today. Known for asking difficult questions. [[Alain Mercier|Director Alain Mercier]] Maintains an office in the district despite serving primarily from the Closed Gardens. His lectures routinely fill entire auditoriums. [[Pierre Gauthier]] Student activist and rising political figure. Closely watched by Social Solidarity. Public Reputation Most citizens describe Danton as The place where people talk. Supporters consider it the conscience of Jardin. Critics consider it a district full of people who have never held a real job. Rumors The Secret Congress Influential figures occasionally meet in private to shape future Party policy. The Missing Manuscript A controversial political work disappeared before publication. The Speaker's List Certain lecturers are quietly prevented from speaking in public. Officially no such list exists. The Forgotten Archive Records from the violent Congress of 844 remain sealed somewhere beneath the district. Adventure Hooks The Stolen Speech A major Party address is leaked before delivery. Academic Defector A visiting scholar vanishes after announcing controversial findings. Congress Intrigue Multiple factions attempt to influence an upcoming Party Congress. The Lost Archive Evidence emerges regarding events surrounding Marine Cartier's rise to power. Student Movement A campus protest begins attracting attention from Social Solidarity. The Future Report An unpublished Ministry document threatens to destabilize several powerful factions. gm Referee Notes Danton should feel like the ideological battlefield of Jardin. Not a place of riots and revolution. A place of arguments. Every café hosts debates. Every university produces theories. Every faction believes it is saving civilization. If Fort Robespierre trains soldiers and the Closed Gardens train scientists, Danton trains politicians. And on Jardin, that can be just as dangerous.

Invitation]( the shepherd s invitation) Overview The Quartier Sainte Liberté is the most vibrant, chaotic, and controversial district on Jardin. To government officials, it is an economic necessity. To tourists, it is fascinating. To Social Solidarity, it is a headache. To the Syndicate, it is home. Unlike the carefully planned districts that dominate the rest of Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, Sainte Liberté grew organically over centuries. The result is a dense urban labyrinth of Neon signs Elevated transit lines Markets Nightclubs Data cafés Capsule hotels Apartment towers Hidden courtyards The district never truly sleeps. At any hour one can find food, music, business, crime, and opportunity. Many visitors compare it to stepping into another world. First Impressions Sainte Liberté assaults the senses. Giant holographic advertisements float between towers. Light reflects from perpetual rain and condensation. Transit trains roar overhead. Thousands of conversations fill the air. The scent of Street food Industrial machinery Ocean air Imported spices mixes together into something uniquely Sainte Liberté. Officially Jardin is orderly. Sainte Liberté is what happens when millions of people improvise. History The Port Expansion The district originated as worker housing supporting the expansion of Port Sainte Jeanne. Dock workers. Freighter crews. Construction laborers. Merchants. Immigrants. Over time these populations created their own communities. The Arcology Connection When Rousseau expanded, elevated transit corridors linked the district directly to the arcology. Development exploded. Commercial towers grew upward. Markets expanded. Entertainment venues multiplied. The district became the unofficial social capital of the city. Modern Era Today Sainte Liberté occupies a unique position. It is not poor. It is not wealthy. It is not controlled. At least not completely. Architecture The district is characterized by Dense construction Vertical development Narrow streets Endless signage Layered infrastructure Buildings have been expanded and modified repeatedly over centuries. Many structures contain Retail space Apartments Workshops Restaurants Data centers within the same tower. The skyline is dominated by holographic advertising and elevated transportation systems. Atmosphere The district feels unlike anywhere else on Jardin. Most of the planet projects Confidence Order Control Sainte Liberté projects Energy Ambition Survival People come here to build lives. Or hide from them. Major Districts Neon Row The entertainment heart of Sainte Liberté. Contains Clubs Bars Music venues Casinos Performance halls Bright enough to be visible from orbit. Market des Étoiles Star Market The largest open commercial market on Jardin. Goods from across the Confederation can be found here. If you cannot find it in the Star Market, it probably does not exist. The Rainwalks A maze of elevated pedestrian pathways. Lined with Food stalls Small shops Street performers Popular with tourists. Also popular with pickpockets. Lantern Quarter One of the oldest neighborhoods in the city. Known for Traditional architecture Family owned businesses Community organizations Remarkably resistant to redevelopment. Foundry Ward Industrial commercial district. Contains Fabrication shops Robotics repair Vehicle modification Technical services Many independent technicians operate here. Commerce The district hosts millions of independent businesses. Unlike the Exchange, where corporate wealth dominates, Sainte Liberté belongs to Small business owners Entrepreneurs Traders Artisans The economy is dynamic, unpredictable, and difficult to regulate. The Data Markets One of the district's most unusual features. Information is bought and sold constantly. Services include Research Market analysis Reputation tracking Historical archives Most operations are legal. Most. Nightlife The district's nightlife is legendary. Visitors can find Jazz clubs Holographic theaters Music halls Virtual experience lounges Many establishments remain open twenty four hours a day. The Syndicate Presence The Jardin Syndicate maintains extensive influence throughout Sainte Liberté. Their involvement ranges from Protection services Dispute mediation Labor organization Smuggling Many residents view the Syndicate as more reliable than official authorities. Publicly, they would never admit this. Social Solidarity Presence The Ministry maintains numerous offices throughout the district. Relations with residents are often complicated. Social Solidarity can enforce laws. It cannot easily enforce conformity. This frustrates some officials. Crime Common criminal activity includes Smuggling Identity fraud Contraband sales Corporate espionage Illegal gambling Despite its reputation, violent crime remains relatively low. The Syndicate has strong incentives to keep business stable. Notable Locations The Azure Dragon Most famous restaurant in the district. A favored meeting place for merchants and smugglers alike. Liberty Station Largest transit hub in Sainte Liberté. More than two million passengers pass through daily. The Holo Gardens An entertainment complex combining public parks and holographic art installations. The Crescent Market The largest night market on Jardin. Open every evening. Never entirely closes. Notable Individuals [[Marcel Delphine]] The Shepherd Although he officially does not live here, many believe Sainte Liberté is the true center of his influence. [[Colette Moreau]] President, Liberty Merchants Association One of the most influential civilian leaders in the district. [[Lucien Roche]] Information Broker Can acquire almost any information. For the right price. [[Inspector Adrien Martin]] Social Solidarity Liaison Responsible for maintaining relations between local organizations and the government. His job is extremely difficult. Public Reputation Citizens from elsewhere on Jardin often describe Sainte Liberté as Too loud. Too crowded. Too free. Residents generally consider this a compliment. Rumors The Hidden Exchange A secret market exists beneath the district where anything can be bought. Anything. The Shepherd's Court A hidden meeting place where disputes are resolved under Syndicate protection. Ghost Towers Several abandoned towers supposedly contain forgotten infrastructure dating back centuries. The Black Ledger Evidence exists proving corruption among major officials. Numerous organizations are searching for it. Adventure Hooks Missing Courier A data courier vanishes before delivering sensitive information. Syndicate Arbitration The Travellers are asked to mediate a dispute between competing criminal organizations. The Hidden Market Rumors of a secret underground exchange prove true. Corporate Heist A rival corporation hires the Travellers to steal valuable trade data. Ghost Tower An abandoned structure suddenly begins transmitting signals. The Shepherd's Invitation A message arrives requesting a meeting in Sainte Liberté. No address is provided. Only a time. gm Referee Notes Sainte Liberté should feel like the one place on Jardin where control becomes difficult. The Palace controls politics. The Hall controls futures. The Gardens control knowledge. Social Solidarity controls compliance. But Sainte Liberté controls culture. This is where trends begin. Where music spreads. Where merchants gamble. Where immigrants build new lives. Where the Syndicate thrives. If the rest of Jardin feels like a carefully designed machine, Sainte Liberté should feel like humanity leaking out through the cracks.

Courier]( missing courier) [Syndicate Arbitration]( syndicate arbitration) [The Hidden Market]( the hidden market) [Corporate Heist]( corporate heist) [Ghost Tower]( ghost tower) [The Shepherd's Invitation]( the shepherd s invitation) Overview The Quartier Sainte Liberté is the most vibrant, chaotic, and controversial district on Jardin. To government officials, it is an economic necessity. To tourists, it is fascinating. To Social Solidarity, it is a headache. To the Syndicate, it is home. Unlike the carefully planned districts that dominate the rest of Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne, Sainte Liberté grew organically over centuries. The result is a dense urban labyrinth of Neon signs Elevated transit lines Markets Nightclubs Data cafés Capsule hotels Apartment towers Hidden courtyards The district never truly sleeps. At any hour one can find food, music, business, crime, and opportunity. Many visitors compare it to stepping into another world. First Impressions Sainte Liberté assaults the senses. Giant holographic advertisements float between towers. Light reflects from perpetual rain and condensation. Transit trains roar overhead. Thousands of conversations fill the air. The scent of Street food Industrial machinery Ocean air Imported spices mixes together into something uniquely Sainte Liberté. Officially Jardin is orderly. Sainte Liberté is what happens when millions of people improvise. History The Port Expansion The district originated as worker housing supporting the expansion of Port Sainte Jeanne. Dock workers. Freighter crews. Construction laborers. Merchants. Immigrants. Over time these populations created their own communities. The Arcology Connection When Rousseau expanded, elevated transit corridors linked the district directly to the arcology. Development exploded. Commercial towers grew upward. Markets expanded. Entertainment venues multiplied. The district became the unofficial social capital of the city. Modern Era Today Sainte Liberté occupies a unique position. It is not poor. It is not wealthy. It is not controlled. At least not completely. Architecture The district is characterized by Dense construction Vertical development Narrow streets Endless signage Layered infrastructure Buildings have been expanded and modified repeatedly over centuries. Many structures contain Retail space Apartments Workshops Restaurants Data centers within the same tower. The skyline is dominated by holographic advertising and elevated transportation systems. Atmosphere The district feels unlike anywhere else on Jardin. Most of the planet projects Confidence Order Control Sainte Liberté projects Energy Ambition Survival People come here to build lives. Or hide from them. Major Districts Neon Row The entertainment heart of Sainte Liberté. Contains Clubs Bars Music venues Casinos Performance halls Bright enough to be visible from orbit. Market des Étoiles Star Market The largest open commercial market on Jardin. Goods from across the Confederation can be found here. If you cannot find it in the Star Market, it probably does not exist. The Rainwalks A maze of elevated pedestrian pathways. Lined with Food stalls Small shops Street performers Popular with tourists. Also popular with pickpockets. Lantern Quarter One of the oldest neighborhoods in the city. Known for Traditional architecture Family owned businesses Community organizations Remarkably resistant to redevelopment. Foundry Ward Industrial commercial district. Contains Fabrication shops Robotics repair Vehicle modification Technical services Many independent technicians operate here. Commerce The district hosts millions of independent businesses. Unlike the Exchange, where corporate wealth dominates, Sainte Liberté belongs to Small business owners Entrepreneurs Traders Artisans The economy is dynamic, unpredictable, and difficult to regulate. The Data Markets One of the district's most unusual features. Information is bought and sold constantly. Services include Research Market analysis Reputation tracking Historical archives Most operations are legal. Most. Nightlife The district's nightlife is legendary. Visitors can find Jazz clubs Holographic theaters Music halls Virtual experience lounges Many establishments remain open twenty four hours a day. The Syndicate Presence The Jardin Syndicate maintains extensive influence throughout Sainte Liberté. Their involvement ranges from Protection services Dispute mediation Labor organization Smuggling Many residents view the Syndicate as more reliable than official authorities. Publicly, they would never admit this. Social Solidarity Presence The Ministry maintains numerous offices throughout the district. Relations with residents are often complicated. Social Solidarity can enforce laws. It cannot easily enforce conformity. This frustrates some officials. Crime Common criminal activity includes Smuggling Identity fraud Contraband sales Corporate espionage Illegal gambling Despite its reputation, violent crime remains relatively low. The Syndicate has strong incentives to keep business stable. Notable Locations The Azure Dragon Most famous restaurant in the district. A favored meeting place for merchants and smugglers alike. Liberty Station Largest transit hub in Sainte Liberté. More than two million passengers pass through daily. The Holo Gardens An entertainment complex combining public parks and holographic art installations. The Crescent Market The largest night market on Jardin. Open every evening. Never entirely closes. Notable Individuals [[Marcel Delphine]] The Shepherd Although he officially does not live here, many believe Sainte Liberté is the true center of his influence. [[Colette Moreau]] President, Liberty Merchants Association One of the most influential civilian leaders in the district. [[Lucien Roche]] Information Broker Can acquire almost any information. For the right price. [[Inspector Adrien Martin]] Social Solidarity Liaison Responsible for maintaining relations between local organizations and the government. His job is extremely difficult. Public Reputation Citizens from elsewhere on Jardin often describe Sainte Liberté as Too loud. Too crowded. Too free. Residents generally consider this a compliment. Rumors The Hidden Exchange A secret market exists beneath the district where anything can be bought. Anything. The Shepherd's Court A hidden meeting place where disputes are resolved under Syndicate protection. Ghost Towers Several abandoned towers supposedly contain forgotten infrastructure dating back centuries. The Black Ledger Evidence exists proving corruption among major officials. Numerous organizations are searching for it. Adventure Hooks Missing Courier A data courier vanishes before delivering sensitive information. Syndicate Arbitration The Travellers are asked to mediate a dispute between competing criminal organizations. The Hidden Market Rumors of a secret underground exchange prove true. Corporate Heist A rival corporation hires the Travellers to steal valuable trade data. Ghost Tower An abandoned structure suddenly begins transmitting signals. The Shepherd's Invitation A message arrives requesting a meeting in Sainte Liberté. No address is provided. Only a time. gm Referee Notes Sainte Liberté should feel like the one place on Jardin where control becomes difficult. The Palace controls politics. The Hall controls futures. The Gardens control knowledge. Social Solidarity controls compliance. But Sainte Liberté controls culture. This is where trends begin. Where music spreads. Where merchants gamble. Where immigrants build new lives. Where the Syndicate thrives. If the rest of Jardin feels like a carefully designed machine, Sainte Liberté should feel like humanity leaking out through the cracks.

title: Reena Kessler
summary: Transstar gate employee who issued work-seeker stamps at the Sector Exchange.
text: Reena Kessler Overview Reena Kessler works an entry booth at the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. During [[Session 3 Transstar Day]], she greeted the first party members entering the Exchange and asked whether they were there to shop or seek work. Session 3 Reena issued three day holographic Transstar work seeker stamps. She explained that visitors can use the pass to seek employment, file resumes, and explore their fit inside the Transstar organization. If they find work, the temporary pass can become a permanent Transstar ID. She also explained that Transstar employees receive corporate discounts and that employment changes a person's legal relationship to Jardin the employee becomes part of the Transstar corporate system rather than an ordinary planetary citizen. Connected Pages [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] [[Transstar Employment Contract]] [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]

title: Relay Station 932
summary: Primary undersea communications relay used by Transstar ships and orbital links.
text: Relay Station 932 ![Hadal undersea operations map](/wiki/media/Hadal Undersea Map.png) Overview Relay Station 932 is the undersea communications relay described during the [[TSS Profondeur]] briefing. It serves as a major communications hub, passing traffic between undersea ships, bases, and orbital systems. Session 4 The relay helps define the limits of communication during undersea operations. Delays and routing constraints become important once the party wants to slow or observe messages about the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]].

title: Rémi Beauchamp
summary: Sonar, sensors, electronics, and communications specialist aboard the
text: Rémi Beauchamp ![Rémi Beauchamp portrait](/wiki/media/Remi Beauchamp.png) Sonar / Sensors / Comms Overview Rémi Beauchamp handles electrics, sonar, sensors, and communications aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. He is a former Jardin Navy naval intelligence signals specialist. His job during the party's first shift is to train anyone capable on consoles while covering whichever station remains weakest. Session 4 Beauchamp helps prepare the new crew for sonar and communications work during the trip to [[Hadal Research Site]]. After the rescue, he sends the emergency message to [[Undersea Base Elyon]] reporting one living unidentified Jardin Navy survivor and multiple dead from the earlier attack.

title: Sabine Caron
summary: Security and diving-operations lead aboard the TSS Profondeur.
text: Sabine Caron ![Sabine Caron portrait](/wiki/media/Sabine Caron.png) Security / Diving Operations Overview Sabine Caron is the security and diving operations lead aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. A former Jardin Navy marine and underwater security specialist, she carries paired sawed off shotguns and handles combat readiness outside the hull. Sabine joined Transstar after killing her abusive husband and deciding that a corrupt judiciary would send her to prison for decades. Session 4 Sabine trains the party in undersea suit procedure, exterior movement, buddy checks, and the division between salvage hands and security. She receives Emma's transmitted warning about the hidden [[Jardinian Naval SOS]] while the party operates outside the ship. At [[Undersea Base Elyon]], Sabine prepares the dead Jardin Navy personnel recovered from Hadal for transport to their families and the military.

title: Sarah Chen
summary: Route Intelligence Analyst at Transstar.
text: Sarah Chen Route Intelligence Analyst Overview Sarah Chen is a Route Intelligence Analyst for [[Transstar]], tracking shipping patterns, economic trends, passenger flows, and frontier development from the company's regional data center. She often knows a recession is coming before local governments do, and [[SolSec]] frequently requests her reports — a request she pretends not to notice. Her desk is one of the best vantage points on Jardin for seeing what the numbers are about to do. Notable For Forecasts economic and shipping trends ahead of governments. Her reports are quietly sought by SolSec. A rare clear view of the subsector's moving parts. Ties [[Transstar]] [[SolSec]]

title: Secure Burner Comms
summary: Modified burner communicators built from cheap phones and parts during Session 2.
text: Secure Burner Comms Overview The secure burner comms are modified cheap phones created by the supply team during [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]]. The group bought several burners and parts, then modified them into local military grade communicators. Capabilities Each party member received one. The comms use altered frequencies and hardware changes. Someone who does not know where the group is cannot simply listen in. If an enemy observes a call, they may still try to triangulate the physical location. Limitations They are improvised and local to Jardin's communication environment. They are not a permanent secure network. They do not protect against being physically followed or compromised.

title: Sergey Sun
summary: Emma Colbert contact with a loose smuggling network that can move restricted goods, records, and occasionally people.
text: Sergey Sun Overview Sergey Sun is one of [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]]'s contacts. He operates a loose smuggling network that moves restricted pharmaceutical goods, records, and occasionally people. Session 5 During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], Emma identifies Sergey as the contact most suited to helping move [[Alain Mercier]] off world or into an off world transfer path after the party raises [[Oduya]]. Relevance Sergey is useful because Mercier cannot legally return to Jardin's surface after clone restoration. The party needs a route that moves him from underwater custody to orbit or Navy transfer without triggering public, legal, or genetic control exposure.

title: Session 1 Official Business
text: category game type game name Session 1 Official Business summary Opening session the group is framed for Alain Mercier's assassination and rescued by Marcel Delphine. tags session game session 1 visibility players approvalStatus approved knownToPlayers true keyLinks "[[Mercier Assassination]]" "[[Mercier Frame Up]]" "[[Marcel Delphine]]" aliases Game 1 Chapter 1 Game 1 Stars g1 lastEditedBy Codex eventDate "143 1105" Session 1 Official Business Transcript Source Stars g1.md Synopsis The group is summoned to the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] for official review and finds itself assembled in an unusually armed, suspiciously connected cluster. A broadcast announces that Minister [[Alain Mercier]] will reveal corruption in genetic records at the Party Congress. Moments later, Mercier is killed in front of them by shots that appear to implicate their own weapons. The first response from [[Social Solidarity]] and the [[Home Guard]] becomes a firefight after [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] receives a warning that the authorities intend to kill them. The group escapes using an intact walker/mech after [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] kills its pilot, then is taken by a driverless grav speeder to [[Marcel Delphine]]. Marcel explains that the [[Jardin Syndicate]] wants the group alive because the official story may be used to blame both the characters and the Syndicate while burying Mercier's real findings. He provides [[Identity Veils]] and a one use communicator, and offers unedited assassination footage in exchange for future cooperation. What Happened Game 1 began with the characters arriving at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] for official business genetic review, financial review, military paperwork, administrative interviews, or other state procedures. The gathering quickly felt strange. Too many of the people waiting were armed, trained, connected, or already known to one another, suggesting the group had been assembled for a reason. While they waited, a broadcast announced that Minister [[Alain Mercier]] intended to reveal corruption in Jardin's genetic records at the upcoming Party Congress. Moments later, Mercier rushed through the office area and was shot. The killing immediately looked wrong several characters noticed that their own weapons had moved, fired, heated up, or otherwise been made to look involved. [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] found a missing shotgun round, and the party realized they were being framed for the assassination. [[Elena Verona]] and Home Guard forces moved in to control the scene. The group initially tried to understand or comply, but [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] received a warning through her attached computer that the authorities intended to kill them. The situation turned into a firefight. The party fought through the Home Guard response, recovered useful equipment and Mercier's locked devices, and escaped the building when [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] killed the pilot of a walker/mech without destroying the machine. The group used the walker to descend the outside of the building and was then collected by a driverless grav speeder. The speeder carried them through hidden service and waste disposal routes beneath the arcology to [[Marcel Delphine]], an uplifted dolphin tied to the [[Jardin Syndicate]]. Marcel claimed the Syndicate did not kill Mercier and that Mercier's discovery pointed to corruption "from above," not simply to criminal genetic record manipulation. By the end of the game, the official story had already turned against the party. News broadcasts blamed genetic outcasts, used false footage of [[Zoy (Damon)]], and positioned the characters as terrorists. Marcel gave the group [[Identity Veils]] and a one use communicator, while the party regrouped at Emma's warehouse with Mercier's locked pad, new enemies, and several possible paths clear their names, bargain with Marcel, seek refuge at the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]], or find a way off Jardin. Important Pages [[Mercier Assassination]] [[Mercier Frame Up]] [[False News Broadcast]] [[Identity Veils]] [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] [[Friday Party Congress Hearing]] [[Sunken Ship Boat]] [[Nico Gay]] Characters Present [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]] [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] [[Zoy (Damon)]] Open Questions Who controlled or spoofed the weapons? What did Mercier know? Who is "above" the Syndicate in Marcel's warning? Can the group get unedited footage, unlock the pad, or reach the Friday hearing's inside information? Will the group clear its names, flee Jardin, or work with Marcel?

title: Session 2 - Masks and Markers
summary: The group gathers evidence, recharges Saichi, meets data broker Lucin, and recovers Mercier-linked genetic-marker research.
text: Session 2 Masks and Markers Transcript Source transcript 2026 07 14T13 30 07.150Z.json Synopsis The group wakes in Emma's warehouse with practical problems [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] needs a heavy charge, the [[Identity Veils]] have little time left, and the party still needs evidence and supplies. They split up while their veils still hide them from surveillance. At the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]], the recon team sees [[Social Solidarity]] denying [[SolSec]] access to the assassination investigation. Emma recognizes [[Inspector Marc Valois]], a SolSec investigator whose work touches genetic crime and alien biology. Inside, the team intercepts a [[Mobile Data Tube]] from [[Dr. Luc Moreau]]. Its data says Mercier was killed for information passed to him. Saichi recharges from a police mech during a public shaming at the Grand Axis. The supply team buys survival gear, creates modified burner comms, and meets [[Lucin]], a data broker. Lucin trades them a trike and future goodwill for a daylight delivery from Dome 2 of [[Les Jardins Fermés]] to [[Chief Helene Marchand]]'s secured residence. The crate contains a corgi. Back at the warehouse, the recovered data points to long term genetic marker research tied to extraordinary or psionic like effects. The file is corrupted before its final conclusion, but the findings may explain why Mercier was killed and may connect to the impossible bullet behavior in his assassination. What Happened Game 2 opened the morning after the frame up, with the party hidden in Emma's warehouse and running out of easy options. [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] needed a heavy recharge, the [[Identity Veils]] had limited time left, and the group still lacked proof of who killed Mercier or why. The party split into teams to investigate the Hall, recharge Saichi, and gather supplies. At the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]], the recon team found [[Social Solidarity]] blocking [[SolSec]] from entering the assassination scene. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] recognized [[Inspector Marc Valois]], a SolSec investigator connected to genetic crimes and alien biology cases. Social Solidarity argued that SolSec could not be trusted because a SolSec operative had been implicated in the murder, making Emma's identity part of the political blockade. Inside the Hall, the team followed [[Dr. Luc Moreau]], a nervous scientist who tried to flush a self moving [[Mobile Data Tube]] through the bathroom plumbing. [[Zoy (Damon)]] and [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] recovered the tube before it escaped, and Emma disarmed its self destruct charge. The message attached to the courier said Mercier had obviously been killed for data that had been passed to him. Elsewhere, Saichi and [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] used a public shaming at the Grand Axis as cover to recharge from a police mech. The supply team went into [[Quartier Sainte Liberté]], bought food, medical supplies, water containers, hygiene goods, batteries, and burner phones, and modified the phones into secure short range comms. They also met [[Lucin]], an armored data broker with a cybernetic third arm, who offered them a trike and future goodwill in exchange for a daylight delivery. The party took Lucin's job while the veils still worked. They picked up a golf bag sized crate from Dome 2 of [[Les Jardins Fermés]] and delivered it to a secured residence marked for [[Chief Helene Marchand]], Chief of Staff of the President. A cybernetic butler opened the crate with a code and released a corgi. The party left without incident and kept Lucin's trike. Back at the warehouse, Emma and Zoy reviewed the recovered data chip. The file contained decades of genetic marker research tied to extraordinary or psionic like effects, including examples of people predicting random outputs or identifying hidden cards. The data was corrupted before its final conclusion, but the markers HX 14, SC 9, MY22, and PX 4 may explain why Mercier was killed and may connect to the impossible weapon behavior during the assassination. Character Notes [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] recharged from a police mech during the Grand Axis public shaming. [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] helped follow [[Dr. Luc Moreau]] and recover the [[Mobile Data Tube]]. [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] helped gather supplies, create [[Secure Burner Comms]], and compare his genetic papers against the recovered markers. [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]] helped secure repair supplies and turn the supply run into a useful contact with [[Lucin]]. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] recognized [[Inspector Marc Valois]], set up a Hall comms tap, disarmed the tube, and interpreted the genetic marker data. [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] supported the supply team, made her rifle less conspicuous, and provided overwatch for Lucin's delivery. [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] helped distract attention so Saichi could charge safely. [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] pushed for careful overwatch and supported using the recovered evidence to approach [[SolSec]]. [[Zoy (Damon)]] spotted Moreau's tube handoff, helped retrieve it from the plumbing, and carried it out covertly. Important Pages [[Mercier Genetic Findings]] [[Mobile Data Tube]] [[Dr. Luc Moreau]] [[Inspector Marc Valois]] [[Lucin]] [[Chief Helene Marchand]] [[Identity Veils]] [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] Characters Present [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]] [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] [[Zoy (Damon)]] Open Questions Can the group use the data chip to approach SolSec or clear their names? Why was Chief Helene Marchand receiving a covertly transported corgi? Can Lucin provide ammunition, transport, or more information? Do any of the player characters have the genetic markers in Mercier's data? Can the group get more identity veils before the current ones fail?

title: Session 3 - Transstar Day
summary: The party sends Mercier evidence to Valois through Lucin, flees a tracked data pad, and takes Transstar jobs to survive the failing identity veils.
text: Session 3 Transstar Day Transcript Source transcript 2026 07 28T13 25 40.538Z.json Caption File wiki/transcripts/Session 3 Transstar Day.srt Synopsis With the [[Identity Veils]] almost expired, the group chooses a path that is neither full surrender nor full Syndicate employment. They send the recovered Mercier evidence to [[Inspector Marc Valois]] through [[Lucin]], then retreat into the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] before their disguises fail. Lucin receives the [[Mobile Data Tube]] evidence, related files, and physical proof at [[La Porte Fiel]]. He agrees to have the package placed inside Valois's home later that night, using the favor owed from the Session 2 delivery as payment. During the handoff, [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] activates a tracking signal. Lucin seals it in a Faraday bag, and the group escapes before police reach the club. At the Exchange, [[Reena Kessler]] grants three day work seeker stamps to the first arrivals. The party learns that Transstar employment creates a corporate legal shield inside the Exchange and aboard Transstar ships. Once the Lucin team escapes, everyone brings their gear inside before the veils fail. The group takes Transstar hiring tests. Emma succeeds spectacularly on the executive track and becomes a division level executive. Others become loaders or corporate security after deciding how far to push their luck. [[Claire Bouchard]] handles onboarding, gives them employee badges with their real faces, and assigns the group to the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]]. The party is now temporarily safe as Transstar employees, housed together in Emma's executive suite. The price is corporate supervision, an underwater salvage job, and a thirty day clock before they must either clear their names, leave, or accept a longer Transstar term. What Happened The session opened with a planning argument in Emma's warehouse. The group wanted to avoid becoming criminals in truth while still surviving the end of the [[Identity Veils]]. Options included contacting [[Marcel Delphine]], pressing [[Dr. Luc Moreau]], reaching [[Inspector Marc Valois]], finding new veils, or moving to the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. The party settled on a compromise get the evidence to Valois without exposing themselves. Ciernan led the Lucin team back to Sainte Liberte. They found Lucin inside [[La Porte Fiel]], a drug den where he was calmly searching customers' pockets while they were too intoxicated to react. Lucin accepted the job, scrubbed the package for DNA, and arranged a home delivery to Valois. As the evidence was sealed, [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] activated a "Find My Data Pad" signal. Lucin put the pad in a Faraday bag and told the group to leave. Ciernan guided the escape, and the team got away before police arrived. At the same time, Emma, Victor, Dan, and Varian entered the Exchange. [[Reena Kessler]] explained the three day work seeker stamp and the path from visitor to Transstar employee. Once inside, the group saw [[Transstar Peacekeepers]] and realized corporate law would replace Jardin law inside the Exchange. The first group called the others and told them to come immediately with all gear. Saichi entered with a restrainer tag that powered down her guns. Zoy entered through a mix of confusion and confidence, without receiving a normal stamp. The party then gambled on employment tests. The tests measured skill and risk judgement pushing to a higher tier after a success could lead to promotion, but failing after pushing too far could drop the applicant to loader status. Emma became a division level executive. Several others became loaders or corporate security. [[Claire Bouchard]] then folded everyone into Transstar orientation. The onboarding terms give the party thirty days of open employment. During that window, they may leave or be fired. After that, Transstar expects a longer two , four , or six year commitment. The first assignment is [[Aquatic Salvage Project]], with corporate housing in Emma's suite and work beginning at 4 a.m. Character Notes [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] entered as property/equipment and can be protected through Emma's executive status. [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] helped move the evidence plan forward and tested into Transstar work. [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] handled Lucin socially, led the police evasion, and questioned whether the party had bought time or indentured itself. [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]] pushed the corporate refuge angle and tested under a cover identity. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] argued for a Valois evidence channel and became a Transstar division level executive. [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] is expected to test into the military/security side. [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] assessed the test structure and tried the spacer path. [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] helped frame the Exchange as a safe corporate refuge and provided strong leadership support during testing. [[Zoy (Damon)]] talked his way past the gate despite paperwork and citizenship complications. Important Pages [[Lucin]] [[La Porte Fiel]] [[Inspector Marc Valois]] [[Mercier's Locked Pad]] [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] [[Reena Kessler]] [[Claire Bouchard]] [[Transstar Employment Contract]] [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] [[Dolphin Extremists]] Open Questions How will Valois react to evidence appearing inside his home? Who activated the tracking on Mercier's pad? Can the party clear their names before the thirty day Transstar window closes? What is Transstar really doing underwater? Can the party use the salvage assignment to pursue the sunken ship lead?

title: Session 4 - Into the Hadal Deep
summary: The party begins underwater salvage aboard the TSS Profondeur, rescues a Mercier lookalike from Hadal, and draws SolSec attention at Undersea Base Elyon.
text: Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Transcript Source transcript 2026 08 11T13 10 25.568Z.json Caption File wiki/transcripts/Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep.srt In World Date 145 1105, first Transstar workday. Synopsis The party reports for its first shift on the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] and is assigned to the [[TSS Profondeur]], a refitted former Jardin Navy submersible commanded by [[Étienne Valcourt]]. The new Transstar crew learns the ship layout, meets the senior hands, and starts twelve on/twelve off training under [[Maëlle Fournier]], [[Rémi Beauchamp]], and [[Sabine Caron]]. During the run to [[Hadal Research Site]], Emma discovers an encrypted [[Jardinian Naval SOS]] hidden from ordinary Transstar channels. Cass and Varian train on the bridge while Saichi is assigned to drone and hull response work. The team learns that the opposition is not simply "dolphin extremists" the attackers include humanoids and orcas using cybernetic strength rigs and explosive micro harpoons. At Hadal, the site is badly wrecked. Three of five domes are broken, two still hold oxygen, and a drone survey finds a live power station feeding an interior load. The group identifies a sealed habitat chamber behind a damaged airlock and chooses a manned salvage rescue instead of simply breaching and flooding it. Dan and Victor help rig a temporary airlock seal while Ciernan, Cass, and others enter. Inside are four starving survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel. The crew uses rescue tubes from the Profondeur and hauls the survivors back, but only one lives a naval officer who looks almost exactly like assassinated Genetics Minister [[Alain Mercier]]. Valcourt diverts to [[Undersea Base Elyon]], where the survivor receives emergency nanite treatment. The discovery raises a new question why was a full Jardin Navy team trapped inside a Transstar research facility, and why does the surviving officer look like Mercier? Saichi watches the survivor's room and spots a [[SolSec]] operative taking a hand and bone growth scan. Victor and Dan sabotage base communications to delay outgoing reports, while Zoy and Ciernan try to intercept the SolSec agent and learn exactly how dangerous this thread has become. Major Events 1. Transstar badges summon the party to Dock 6 2 for its first [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] shift. 2. The group receives Transstar uniforms, including a visible corporate treatment for Saichi. 3. The party boards the [[TSS Profondeur]], a former Jardin Navy submersible now used by Transstar. 4. [[Étienne Valcourt]] introduces senior crew [[Maëlle Fournier]], [[Rémi Beauchamp]], and [[Sabine Caron]]. 5. The party learns pressure suit procedures, underwater combat limits, and the dangers of ordinary weapons inside a soft hulled submersible. 6. Emma uncovers a hidden encrypted [[Jardinian Naval SOS]] tied to the attacked Hadal site. 7. The Profondeur reaches [[Hadal Research Site]] and surveys wrecked domes, damaged airlocks, and remaining geothermal power. 8. The team identifies a sealed oxygenated room and chooses a temporary airlock rescue plan. 9. Ciernan, Cass, and others enter the sealed room; Dan and Victor help keep the seal and rescue process viable. 10. Four survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel are found inside a Transstar facility. 11. The crew recovers generators, computer gear, data cubes, and a Seafarer skill chip during salvage. 12. Three survivors die after rescue; the last survivor resembles [[Alain Mercier]] and is stabilized. 13. Valcourt diverts to [[Undersea Base Elyon]] for emergency care rather than returning to the coast. 14. Valcourt warns the party that Jardin Navy personnel inside a Transstar site suggest a covert military operation. 15. Saichi observes a [[SolSec]] operative scanning the survivor's hand and reports the contact. 16. Victor and Dan flood communications batteries with salt water to slow outgoing traffic. 17. Zoy and Ciernan intercept the SolSec agent; the agent draws on Zoy and warns the party away from the investigation. Key NPCs [[Étienne Valcourt]] captain and pilot of the Profondeur. [[Maëlle Fournier]] engineer and damage control specialist. [[Rémi Beauchamp]] sonar, sensors, and communications specialist. [[Sabine Caron]] security and diving operations lead. [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]] rescued Jardin Navy officer whose appearance matches Alain Mercier. [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] agent who scans the survivor and threatens the party. Places [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] [[Fort Robespierre Naval Annex]] [[TSS Profondeur]] [[Hadal Research Site]] [[Undersea Base Elyon]] [[Relay Station 932]] Organizations [[Transstar]] [[Jardin Navy]] [[SolSec]] [[Undersea Extremists]] Clues and Revelations The Profondeur is under crewed because experienced crew were split off to train another vessel. The Profondeur's missile room has been converted into pressure rescue pods. Prior salvage records include equipment, oxygenators, power couplers, and scrubbed rescue logs. Hidden energy weapons aboard the Profondeur are logged as welders. Hadal was attacked weeks ago, but a group of Jardin Navy personnel survived trapped inside one oxygenated dome. The survivor looks almost identical to [[Alain Mercier]] and wears a Jardin Navy uniform. SolSec knows enough about genetic duplication, altered bodies, or clones to perform bone growth and hand structure scans. Undersea Base Elyon is Transstar owned, but SolSec can still operate there. Loot and Assets Seafarer skill chip recovered from Hadal. Salvaged power generators, computer gear, and data cubes. Practical training in Transstar undersea suits, drone scouting, submarine piloting, sonar, and emergency salvage. First hand knowledge that Hadal contained Jardin Navy personnel and not only Transstar staff. Open Threads Who is the Mercier lookalike survivor? Was the assassinated Mercier the original, a duplicate, or one part of a larger genetic program? Why was Jardin Navy operating inside a Transstar research site? What was hidden in the encrypted Jardinian Naval SOS? Can the party get information from the survivor before SolSec or Jardin Navy seals him away? What do the scrubbed Profondeur rescue logs say about previous people recovered by Transstar? Are the undersea extremists enemies, witnesses, or a group reacting to something Transstar and Jardin Navy did? Character Notes [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] is folded into the crew as a pressure capable robot, assigned to drone and hull response work, and later spots the SolSec operative at Elyon. [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] trains on ship systems, helps enter the sealed habitat, and supports the rescue. [[Ciernan Seanislav (Peter)]] works as a loader/security hand, helps reason through the sealed room rescue, and performs triage on the survivors. [[Dan Araujo (Josh)]] scouts Hadal by drone, identifies a live power load, and helps sabotage Elyon's communications delay. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] discovers the encrypted Jardinian Naval SOS and understands the SolSec scan being performed on the survivor. [[Judith Dumont (Carla)]] has no distinct Game 4 action recorded in the transcript. [[Varian Svazz (Allen)]] pilots the Profondeur with exceptional precision and recognizes the survivor's resemblance to Alain Mercier. [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] applies naval and mechanical expertise to the temporary airlock rescue and later assists the communications sabotage. [[Zoy (Damon)]] helps confront the SolSec operative and learns how quickly SolSec can turn a conversation into a threat.

title: Session 5 - The Oduya
summary: Mercier returns through a clone body, the party raises the smuggling ship-boat Oduya, and the conspiracy points beyond Jardin.
text: Session 5 The Oduya The full session record is stored in wiki/sessions/Session 5 The Oduya.md , with captions at wiki/transcripts/Session 5 The Oduya.srt . Synopsis The rescued Hadal survivor wakes at [[Undersea Base Elyon]] and identifies himself as [[Alain Mercier]], restored through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. He offers access codes to his house and computer if the party can keep him safe and get him legally off world. The crew uses the [[TSS Profondeur]] to reach the [[Sunken Ship Boat]], raises the wreck, and learns its true name [[Oduya]]. The ship is a forty year old smuggler craft with modular false identities, dead crew, illegal cybernetic cargo, and enough potential to become the party's route into orbit and the wider system. title: Sister Celeste Moreau
summary: Community Organizer at Arcosphere Rousseau.
text: Sister Celeste Moreau Community Organizer Overview Sister Celeste Moreau runs charitable programs throughout the lower districts of the Rousseau Arcology and is widely respected by the residents she serves. Where the state measures citizens by genetic and demographic value, her work reaches the people the Perfection System ranks lowest, which makes her both beloved in the commons and quietly watched from above. Her networks in the depths of the arcology give her reach that official charity never manages. Notable For Operates charity programs across Rousseau's lower districts. Trusted by residents the state tends to overlook. Commands informal reach into the arcology's poorest levels. Ties [[Arcosphere Rousseau]]

title: Social Solidarity
text: Ministère de la Solidarité Sociale Ministry of Social Solidarity "Harmony Through Responsibility" Designation Ministry of Social Solidarity | Type Government Ministry | Founded 705 | Status Active | Authority Supreme Presidency of Jardin Social Solidarity Emblem ![Ministry of Social Solidarity](/wiki/media/Ministry of Social Solidarity.png) | Field | Value | | | | | Designation | Ministry of Social Solidarity | | Common Name | Social Solidarity | | Type | Internal Security Ministry | | Headquarters | Citadel of Social Harmony | | Location | Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne | | Employees | Approx. 18 Million | | Status | Active | | Reporting Authority | Supreme President Leo Duprey | Overview The Ministry of Social Solidarity is the primary internal security, social administration, and compliance organization of Jardin. Session 1 Role In [[Session 1 Official Business]], [[Elena Verona]], a Social Solidarity commissar, arrived after the [[Mercier Assassination]] and attempted to contain the scene with Home Guard personnel. The public narrative later presented Verona as a harmed witness against the player characters. The transcript clarifies that on Jardin, Social Solidarity functions as the local secret police and internal security organization. [[SolSec]] is separate and handles terrorism and external threats. Open Questions Whether Verona knowingly participated in the frame up or was herself responding to manipulated information is not confirmed. The source of the "kill them all" warning/order received by Emma remains unresolved. Session 2 Role During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], Social Solidarity personnel blocked [[Inspector Marc Valois]] and [[SolSec]] from entering the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] investigation scene. Their stated argument was jurisdictional and political [[Alain Mercier]] was a planetary official killed in a planetary government building, and a SolSec operative was implicated, so SolSec could not be trusted with evidence access. This confirms the rivalry between Social Solidarity and SolSec is now active inside the Mercier investigation. It also gives the party a possible wedge evidence sent to the right SolSec channel might bypass the planetary narrative, but it could also escalate the conflict between agencies. To foreign observers it resembles a mixture of Internal Security Service Immigration Bureau Social Services Agency Political Police Population Management Ministry To most citizens of Jardin, however, Social Solidarity is simply part of daily life. History Social Solidarity emerged following the installation of the Solomani Party government after Jardin's defeat by the Solomani Autonomous Region. title: SolSec Operative at Elyon
summary: Unidentified SolSec agent who scans the Mercier lookalike survivor at Undersea Base Elyon.
text: SolSec Operative at Elyon Overview The SolSec Operative at Elyon is an unidentified agent seen inside [[Undersea Base Elyon]] during [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]]. Saichi spots him entering the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]'s room late at night. Session 4 The operative scans the survivor's hand and bone structure. Emma recognizes the likely significance SolSec is testing whether the survivor is genetically identical, physically altered, cloned, or otherwise connected to [[Alain Mercier]]. Zoy and Ciernan attempt to intercept the operative afterward. The agent quickly draws a gun on Zoy, identifies the party as enemies of the state, warns them not to interfere with SolSec activity, and leaves without escalating further. Session 5 The party debriefs the confrontation and decides the operative is too dangerous to approach casually. After [[Alain Mercier]] wakes and explains the [[Clone Rebirth Program]], the operative's scan reads as an attempt to determine whether Mercier is a restored clone, an original, or part of a clone fraud scenario. Open Questions Does this operative answer to [[Inspector Marc Valois]], a hostile SolSec faction, or another chain of command? What did the scan reveal? Did the communications sabotage prevent him from sending the result?

title: SolSec
summary: Solomani security service focused on terrorism and external threats; distinct from Jardin's Social Solidarity.
text: SolSec Overview SolSec is distinguished in the transcript from [[Social Solidarity]]. On Jardin, Social Solidarity functions as the local secret police and internal security arm, while SolSec handles terrorism and external threats. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] has a SolSec background as a secret agent, which shapes how she thinks about cover, contacts, and state security. Session 2 Blocked Investigation During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], [[Inspector Marc Valois]] attempted to gain access to the [[Mercier Assassination]] scene at the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]]. [[Social Solidarity]] blocked him, arguing that SolSec could not be trusted because a SolSec operative was implicated in the assassination. Emma believes her own SolSec connection may have been useful to the conspirators by framing the group with a SolSec linked operative, they created a reason to keep SolSec away from the evidence. Appears In [[Session 1 Official Business]] [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]] Notes SolSec identities and contacts may be dangerous to use while the group is framed. Forged identities recorded by SolSec may not remain safe over multiple jumps. Valois may be a possible ally or evidence channel, but any approach could be watched by planetary authorities. Session 4 Elyon Scan At [[Undersea Base Elyon]], Saichi observes a [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] scanning the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] recognizes the method as a way to compare hand structure, bone growth patterns, and genetic identity when someone may be altered, cloned, or otherwise duplicated. When Zoy and Ciernan attempt to speak with the operative, he draws on Zoy, identifies the party as enemies of the state, and warns them not to interfere with SolSec activity.

title: Sunken Ship-Boat
summary: A drowned smuggling ship-boat, now identified as Oduya, raised by the party in Session 5.
text: Sunken Ship Boat A dead hull in the water, and maybe a way out. Overview One of [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]]'s smuggling contacts reported a broken ship's boat sunk off the coast near [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]]. A ship's boat is a small enclosed craft used to move people and cargo between orbit and a world surface. A working one could lift the party out of Jardin's identity trap. During [[Session 5 The Oduya]], the party reached the wreck through the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] and identified it as [[Oduya]], a smuggling ship boat lost roughly forty years ago. Why It Matters Jardin's whole trap is identity. As [[Keith Morris]] warned, leaving directly means passing heavy passport and genetic scans, and the party's papers will not survive them. A ship's boat with changeable or outdated registration is exactly the kind of gap the group needs. Game 5 makes the wreck more valuable than a simple unregistered craft. [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] recovered a [[Transponder Swap Box]] from Oduya's dead captain, giving the ship multiple broadcast identities for system scale movement. Oduya also gives the party a possible way to move restored [[Alain Mercier]] off world without making him return to Jardin's surface, which he says would violate the law governing public deaths and clone restoration. What It Took Raising and reviving the boat is now in progress Reached. The party used the [[TSS Profondeur]] and Transstar cover to reach the wreck. Assessed. Saichi documented removable markings, dead crew, hull damage, and suspicious cargo. Patched. The party sealed major breaches, drained water, restored partial power, and got Oduya moving. Needs repair. The patch job is enough for short movement, but not yet reliable for atmosphere, reentry, or long term operations. Needs funding. Illegal cybernetic cargo may fund repairs through [[Anita Singh]]. Session 5 The Oduya The party raises Oduya enough to move it and learns it sank after a Navy patrol caught it making an underwater drop for the [[Jardin Syndicate]] and dolphin contacts. The patrol used depth charges, damaging the craft and fatally injuring the crew. Official recovery appears to have stopped once a reactor leak made the site unattractive. Known recovered assets [[Oduya]] [[Transponder Swap Box]] Illegal cybernetic weapons and implants. A living tree in hibernation. Logs proving the craft was used for smuggling. Complications The waters near the downport are watched, and port security treats unregistered salvage as smuggling by default. Salvage rights are fragile whoever raises the craft owns it only until someone stronger notices. The ship is a smuggling craft, not a clean Navy vessel. The recovered transponders may carry old enemies, old crimes, or bad registrations. The party needs Oduya to help [[Alain Mercier]] before SolSec, the Navy, or the conspiracy acts. Limits Oduya has no jump drive. Oduya can reach orbit and other planets in the system once repaired. The current hull work is improvised and not yet safe for high stress launch or reentry. The ship's cargo and transponder identities are useful but legally dangerous. gm GM Notes The original pre Session 5 version of this page treated the ship boat as an uncertain escape lead. Session 5 established the working truth the wreck is [[Oduya]], a forty year old smuggler craft with modular transponders, dead crew, illegal cargo, and enough remaining structure to become the party's first system craft. Connected Pages [[Cass Pien (Kolb)]] [[Oduya]] [[Transponder Swap Box]] [[Port Sainte Jeanne Downport]] [[Keith Morris]] [[Miasma]] [[Session 1 Official Business]] [[Session 5 The Oduya]]

title: TSS Profondeur
summary: Refitted former Jardin Navy submersible used by Transstar for the Aquatic Salvage Project.
text: TSS Profondeur ![TSS Profondeur logo](/wiki/media/TSS Profondeur Logo.png) Overview The TSS Profondeur is a Transstar salvage submersible assigned to the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]]. It was formerly a Jardin Navy vessel, damaged during prior service and later purchased or transferred to [[Transstar]] because full naval repair was not worth the expense. [[Étienne Valcourt]] commands the vessel. The senior crew includes [[Maëlle Fournier]] for engineering and damage control, [[Rémi Beauchamp]] for sonar, sensors, and communications, and [[Sabine Caron]] for security and diving operations. Deck Plan ![TSS Profondeur deck plan](/wiki/media/TSS Profondeur Deck Plan.png) Known Details The vessel is around twenty five to thirty years old. It can travel faster than orcas, but full speed operation is noisy enough to advertise its position on sonar. Its missile room has been converted into pressurized rescue tubes or escape pods. The ship is under crewed because experienced hands were moved to train another vessel. Hidden energy weapons are stored aboard but logged as welders. Prior salvage logs mention equipment, oxygenators, power couplers, and scrubbed rescue details. Food service is processed cubes with spice packets; chicken cacciatore and Szechuan sauce are crew favorites. Session 4 The party boards the Profondeur for its first Transstar shift. The crew trains them in shipboard stations, undersea suits, drone work, and emergency procedures before traveling to [[Hadal Research Site]]. After the Hadal rescue, the Profondeur diverts to [[Undersea Base Elyon]] to save the surviving Jardin Navy officer. Session 5 After refueling and replacing spent rescue gear at [[Undersea Base Elyon]], Captain [[Etienne Valcourt]] agrees to take the Profondeur toward the [[Sunken Ship Boat]] under the cover of continued Hadal rescue follow up. Emma persuades him that the work may serve Transstar's interests and help solve a legal problem created by restored [[Alain Mercier]]. The Profondeur delivers the party to [[Oduya]], leaves them oxygen supplies, and briefly acts as a decoy when a small unresponsive craft approaches the salvage site. Open Questions Why are previous rescue logs scrubbed? Who authorized the hidden weapons? Why was the Profondeur's experienced crew split off so soon before a dangerous Hadal mission? Did anyone track the Profondeur's diversion to Oduya?

title: Timeline
summary: Chronological campaign timeline for Sparks of the Past.
text: Timeline 143 1105 Official Business Summons to the Hall The player characters are summoned to the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne for official genetic, military, financial, or AI status review. Their military IDs allow many of them to enter armed, but the grouping is suspiciously convenient for a later frame up. Mercier Broadcast A news item reports that [[Alain Mercier]], Minister of Genetics, plans to reveal corruption in the genetic affairs files at the coming Party Congress. Mercier Assassination Mercier rushes through the office area and is killed by multiple shots. Several characters detect signs that their own weapons have moved or fired without normal handling. The group realizes they may have been framed. Social Solidarity Response [[Elena Verona]] and [[Home Guard]] personnel attempt to contain the room. Emma receives a warning through her attached computer system that the authorities intend to kill the group. The confrontation turns into a firefight. Escape From the Hall The group defeats the immediate security force, loots key equipment, and escapes when [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] kills the pilot of an attacking walker/mech. The group rides the walker down the outside of the building and is collected by a driverless grav speeder. Marcel Delphine The grav speeder carries the group through hidden service routes beneath [[Arcosphere Rousseau]] to [[Marcel Delphine]]. Marcel gives them [[Identity Veils]], explains the [[Jardin Syndicate]]'s interest, and claims the real corruption Mercier found came "from above." Aftermath The official story becomes the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. News broadcasts falsely blame genetic outcasts and show fabricated footage of [[Zoy (Damon)]] throwing a grenade. The group regroups in Emma's safe warehouse, gathers gear, contacts allies, and considers escape or investigation options. Open Paths Investigate who silenced Mercier. Obtain the Syndicate's unedited footage. Unlock [[Mercier's Locked Pad]]. Reach the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]]. Acquire forged identities. Find a boat/submersible and repair the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]. Move within the Jardin system before attempting off world escape to [[Miasma]] or elsewhere. 144 1105 Masks and Markers Warehouse Morning The group wakes in Emma's off grid warehouse. [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] needs a heavy charge soon, the [[Identity Veils]] have limited time left, and the party agrees to split up while they can still move under disguised identities. Hall Reconnaissance At the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]], the recon team sees [[Social Solidarity]] denying [[SolSec]] access to the assassination evidence. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] recognizes [[Inspector Marc Valois]], a SolSec investigator tied to genetic and alien biology crimes. Mobile Data Tube Inside the Hall, [[Dr. Luc Moreau]] sends data through the plumbing in a [[Mobile Data Tube]]. Zoy and Cass recover it, and Emma disarms its self destruct charge. The chip inside later reveals part of the [[Mercier Genetic Findings]]. Saichi Recharged At the Grand Axis, Saichi and Varian use a public shaming as cover. Saichi unplugs a police mech from a heavy charger and restores herself to roughly three days of noncombat power. Sainte Liberte Supply Run The supply team acquires food, medical supplies, water and hygiene goods, batteries, a repair kit, and [[Secure Burner Comms]]. They also meet [[Lucin]], a data broker who can arrange ammunition through a [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] contact. Lucin's Delivery The party completes Lucin's errand, picking up a crate from Dome 2 of [[Les Jardins Fermés]] and delivering it to [[Chief Helene Marchand]]'s secured residence. The crate contains a corgi. The group keeps Lucin's trike. Genetic Marker Revelation The recovered data suggests Mercier was working with decades of genetic marker research tied to psionic like or extraordinary abilities. The file is corrupted before its final conclusion, but known markers include HX 14, SC 9, MY22, and PX 4. Next Decisions Contact [[Marcel Delphine]] before the identity veils fail. Get more or renewed [[Identity Veils]]. Use the recovered data to approach [[SolSec]] or clear the group's names. Move to the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] for safety and ammunition. Compare the party's own genetic records against the recovered markers. Continue attempts to open [[Mercier's Locked Pad]]. 145 1105 Transstar Day Transstar Shelter The party moves into the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] before the [[Identity Veils]] fail. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] becomes a division level executive, the group receives employee badges using their true faces, and [[Claire Bouchard]] assigns them to the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]]. Into the Hadal Deep The crew reports to Dock 6 2 and boards the [[TSS Profondeur]] under [[Étienne Valcourt]]. They train with [[Maëlle Fournier]], [[Rémi Beauchamp]], and [[Sabine Caron]] while traveling to [[Hadal Research Site]]. Hadal Rescue At Hadal, the party finds a sealed oxygenated chamber inside a damaged Transstar research facility. They build a temporary airlock, recover four starving survivors and ten dead Jardin Navy personnel, and salvage generators, data cubes, computer gear, and a Seafarer chip. Mercier Double Only one survivor lives after transfer an unidentified Jardin Navy officer who closely resembles [[Alain Mercier]]. The [[TSS Profondeur]] diverts to [[Undersea Base Elyon]], where medical staff stabilize him. SolSec at Elyon Saichi spots a [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] scanning the survivor. Emma recognizes the scan as a test for genetic identity, bone growth history, or cloning. Victor and Dan delay communications with a salt water battery sabotage, while Zoy and Ciernan's attempted conversation with the agent ends with a gun drawn and a warning to stay out of SolSec business. Open Paths Identify the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. Learn why Jardin Navy personnel were trapped inside a Transstar research facility. Find out what the encrypted [[Jardinian Naval SOS]] really said. Prevent SolSec or Jardin Navy from burying the Hadal rescue. Continue the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] without losing sight of the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. 145 1105 The Oduya Mercier Restored At [[Undersea Base Elyon]], [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] and [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] question the rescued Hadal survivor. He identifies himself as [[Alain Mercier]], restored through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. His memory is about six weeks old, but he can provide access to his house and computer if the party keeps him safe and gets him legally off world. Clone Backup Theory Mercier explains that Platinum 2 officials and comparable elites maintain prepared clone bodies. Restored people whose deaths were public cannot return to Jardin's surface and must leave by Navy ship. He suspects [[Hadal Research Site]] may have been attacked to destroy clone backups before a future assassination. Prime Minister Bombing News reports the [[Prime Minister Bombing|Prime Minister's home bombing]] by suspected separatists. The timing makes the destroyed Hadal clone backups feel less like aftermath and more like preparation. Oduya Raised The party uses the [[TSS Profondeur]] to reach the [[Sunken Ship Boat]], raises it enough to move, and learns the craft's true name is [[Oduya]]. It is a forty year old smuggler ship boat, not a clean Navy vessel. Cargo and Transponders Saichi finds a [[Transponder Swap Box]] held by Oduya's dead captain. The party recovers illegal cybernetics, a valuable living tree in hibernation, and enough salvage value to fund repairs through [[Anita Singh]]. [[Sergey Sun]] becomes the likely channel for moving Mercier off world. Open Paths Repair [[Oduya]] into a reliable orbital and system craft. Move [[Alain Mercier]] off world and collect his house/computer access codes. Investigate the [[Prime Minister Bombing]] and whether Hadal destroyed the Prime Minister's clone backup. Activate the pad recovered with Oduya's dead captain. Visit Mercier's house during the coming Transstar work window.

title: Transponder Swap Box
summary: Metallic case of removable ship transponders recovered from Oduya's dead captain.
text: Transponder Swap Box Overview The Transponder Swap Box is a metallic case recovered by [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] from the dead captain of [[Oduya]] during [[Session 5 The Oduya]]. The case contains multiple cylindrical transponder modules, each built from subtly different marked metals. Function The modules are removable ship transponders. Oduya has an internal plate that accepts one module, draws it deep into the computer, replaces the active identity, and ejects the previous transponder. The system explains why the wreck carried large removable exterior markings Oduya could alter both its broadcast identity and visible nationality. Known Identities The recovered set includes five usable changes in addition to whatever is currently installed Two Solomani transponders. One very old pre war Solomani transponder. One Imperium transponder. One Aslan transponder. Relevance For ordinary travel, ships broadcast identity constantly. This box gives the party a way to disguise Oduya on a planetary or system scale, slip past routine tracking, approach worlds under different profiles, or rescue contacts without immediately tying those actions to their known identities. Risks Any identity may have its own history, debts, enemies, or watchlist flags. Using an Imperium or Aslan transponder inside Solomani controlled space could attract dangerous attention. The hardware is delicate and old; mishandling could damage the modules.

title: Transstar Employment Contract
summary: Corporate employment arrangement that gives the party temporary protection but starts a thirty-day clock.
text: Transstar Employment Contract Overview The Transstar employment contract is the legal shield the party accepts in [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]. As employees, they are protected from ordinary Jardin prosecution while inside the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] or aboard a Transstar ship. Terms Learned A three day work seeker stamp allows entry to seek employment. Successful applicants receive Transstar employee badges. The first thirty days are open employment the employee may leave, and Transstar may fire them. After thirty days, the employee must choose a two , four , or six year term if they stay. Housing, food, storage, cleaning, and other costs are deducted from pay before salary reaches the employee's badge or credit account. Personal anti state beliefs are tolerated only if kept private and non disruptive. Party Impact The contract gives the party time after the [[Identity Veils]] fail. It also places their true faces in Transstar's system, binds them to corporate rules, and makes clearing their names harder to prioritize around work. Connected Pages [[Claire Bouchard]] [[Reena Kessler]] [[Transstar Peacekeepers]] [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]

title: Transstar Peacekeepers
summary: Corporate security force operating inside the Transstar Sector Exchange.
text: Transstar Peacekeepers Overview The Transstar Peacekeepers are the corporate police force seen inside the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] during [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]. Their uniforms differ from Jardin police and signal that the Exchange is governed by corporate law rather than normal planetary enforcement. Role Inside Exchange territory, the Peacekeepers enforce Transstar rules, corporate contracts, commercial order, and internal security. Their authority is one of the reasons the party considers the Exchange a viable refuge while the [[Identity Veils]] fail. Connected Pages [[Transstar]] [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] [[Transstar Employment Contract]] [[Session 3 Transstar Day]]
