session 2 ammunition lead) Overview The Transstar Sector Exchange is the economic heart of Jardin and one of the most important financial centers in the Solomani Front. Located at the southern end of the Grand Axis between Rousseau Arcology and Port Sainte Jeanne, the district serves as the central hub for commerce, banking, shipping contracts, insurance markets, and interstellar investment throughout the subsector. Unlike most of Jardin, the Exchange operates under a special legal charter negotiated between Transstar, the Supreme Presidency, and the Solomani Party. The result is a district that feels markedly different from the rest of the world. Visitors often compare it to A corporate city state A permanent trade conference A civilized battlefield The district is simultaneously one of the wealthiest and least ideological locations on Jardin. Money speaks every language. History Foundation The Exchange was established shortly after Jardin became the dominant economic power of the subsector. As trade expanded, government officials recognized that traditional Party bureaucracy could not process commercial activity quickly enough. Special exemptions were granted. Corporate courts were established. Foreign companies were invited. Certain regulations were relaxed. The experiment proved wildly successful. The Great Expansion Following the Solomani Rim War, the Exchange became one of the Confederation's most important frontier trade hubs. Merchants operating between Confederation Worlds Imperial Border Systems Hive Federation Markets Frontier Colonies all found themselves passing through Jardin. Transstar aggressively expanded the district. Within decades it became the largest concentration of commercial activity in the entire subsector. Governance The Exchange exists under a special charter. It is not independent. But it is not fully governed by standard Jardinese law. The arrangement remains controversial. Officially The Supreme Presidency governs the district. Confederation law applies. Social Solidarity retains authority. In practice Transstar runs most day to day operations. The Exchange Authority The district is administered by the Exchange Authority , a joint body consisting of Transstar Executives Party Representatives Economic Ministry Officials Selected Corporate Delegates Most decisions are made through negotiation. Exchange Security Bureau Corporate Police The district's police force. Often called "Blue Jackets" The Bureau handles Financial crimes Commercial disputes Smuggling investigations Contract enforcement Corporate security Uniforms are dark blue with silver trim. Their authority exists only within Exchange territory. Outside the district they possess no special privileges. Inside the district they are feared. Relationship with Social Solidarity The relationship is tense. Social Solidarity considers the Exchange dangerously independent. The Exchange Authority considers Social Solidarity dangerously intrusive. Both cooperate when necessary. Neither trusts the other. Relationship with SolSec SolSec maintains a permanent office inside the Exchange. Officially Counter espionage. Unofficially Everyone knows the district is crawling with intelligence services. Architecture The district combines Corporate Arcologies Financial Towers Luxury Hotels Trade Centers Elevated Transit Systems The skyline differs dramatically from the monumental government architecture found elsewhere in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne. Corporate logos are everywhere. Many buildings are illuminated twenty four hours a day. The Exchange never truly sleeps. Major Districts The Grand Market The commercial center. Contains Commodity exchanges Trade houses Shipping brokers Merchant guild offices Thousands of contracts worth billions of credits are signed here daily. Transstar Plaza The symbolic center of the district. Dominated by the massive Transstar Solomani Front Headquarters . The building houses Regional Management Route Development Offices Freight Coordination Centers Political Liaison Offices Many citizens consider it the true center of power in the subsector. Meridian Financial Quarter Home to Banks Investment Houses Insurance Syndicates Commodity Funds The wealthiest square kilometer on Jardin. International Concourse The most cosmopolitan district on the planet. Visitors include Imperial merchants Hive traders Aslan brokers Independent captains The district feels noticeably less ideological than the rest of Jardin. Business comes first. Broker's Row Hundreds of freight brokers compete for contracts. Deals ranging from Single cargo containers Entire colony shipments Naval procurement contracts change hands here. Commerce Nearly forty percent of all legal interstellar commerce entering Jardin passes through the Exchange. Major industries include Shipping Finance Insurance Logistics Data Analysis Commodity Trading The district generates enormous tax revenue. Many Party officials privately dislike the Exchange. Few are willing to damage something so profitable. Foreign Presence Special permits allow limited foreign corporate representation. Offices from Imperial Trading Houses Hive Federation Companies Independent Merchant Leagues can be found throughout the district. The Exchange remains one of the few places on Jardin where foreigners are common. Criminal Activity Money attracts crime. The Exchange hosts Corporate espionage Insider trading Data theft Smuggling Financial fraud Most activity remains hidden beneath layers of legality. The Jardin Syndicate The Syndicate maintains extensive influence throughout the Exchange. Activities include Money laundering False cargo manifests Identity creation Smuggling services Many Exchange Security officers spend entire careers fighting Syndicate operations. Most achieve only temporary victories. Notable Individuals [[Antoine Mercier]] Executive Director, Solomani Front Operations The most powerful Transstar executive on Jardin. Frequently rumored to possess more influence than several planetary ministers. [[Commissioner Isabelle Fournier|Isabelle Fournier]] Chief Commissioner, Exchange Security Bureau Respected, feared, and incorruptible. At least according to official statements. [[Lucien Voss]] Senior Freight Broker A legend within the district. Capable of arranging transport to almost anywhere. For a price. [[Mara Kovalenko]] Director of Foreign Trade Relations Responsible for managing interactions with Imperial and Hive commercial interests. Possesses one of the largest diplomatic contact networks in the subsector. Public Reputation Citizens of Jardin often hold mixed opinions regarding the Exchange. Supporters call it The Engine of Prosperity Critics call it The Capitalist Exception Most simply call it Where the Money Is. Rumors The Hidden Market An entire black market exchange allegedly exists beneath the district. The Ghost Accounts Anonymous investment funds appear to move billions of credits without identifiable owners. The Syndicate Ledger A document exists proving corruption at the highest levels of the Exchange Authority. Many have searched for it. Few continue searching. The Foreign Vault One of the banks allegedly stores data belonging to multiple intelligence agencies. Adventure Hooks Market Crash Someone manipulates commodity markets, threatening the economy of multiple worlds. Missing Broker A freight broker disappears after arranging a mysterious shipment. Corporate War Two major corporations begin a covert conflict within the district. Syndicate Money The Travellers uncover evidence of a massive laundering operation. SolSec Investigation An intelligence operation threatens to expose corruption reaching into the Supreme Presidency itself. The Sealed Vault A forgotten data vault from the Solomani Rim War is discovered beneath Transstar Plaza. Everyone wants what is inside. Session 1 Potential Refuge Emma's smuggler contact identified the Transstar Sector Exchange as a possible refuge after the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. The Exchange is described as an independent legal entity inside Jardin not fully outside local reality, but separate enough that the group may not be direct enemies of the state while inside it. The contact compared it to a corporate enclave or embassy like safe zone. If the [[Identity Veils]] begin to fail, reaching the Exchange may allow the group to speak more openly with contacts and seek corporate or smuggling options. Session 2 Ammunition Lead During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], [[Lucin]] claimed he has a broker in Transstar who can provide military grade ammunition if the group supplies the weapon models and credits. The GM also flagged Transstar as a safer next destination where the party might pick up ammunition and avoid being ambushed in the warehouse district. gm Referee Notes The Transstar Sector Exchange should feel fundamentally different from the rest of Jardin. The Palace of Continuity is about power. The Hall of Chosen Futures is about control. The Closed Gardens are about science. Rousseau is about people. The Exchange is about money. Here ideology bends around profit. Party officials, merchants, smugglers, bankers, intelligence agents, and foreign traders all operate in close proximity. It is the one place on Jardin where a person can genuinely believe that credits matter more than politics. Whether that belief is true remains open to debate.

session 2 ammunition lead) Overview The Transstar Sector Exchange is the economic heart of Jardin and one of the most important financial centers in the Solomani Front. Located at the southern end of the Grand Axis between Rousseau Arcology and Port Sainte Jeanne, the district serves as the central hub for commerce, banking, shipping contracts, insurance markets, and interstellar investment throughout the subsector. Unlike most of Jardin, the Exchange operates under a special legal charter negotiated between Transstar, the Supreme Presidency, and the Solomani Party. The result is a district that feels markedly different from the rest of the world. Visitors often compare it to A corporate city state A permanent trade conference A civilized battlefield The district is simultaneously one of the wealthiest and least ideological locations on Jardin. Money speaks every language. History Foundation The Exchange was established shortly after Jardin became the dominant economic power of the subsector. As trade expanded, government officials recognized that traditional Party bureaucracy could not process commercial activity quickly enough. Special exemptions were granted. Corporate courts were established. Foreign companies were invited. Certain regulations were relaxed. The experiment proved wildly successful. The Great Expansion Following the Solomani Rim War, the Exchange became one of the Confederation's most important frontier trade hubs. Merchants operating between Confederation Worlds Imperial Border Systems Hive Federation Markets Frontier Colonies all found themselves passing through Jardin. Transstar aggressively expanded the district. Within decades it became the largest concentration of commercial activity in the entire subsector. Governance The Exchange exists under a special charter. It is not independent. But it is not fully governed by standard Jardinese law. The arrangement remains controversial. Officially The Supreme Presidency governs the district. Confederation law applies. Social Solidarity retains authority. In practice Transstar runs most day to day operations. The Exchange Authority The district is administered by the Exchange Authority , a joint body consisting of Transstar Executives Party Representatives Economic Ministry Officials Selected Corporate Delegates Most decisions are made through negotiation. Exchange Security Bureau Corporate Police The district's police force. Often called "Blue Jackets" The Bureau handles Financial crimes Commercial disputes Smuggling investigations Contract enforcement Corporate security Uniforms are dark blue with silver trim. Their authority exists only within Exchange territory. Outside the district they possess no special privileges. Inside the district they are feared. Relationship with Social Solidarity The relationship is tense. Social Solidarity considers the Exchange dangerously independent. The Exchange Authority considers Social Solidarity dangerously intrusive. Both cooperate when necessary. Neither trusts the other. Relationship with SolSec SolSec maintains a permanent office inside the Exchange. Officially Counter espionage. Unofficially Everyone knows the district is crawling with intelligence services. Architecture The district combines Corporate Arcologies Financial Towers Luxury Hotels Trade Centers Elevated Transit Systems The skyline differs dramatically from the monumental government architecture found elsewhere in Nouvelle Sainte Jeanne. Corporate logos are everywhere. Many buildings are illuminated twenty four hours a day. The Exchange never truly sleeps. Major Districts The Grand Market The commercial center. Contains Commodity exchanges Trade houses Shipping brokers Merchant guild offices Thousands of contracts worth billions of credits are signed here daily. Transstar Plaza The symbolic center of the district. Dominated by the massive Transstar Solomani Front Headquarters . The building houses Regional Management Route Development Offices Freight Coordination Centers Political Liaison Offices Many citizens consider it the true center of power in the subsector. Meridian Financial Quarter Home to Banks Investment Houses Insurance Syndicates Commodity Funds The wealthiest square kilometer on Jardin. International Concourse The most cosmopolitan district on the planet. Visitors include Imperial merchants Hive traders Aslan brokers Independent captains The district feels noticeably less ideological than the rest of Jardin. Business comes first. Broker's Row Hundreds of freight brokers compete for contracts. Deals ranging from Single cargo containers Entire colony shipments Naval procurement contracts change hands here. Commerce Nearly forty percent of all legal interstellar commerce entering Jardin passes through the Exchange. Major industries include Shipping Finance Insurance Logistics Data Analysis Commodity Trading The district generates enormous tax revenue. Many Party officials privately dislike the Exchange. Few are willing to damage something so profitable. Foreign Presence Special permits allow limited foreign corporate representation. Offices from Imperial Trading Houses Hive Federation Companies Independent Merchant Leagues can be found throughout the district. The Exchange remains one of the few places on Jardin where foreigners are common. Criminal Activity Money attracts crime. The Exchange hosts Corporate espionage Insider trading Data theft Smuggling Financial fraud Most activity remains hidden beneath layers of legality. The Jardin Syndicate The Syndicate maintains extensive influence throughout the Exchange. Activities include Money laundering False cargo manifests Identity creation Smuggling services Many Exchange Security officers spend entire careers fighting Syndicate operations. Most achieve only temporary victories. Notable Individuals [[Antoine Mercier]] Executive Director, Solomani Front Operations The most powerful Transstar executive on Jardin. Frequently rumored to possess more influence than several planetary ministers. [[Commissioner Isabelle Fournier|Isabelle Fournier]] Chief Commissioner, Exchange Security Bureau Respected, feared, and incorruptible. At least according to official statements. [[Lucien Voss]] Senior Freight Broker A legend within the district. Capable of arranging transport to almost anywhere. For a price. [[Mara Kovalenko]] Director of Foreign Trade Relations Responsible for managing interactions with Imperial and Hive commercial interests. Possesses one of the largest diplomatic contact networks in the subsector. Public Reputation Citizens of Jardin often hold mixed opinions regarding the Exchange. Supporters call it The Engine of Prosperity Critics call it The Capitalist Exception Most simply call it Where the Money Is. Rumors The Hidden Market An entire black market exchange allegedly exists beneath the district. The Ghost Accounts Anonymous investment funds appear to move billions of credits without identifiable owners. The Syndicate Ledger A document exists proving corruption at the highest levels of the Exchange Authority. Many have searched for it. Few continue searching. The Foreign Vault One of the banks allegedly stores data belonging to multiple intelligence agencies. Adventure Hooks Market Crash Someone manipulates commodity markets, threatening the economy of multiple worlds. Missing Broker A freight broker disappears after arranging a mysterious shipment. Corporate War Two major corporations begin a covert conflict within the district. Syndicate Money The Travellers uncover evidence of a massive laundering operation. SolSec Investigation An intelligence operation threatens to expose corruption reaching into the Supreme Presidency itself. The Sealed Vault A forgotten data vault from the Solomani Rim War is discovered beneath Transstar Plaza. Everyone wants what is inside. Session 1 Potential Refuge Emma's smuggler contact identified the Transstar Sector Exchange as a possible refuge after the [[Mercier Frame Up]]. The Exchange is described as an independent legal entity inside Jardin not fully outside local reality, but separate enough that the group may not be direct enemies of the state while inside it. The contact compared it to a corporate enclave or embassy like safe zone. If the [[Identity Veils]] begin to fail, reaching the Exchange may allow the group to speak more openly with contacts and seek corporate or smuggling options. Session 2 Ammunition Lead During [[Session 2 Masks and Markers]], [[Lucin]] claimed he has a broker in Transstar who can provide military grade ammunition if the group supplies the weapon models and credits. The GM also flagged Transstar as a safer next destination where the party might pick up ammunition and avoid being ambushed in the warehouse district. gm Referee Notes The Transstar Sector Exchange should feel fundamentally different from the rest of Jardin. The Palace of Continuity is about power. The Hall of Chosen Futures is about control. The Closed Gardens are about science. Rousseau is about people. The Exchange is about money. Here ideology bends around profit. Party officials, merchants, smugglers, bankers, intelligence agents, and foreign traders all operate in close proximity. It is the one place on Jardin where a person can genuinely believe that credits matter more than politics. Whether that belief is true remains open to debate.

title: Transstar
text: Transstar The Merchant Line of the Solomani Cause Designation Transstar | Type Corporation | TL 14 | Status Active | Owner Solomani Party ![Transstar logo](/wiki/media/Transstar Logo.png) | Field | Value | | | | | Designation | Transstar | | Nickname | The Party Line | | Type | Megacorporation | | Headquarters | Home | | Area of Operations | Entire Solomani Confederation | | Ownership | Majority Solomani Party Controlled | | Status | Active | Overview Transstar is the largest transportation company operating within the Solomani Confederation and the only Solomani corporation to achieve true megacorporation status. It operates freight services, passenger lines, orbital facilities, and logistics networks spanning the entire Solomani Sphere. Officially, Transstar is a commercial enterprise. Unofficially, it is one of the most important institutions in the Confederation. The company provides Interstellar freight transport Passenger transportation Orbital facilities management Frontier logistics Government transportation contracts Strategic shipping support Many citizens joke that there are only three ways to cross the Confederation Join the Navy Own a ship Ride Transstar Most choose the third option. History Origins Transstar began as a relatively modest transport company operating in the Solomani Rim during the final centuries of Imperial rule. At the time, many Solomani owned companies struggled to compete against the vast resources of Imperial megacorporations. As support for the Solomani Movement increased, Transstar became one of its earliest and most important corporate backers. Its executives believed that the economic interests of the Solomani worlds were being ignored by the Imperial center. The company funded Political organizations Party congresses Frontier development Solomani advocacy groups These investments proved highly profitable. First Party Congress Transstar played a major role in the First Solomani Party Congress. The company provided discounted transportation for delegates traveling to Terra and became one of the primary financial supporters of the emerging movement. Many historians believe the Solomani Movement would have developed much more slowly without Transstar's assistance. Rise of the Confederation Following the creation of the Solomani Confederation, Transstar expanded rapidly. Its existing political connections allowed it to secure Government contracts Exclusive transportation agreements Infrastructure projects Frontier expansion initiatives Within a century it had become the dominant merchant line in the Confederation. Modern Era Today Transstar remains the only true Solomani megacorporation. Its influence extends into every sector of Confederation life. Many observers consider it less a corporation and more an unofficial ministry. Corporate Structure Board of Directors Officially governs the corporation. Most members possess extensive Party connections. Many previously held government positions. Regional Directorates Manage operations at the sector and subsector level. These positions are highly sought after. A successful regional director often transitions into government service. Political Liaison Office Coordinates relations with Solomani Party organizations Local governments SolSec Confederation ministries Officially this office exists for regulatory compliance. Few believe that explanation. Passenger Services Transstar's passenger network serves billions of travelers annually. The company has a reputation for Reliability Punctuality Professionalism It has less of a reputation for comfort. Middle Passage accommodations are often described as "Efficient." This is rarely intended as a compliment. Many older liners originated as Colony transports Troop carriers Refitted freight vessels especially following austerity measures after the Solomani Rim War. Taj Mahal Class The pride of the fleet. The Taj Mahal class luxury liners are among the finest passenger vessels operating anywhere in Charted Space. Features include Jump 4 capability Luxury accommodations High end dining Cultural programming VIP suites Their service rivals anything available in the Imperium. Their prices do as well. Freight Operations Freight remains the corporation's primary source of revenue. Transstar moves Industrial goods Agricultural products Military supplies Consumer products Colonial equipment Throughout much of the Confederation economy, if a product exists on another world, Transstar probably moved it. Political Influence Transstar is deeply intertwined with the Solomani Party. The corporation is now largely Party owned and serves as a major source of Party income. Benefits include Access to political leaders Favorable contracts Infrastructure support In exchange, the Party receives Revenue Transportation capacity Strategic logistics Critics frequently describe the relationship as indistinguishable from state ownership. Supporters call it patriotic cooperation. SolSec Connections Transstar is widely believed to be heavily infiltrated by SolSec. The corporation officially denies these claims. No one takes the denial seriously. Passengers generally assume Security personnel are present. Communications are monitored. Suspicious activities are reported. Whether this is true varies considerably. Presence on Jardin Transstar maintains a massive presence on Jardin. Major facilities include Port Sainte Jeanne Highport Primary orbital logistics hub. Rousseau Commercial Exchange Regional corporate headquarters. Jardin Freight Integration Center Coordinates cargo movement throughout the subsector. Hall of Commerce Annex Maintains direct links with local government ministries. The corporation is among the largest employers on the planet. Common Sayings "Transstar gets there." Official corporate slogan. "The Party rides Transstar." Popular joke among merchants. "If you can move it, Transstar already has." Common saying among freight operators. Rivals Independent merchant captains Imperial shipping interests Regional freight cooperatives The Jardin Syndicate While Transstar dominates legal transport, many illegal migration and smuggling routes compete directly with its services. Adventure Hooks Missing Cargo A routine freight shipment disappears between systems. Party Courier The Travellers are hired to escort a politically sensitive passenger. Highport Incident A security lockdown traps thousands of passengers. SolSec Investigation Evidence suggests a senior Transstar executive is working with smugglers. The Syndicate Route The Jardin Syndicate has established an illegal migration corridor that bypasses Transstar entirely. Corporate Election A battle for control of a regional directorate threatens to spill into local politics. Transstar Personnel of Jardin A collection of notable Transstar employees, executives, and operators commonly encountered on Jardin and throughout the surrounding subsector. [[Étienne Moreau]] Regional Director, Jardin Subsector Age 61 Species Solomani Human Location Rousseau Commercial Exchange The senior Transstar executive on Jardin. Moreau is polished, intelligent, and politically connected. He views transportation as the nervous system of civilization and genuinely believes Transstar holds the Confederation together. Many believe his next promotion will be to a Ministry of Economics position. Others believe he already works for SolSec. No one is completely certain. [[Claire Bouchard]] Highport Operations Manager Age 44 Species Solomani Human Location Port Sainte Jeanne Highport Responsible for coordinating thousands of arrivals and departures every week. Bouchard has a reputation for absolute efficiency. Nothing surprises her. Nothing delays her. Nothing intimidates her. She can reroute half a sector's shipping traffic while eating lunch. [[Captain Victor Mendes|Victor Mendes]] Senior Freight Captain Age 47 Species Mixed Human Location Various Routes A former Confederation Navy petty officer who now commands the freighter Prosperity's Promise . Known for Reliability Honesty Protecting his crew Often hired for sensitive cargo assignments. Refuses to transport anything he believes is connected to slavery. [[Nadine Pelletier]] Passenger Services Director Age 38 Species Solomani Human Location Jardin Orbital Terminal The public face of Transstar luxury travel. Charismatic and media savvy. She oversees the arrival of VIPs, Party officials, and wealthy travelers. Rumors persist that she knows every secret carried by every important passenger. [[Luc Girard]] Labor Coordinator Age 55 Species Solomani Human Location Industrial Levels, Rousseau Arcology Responsible for assigning thousands of dockworkers and logistics personnel. Officially he manages staffing. Unofficially he can make careers appear or disappear. His influence among working class Party members is considerable. [[Sarah Chen]] Route Intelligence Analyst Age 34 Species Solomani Human Location Regional Data Center Tracks Shipping patterns Economic trends Passenger flows Frontier development Often knows a recession is coming before local governments do. SolSec frequently requests her reports. She pretends not to notice. [[Armand Rousselet]] Senior Customs Liaison Age 58 Species Solomani Human Location Port Sainte Jeanne Works between Transstar and customs authorities. Has spent thirty years finding legal solutions to impossible problems. Many smugglers hate him. Many smugglers secretly respect him. [[Elena Kovacs]] Taj Mahal Class Purser Age 42 Species Solomani Human Location Luxury Routes Oversees high passage passengers aboard the luxury liner SS Nouvelle Aube . Can handle Billionaires Admirals Diplomats Celebrities without breaking a sweat. She possesses enough gossip to destabilize multiple governments. [[Philippe Laurent]] Fleet Maintenance Director Age 50 Species Solomani Human Location Jardin Shipyards Responsible for maintenance of over four hundred vessels operating within the region. Famous for his obsession with preventative maintenance. Frequently quoted as saying "Ships don't fail. Managers fail." His engineers are terrified of disappointing him. [[Amelia Torres]] Special Projects Coordinator Age 36 Species Solomani Human Location Unknown Officially she oversees strategic transportation initiatives. Nobody is entirely sure what that means. She appears whenever SolSec becomes involved Party officials travel Sensitive cargo moves Many employees believe she works for intelligence services. She always smiles when asked. gm Referee Notes These ten NPCs collectively represent most of the power centers within Transstar Executive Leadership Highport Operations Freight Transport Passenger Services Labor Relations Data Analysis Customs Luxury Travel Fleet Logistics Political Operations Any Traveller dealing with Transstar on Jardin is likely to encounter at least one of them. Most are loyal to Transstar first. Some are loyal to the Party first. A few may be loyal to something else entirely. Transstar is effectively the economic arm of the Solomani Party. Its executives, managers, and logistics coordinators form an unofficial pipeline into government service. Many ministers began their careers with Transstar. Many retired politicians end them there. The corporation's greatest asset is not its ships. It is information. Every year Transstar transports billions of passengers and countless cargo shipments. The resulting data provides a remarkably accurate picture of economic, political, and social trends throughout the Confederation. Several intelligence analysts privately argue that Transstar understands the Confederation better than the government itself. Whether that is true remains uncertain. The corporation has no desire to rule. Its leadership is content to ensure that whoever does rule depends upon Transstar to keep the Confederation moving. Session 4 Undersea Salvage During [[Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep]], Transstar's protection becomes concrete employment aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. The party's first assignment on the [[Aquatic Salvage Project]] sends them to [[Hadal Research Site]], a damaged undersea Transstar facility. The mission reveals a dangerous contradiction for Transstar the sealed survivors at Hadal are Jardin Navy personnel, not Transstar staff. The party's rescue of the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]] also shows that Transstar owned spaces such as [[Undersea Base Elyon]] are not free of [[SolSec]] activity.

title: Undersea Base Elyon
summary: Transstar-owned undersea base with ship airlock, repair capacity, and emergency medical response.
text: Undersea Base Elyon ![Hadal undersea operations map](/wiki/media/Hadal Undersea Map.png) Overview Undersea Base Elyon is a Transstar owned underwater base near [[Hadal Research Site]]. It functions like a compact undersea industrial platform, with real meals, a bar, a full size ship airlock, and enough dry dock capacity to repair submersibles that cannot safely return to the coast. Known Details The base is about one hour from Hadal by Profondeur. It has roughly 60 to 100 personnel active in Session 4. Its full size airlock can bring ships inside for repairs. It has emergency medical staff capable of advanced nanite treatment. It is Transstar owned, but [[SolSec]] can operate there. Session 4 The [[TSS Profondeur]] diverts to Elyon after the Hadal rescue. Medical staff stabilize the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]], while Valcourt gathers the party to discuss the disturbing fact that a full Jardin Navy group was found trapped inside a Transstar facility. Saichi later sees a [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] enter the survivor's room and take a hand and bone growth scan. Session 5 The party remains at Elyon after the SolSec confrontation. [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] and [[Victor Mendes (Steinbach)]] enter the survivor's medical room and question him after he wakes. The survivor identifies himself as [[Alain Mercier]] restored through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]]. Elyon therefore becomes the place where the party learns that the Hadal rescue was not a simple lookalike mystery, but a direct continuation of the Mercier assassination.

title: Undersea Extremists
summary: Aquatic attackers opposed to Transstar undersea operations, including humanoids and cybernetically enhanced orcas.
text: Undersea Extremists Overview The Undersea Extremists are the aquatic opposition Transstar blames for attacks on salvage and research operations. In Session 3 they were described loosely as [[Dolphin Extremists]], but the Session 4 briefing clarifies that the threat includes humanoids and orcas. Known Capabilities Orcas can move large volumes by swallowing cargo and coughing it up elsewhere. Key attackers use cybernetic rigs that give them immense ripping strength underwater. Their favored weapons include micro propelled explosive harpoons that can compromise suits or damage a ship. They have attacked undersea facilities, including [[Hadal Research Site]]. Open Questions Are they attacking Transstar for ideological, ecological, military, or defensive reasons? Did they trap the Jardin Navy personnel at Hadal intentionally? Are they connected to the earlier [[Sunken Ship Boat]] lead?

Their favored weapons include micro propelled explosive harpoons that can compromise suits or damage a ship. They have attacked undersea facilities, including [[Hadal Research Site]]. Open Questions Are they attacking Transstar for ideological, ecological, military, or defensive reasons? Did they trap the Jardin Navy personnel at Hadal intentionally? Are they connected to the earlier [[Sunken Ship Boat]] lead?

title: Undersea Suits
summary: Pressure-rated diving suits used by Transstar crews for salvage and underwater combat.
text: Undersea Suits Overview Undersea suits are pressure rated suits used by Transstar crews during deep salvage and underwater combat. They use familiar vac suit procedures and skill, but they are not ordinary space suits they are built to survive high external pressure rather than vacuum. Session 4 [[Sabine Caron]] trains the party on suit use aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]]. The crew learns buddy checks, suit lights, communications channels, pressure concerns, and tank color coding for different depths and gas mixes. Tool users carry backpack repair kits. Security personnel can carry undersea weapons such as harpoon guns. The training emphasizes that ordinary slug weapons and careless laser fire can endanger a soft hull or suit environment. Known Details Buddy checks take longer but improve the chance of safe operation. Suit computers show distance to ship and teammates, but not always direction. Neck mics and private channels manage communications outside the ship. Exterior work can involve phantom heat/cold, pressure stress, claustrophobia, and heartbeat noise inside the suit.

title: Varian Svazz (Allen)
text: Varian Svazz (Allen) ![Varian Svazz portrait](/wiki/media/Varian Svaz.png) Solomani Racial • Confederation Navy Flight Player Allen Age 34 Species Solomani Racial Gender Male UPP STR 8, DEX 12, END 12, INT 11, EDU 14, SOC 7 Hits 30 Ship Shares 2 Profile Varian Svazz is cool headed, perceptive, and professionally polite, with charisma rooted in competence rather than warmth. He believes in systems but no longer trusts institutions. Officially retired from the Navy and unofficially exiled, Varian is tied to a betrayal that may point toward a larger covert operation involving procurement, black patrol routes, or buried Confederation secrets. Notable Skills Pilot (Spacecraft) 3, Diplomat 2, Mechanic 2, Medic 2, Admin 1, Astrogation 1, Electronics (Computers) 1, Electronics (Sensors) 1, Engineer (J drive) 1, Engineer (M drive) 1, Gun Combat (Slug) 1, Gunner (Capital) 1, Gunner (Turret) 1, Leadership 1, Pilot (Small Craft) 1, Recon 1, Tactics (Naval) 1, Vacc Suit 1. Connections Session 3 Transstar Day Entered the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] with the first group seeking legal cover. Assessed the Transstar employment test structure and tried to turn naval/spacer competence into a useful placement. Helped the group transition from emergency fugitives to Transstar workers with a thirty day decision window. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Trained on [[TSS Profondeur]] piloting and command systems. Piloted the submersible with exceptional precision during the approach to [[Hadal Research Site]]. Helped bring the Profondeur close enough to the Hadal stabilizing/power interface for operations. Noticed that the surviving rescued Jardin Navy officer looked strikingly like [[Alain Mercier]]. Session 5 The Oduya No distinct individual spotlight is captured in the Game 5 transcript. Remains part of the party's Transstar cover and the wider effort to protect restored [[Alain Mercier]], recover [[Oduya]], and find evidence that can clear the group. Enemy Betrayer, formerly an education ally or close clique member Session 1 Official Business Noticed [[Alain Mercier]] moving through the office area with urgency shortly before the assassination. Carried Mercier's body briefly during the chaos and reported "man down" before complying. Helped the group move through the escape and regroup afterward. Contacted an education ally to retrieve belongings and obtain astrogation/navigation study material. Session 2 Masks and Markers Accompanied [[0 31 Saichi Maru (Annette)]] to find a heavy charge source. Identified the public shaming at the Grand Axis as a patriotic/civic discipline event rather than an immediate execution. Used diplomacy and crowd energy to help distract attention while Saichi charged from a police mech. Helped the group understand the public shaming as a revealing, systemic feature of Jardin's culture. Returned with Saichi after she restored enough power to keep operating for the next phase. Ally Education close clique Equipment & Benefits Advanced Combat Rifle, 2 ship shares. gm Import Notes Imported from Foundry actor export fvtt Actor varian svazz (allen) qSXhjmEsLdbd610i.json .

title: Victor Mendes (Steinbach)
text: Victor Mendes (Steinbach) ![Victor Mendes portrait](/wiki/media/Victor Mendes.png) Solomani Mixed • Confederation Navy Line Crew Player Steinbach Age 34 Species Solomani Mixed Gender Male UPP STR 8, DEX 9, END 9, INT 13, EDU 10, SOC 9 Hits 26 Ship Shares 5 Profile Victor Mendes is a sharp minded, physically formidable Solomani Confederation citizen who spent four terms in the Confederation Navy. He left the service as a Petty Officer 1st Class after line and crew assignments marked by exploration, racial violence, and command interest in his advancement. Notable Skills Astrogation 4, Leadership 3, Tactics (Naval) 2, Medic 2, Vacc Suit 2, Deception 2, Engineer (J drive) 1, Electronics (Sensors) 1, Gun Combat (Slug) 1, Gunner (Turret) 1, Mechanic 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Recon 1, Survival 1. Connections Session 3 Transstar Day Helped frame the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] as the party's best immediate refuge from Jardin law. Used leadership and naval experience to support the employment test process. Entered Transstar work as part of the group's corporate legal shield. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Applied naval tactics to understand the [[TSS Profondeur]]'s under crewed state and suspicious converted rescue pod setup. Helped identify odd prior crew traces and hidden shipboard irregularities. Supported Dan's temporary airlock plan at [[Hadal Research Site]]. Kept the improvised seal holding long enough for the team to recover the survivors. Helped maneuver rescue tubes into place and later assisted the salt water sabotage of Elyon's communications batteries. Session 5 The Oduya Went with [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] to question the rescued survivor at [[Undersea Base Elyon]]. Woke the survivor and stayed calm when the man recognized him from the assassination footage. Helped establish that the survivor was [[Alain Mercier]] restored through the [[Clone Rebirth Program]], not a simple lookalike. Persuaded Mercier that the party wanted to clear its name and had also been targeted by the same conspiracy. Helped turn Mercier's legal need for a Navy/off world transfer into the plan to recover the [[Sunken Ship Boat]]. Took part in the [[Oduya]] recovery, including vac suit preparation, engineering support, and systems work. Helped consider how to fund the ship's repairs from recovered contraband. Enemy Racial Incident Session 1 Official Business Arrived without his gun, then assessed distance, cover, and possible exits as Social Solidarity and Home Guard arrived. Grappled [[Elena Verona]] during the firefight and took her sidearm/gear, including the one use grav belt. Used the grav belt during the exterior descent. Recognized that the hidden routes beneath [[Arcosphere Rousseau]] resembled criminal access ways used in the cracks of Jardin society. Returned to his apartment after the escape, noticed it had been disturbed, and left after saying aloud that he had done nothing wrong. Lost a Social Solidarity tail before returning to the group. Session 2 Masks and Markers Joined the Sainte Liberte supply team and helped frame Lucin's errand as a low risk way to gain a vehicle, trust, and an information broker. Emphasized that the party should keep overwatch and reserves in place before attempting the delivery. Pointed out that the group may have been chosen because their existing connections and expendability made them easy to frame as a conspiracy. Supported using the recovered evidence to approach [[SolSec]] rather than trusting planetary security. Unnamed Contact Unnamed Contact Unnamed Ally Equipment & Benefits Terran Adventurers Society membership x2, 5 ship shares. gm Import Notes Imported from Foundry actor export fvtt Actor victor mendes (steinbach) DWE8SuP71tAw4GBU.json .

title: Zoy (Damon)
text: Zoy (Damon) ![Zoy portrait](/wiki/media/Zoy.png) Uplifted Ape Chimp • Merchant Free Trader Player Damon Age 34 Species Uplifted Ape Chimp Gender Unknown UPP STR 6, DEX 8, END 11, INT 11, EDU 10, SOC 4 Hits 25 Armour Cloth Trench Coat, Protection 7 Cash Cr11,100 Medical Debt Cr30,000 Profile Zoy is a sharp minded, physically formidable uplifted chimpanzee and Solomani Confederation citizen. Their career spans Rogue, Drifter, and Merchant work, ending as a Free Trader senior crewman. They chose the Belter background package before career entry and carry the marks of criminal rivalries, captivity, debt, and hard won survival. Notable Skills Astrogation 2, Recon 3, Stealth 3, Survival 2, Streetwise 2, Profession (Belter) 2, Electronics (Computers) 2, Medic 2, Vacc Suit 2, Broker 1, Deception 1, Gambler 1, Mechanic 1, Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Gun Combat specialties 1, Melee (Blade) 1. Connections Session 1 Official Business Was present at the Hall during the [[Mercier Assassination]] and became a central target of the [[False News Broadcast]]. Public propaganda falsely showed Zoy throwing a grenade at [[Alain Mercier]]. Checked regular news afterward and discovered the fake narrative accusing genetic "half breeds" of the attack. His criminal/underworld contacts were treated as linked to the [[Jardin Syndicate]] for gear recovery. The public story makes Zoy especially visible as a scapegoat. Session 2 Masks and Markers Entered the [[Hall des Futurs Choisis]] bathroom with Cass while following an anxious Hall scientist. Climbed above the stall and saw the scientist place a data stick into a metal tube before flushing it. Helped recover the [[Mobile Data Tube]] from the plumbing before it escaped. Carried the tube out covertly so Emma could disarm it and access the data chip. Reviewed the recovered data with [[Emma Colbert (Laura)]] back at the warehouse, tying it to Mercier's genetic marker research. Session 3 Transstar Day Entered the [[Transstar Sector Exchange]] through confidence, confusion, and paperwork ambiguity rather than a normal stamp. Remained a highly visible scapegoat from the false assassination broadcast while the group sought Transstar protection. Joined the party's transition into Transstar employment before the identity veils failed. Session 4 Into the Hadal Deep Took part in the first undersea shift aboard the [[TSS Profondeur]] and exterior mission planning. Helped track the SolSec problem after Saichi spotted the scan of the [[Mercier Lookalike Survivor]]. Intercepted the [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] with Ciernan nearby. Tried to open a conversation about shared interest in the truth, but the operative drew a gun on him and warned the party away from SolSec activity. Session 5 The Oduya Debriefed the group after the [[SolSec Operative at Elyon]] drew a gun on him. Argued that the party should avoid threatening SolSec agents and should be careful about opening a second SolSec channel. Suggested Emma might be able to gather intelligence from the operative one on one, though the group did not pursue it. Helped frame the question of whether to continue short term Transstar work while rejecting a two year commitment. Took part in the [[Oduya]] recovery and cargo inspection. Helped examine and value the illegal cybernetics, becoming visibly uneasy when Ciernan handled or coveted them.
